tei:titleStmt.tei:title: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen gyi smad cha bzhugs
o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen gyi smad cha bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen gyi smad cha bzhugs so/

༈ gsung gi bdag nyid dbang chen rtam̐ mchom̐g dpal/ /gti mug nām̐ gam̐ klum̐ gdon 'dum̐l mdzad skur/ /bzhengs nas snyigs 'gros nad gdon gdug pa las/ /grol ba'i dbam̐ng mchog bskur thabs 'di yang zab/ /so gsum pa gsung rigs dbang chen rta mchog rol pa nā ga klu 'dul gyi dbang bskur ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sbyor ba bsham bkod la/ mdun stegs mthing nag khebs ldan gyi thog tu dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus su/ bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings mthing nag bhan+dha me long shel rdo dang bcas dbang bzhi brtsegs mar bsham/ mig dar/ me tog /gser thur/ gtso bo'i sku/ dur khrod chas brgyad/ gtor ma/ nya bo/ phur pa/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan ral gri dbyug to khyung*/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan lcags kyu thod khrag sbrul zhags/ yum gyi phyag mtshan gri thod/ rig tsaka /sngon gtor chad brtan bskul gsum gsol kha sman raka gtor ma sogs/ bsham pa'i mdun du nyer spyod sna bdun bskor bsham spyi mthun bzhin bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas brtsam ste brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed las gzhung bzhin btang la bstod pa'i mjug tu dzap khang dbye/ bsnyen sgrub ci nus mthar bum pa gnyis sgrub rjes dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod grub pa dang bum lha 'od zhu bya/ de nas bka' gter srung ma gsol kha rgyas bsdus dang skong bshags nas tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar song nas slob ma mdun du bos te khrus bstsal pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus phyag byas te gral la 'khod/ de nas bgegs gtor h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab/ sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ

sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun kyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags/ snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du dbang chen rta phag yab yum/ sprul pa yang sprul phag sdig khyung gsum sogs nā ga klu 'dul gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub par byed pa la/ bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi/ gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes sogs drag sngags spos rol dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ las gzhung bzhin mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: steng 'og me dang mtshon cha'i gur: drwa mig lcags sdig khyung gis gtams: spu gri khro chung pha lam sbar: cis kyang mi tshugs 'khor lo'i gur: om̐ badz+ra ram̐ ā yur dha tsakra rak+ṣa ham̐'u: phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me dpung mtha' med du 'phro bas bcings te cis kyang mi shigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ de nas las rdor gyis me tog bkye bsdu bya zhing slob dpon gyis zhwa chos bcas/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mthar thug sku bzhi yongs rdzogs dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du yi dam rta mgrin nyi ma'i snying po'i dbang bskur gsan te/ lam rim gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed legs par gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

gang gsan par bya ba'i chos la/ de'ang 'og min bde chen bkod pa'i klong du/ bde ba chen po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sku dang ye shes tha dad med pa'i tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas par snang bas/ gsung pad+ma'i chos dbyings dus gsum chad pa med pas/ pad+ma dbang chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rnam par rol pa'i/ rgyud lung man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab par chos nyid rdo rje'i rang sgras bstan cing*/ ston mchog gsung gi rdo rje de nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa la/ 'phags bod gnyis su grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha ba zhes bya ba'i skur bzhengs nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams/ tshe gcig gis zung 'jug chen po'i sa la sbyor ba'i zab mo'i gdams ngag gang la gang 'dul du ston pa las/ pad+ma he ru ka dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i rnam par snang ba la rgyud dang lung gi bye brag /zab cing rgya che bar bzhugs pa rnams la brten nas slob dpon nā gārdzu na gtsor gyur mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rig 'dzin rnams kyis/ man ngag gi bka' srol rgyas bsdus mang du bkral ba rnams las/ khyad par du 'phags pa dbang chen dngos dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon pad+ma kā ras/ gangs can ljongs kyi gdul bya so so'i mos blo dang yul dus kyi gnas skabs la dgongs pa'i dbang chen rta mgrin dmar nag gi sgrub thabs man ngag che phra du ma mdzad/ phal cher ma 'ongs snyigs dus kyi gdul dka' 'dul ba'i don du gter gyi bye brag mang du sbas pa las/ skabs su babs pa'i yi dam rta mgrin nyi ma'i snying po zhes/ rta mgrin rgyud lung gi sgrub thabs bskyed rdzogs man ngag zab cing nyung la gnad du dril ba 'di nyid bka' bab thugs kyi bu dgu'i nang tshan/ gangs ljongs phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po mthu chen bud+dha dz+nyā na'i rnam 'phrul/ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas zab gter don lnga bzhes pa'i nang tshan/

rab byung bcu gnyis pa lcags pho khyi'i lor pad+ma sbas pa'i tshal bdud ri nag po rngam 'dra'i lung pa'i mda'/ dar sna pha wang rta mgo nas khrom gter du gdan drangs pa'i pa'i gdams skor khyad par 'phags pa yin te/ gter gzhung las/ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: yang zab snying gi sgrub pa las: dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul gyi: gcig dril myur zab sgrub pa bzhag: 'di nyid yon tan chog mi shes: lha srin dbang bsdus dregs pa bran: rgyal bsen ar gtad klu bdud 'joms: 'go nad lhog yams mdze shu 'dul: byad dang mtshon cha'i gdug pa bzlog: bsgrub na blo la yod pas chog: mang du spel chos ma yin te: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: klu srin sa bdag 'byung po 'khrugs: mi rung sna dgu rims yams dar: rgya nad bdun drug 'tshubs pa'i tshe: de dag 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru: khro rgyal nā ga klu 'dul gyi: tshig nyung don 'brel byin rlabs che: drag sngags kun gyi mthar thug nyid: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: gza' dang lha bdud rgya 'di srungs: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang chen rta mchog rol pa nyi ma'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub zin/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /sngon chad ma rig pa'i sgrib pas mig ldongs shing ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ma mjal bar mtshon pa'i mig dar dmar po 'ching mdzod/ rig pa rang snang gi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten du kha dog lnga'i me tog gi chun po thogs par mos shig / mig dar me tog gtad/ slob dpon dbang chen rta mchog rol pa dngos su gsal ba la mos gus drag pos thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

kyaiḥ dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag gtso/ /bdag nyid chen po dbang gi bdag khyod ni brtse chen gar dbang che/ /bdag cag smin par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas snod rung du gzigs nas gnang ba stsal bar mos shig /ho/ dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di nyid du/ /'jug tu rung ba'i skyes bu ni/ /skal ldan brgya lam 'ga' zhig ste/ /dam tshig ldan na bdag gis bzung*/ bla ma dang dbang chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la dkon mchog rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ mkha' khyab kyi skye dgu thams cad dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed kyi dbang zab mo gsan la grol byed lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la blo bzhag bzhin pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ skyabs yul 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba gsum: sku gsum lhun grub ngang nas skyabs su mchi: gdod nas dag pa 'khor 'das sangs rgyas zhing : de don rtogs phyir bdag gis sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ thabs khyad par du gyur pa bsags sbyang yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon?por bsngo/ de nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bya dgos shing de'i dpang por rdo rje'i chu nan gyis sbyin pa yin pas don thugs la nges 'tshal/ dam chu sbyin la/ hūm̐/ ye shes rdo rje bskyed byed pa/ /'di ni nyams na dmyal ba'i chu/ /'di nyid nyams par ma gyur na/ /dam bsrungs dngos grub rnam gnyis 'thob/ badz+ra sa ma ti hūm̐/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god pa la khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad rnam par bcun te dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/

las bum gyi chu dang las sngags kyis bsang*/ shū n+ya tā 'i sngags kyis sbyang*/ oṃ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar khrag zhag pad nyi bam gyi gdan la khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa'i ngo bo lcags bsregs las grub rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa can rang sgra dang bcas pa gsal thob/ de nyid gnas 'gyur khro rgyal sku: nā ga klu 'dul mthing nag 'bar: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing khro: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil: rta dbu rigs gsum rta skad mtsher: dbu skra dmar ser thod skam brgyan: dar nag cod pan dug sbrul 'khyugs: g.yas gsum ral gri dbyug to khyung : g.yon gsum lcags kyu thod khrag sbrul: glang ko zhing lpags khyung gshog ldan: thod phreng rus rgyan stag gi sham: sgeg cing sbal sbrul lhu tshigs brgyan: klu gnyan sa bdag khri 'bum gdan: yum mchog phag mo klu 'dul mas: g.yas pas gri gug sbrul zhags 'dzin: g.yon pas bhan dmar sdig pa bsnams: khro bo'i spyi bor phag zhal ngur: rus rgyan gcer mos yab la 'khril: ba spu'i bu gar khyung gis gtams: me ri smug nag klong du gsal: de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs rgyud bskul de las kyang 'od zer gyi pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas/ dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams lha sngags phyag rgya 'od dang thig le'i rnam par kha ba dang bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim par mos shig /hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med drag po e yi klong : rngam brjid dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dbang chen khro rgyal lha tshogs gshegs su gsol:

gshegs nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa sa pa ri wā ra dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spos dang rol mo bcas pas byin dbab/ ye shes pa byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par gyur cig tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes rdo rje mgor bzhag /tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'du byas la/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis pa me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin snang ba la khyed rang rnams kyi tshe rabs nas 'brel ba'i rigs kyi lha la phog par gyur cig snyam pa'i mos pa dang tshig 'di'i rjes zlos bcas me tog 'dor bar zhu/ hoḥ yi dam lha ni thugs rje'i bdag /sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /puṣ+pe sid+dhi hoḥ zhes 'dor du gzhug go / ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal bar mos shig / gser thur gyis mig dar bsal la/ kyaiḥ ma rig 'khrul bas rab bsgribs pas/ /ye shes snang ba'i sgo bcad pa/ /ye shes 'char ba'i sgo nyid du/ /yang dag thabs dang ldan pas dbye/ oṃ tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces mig dar bsal/ ye shes dri ma dang bral ba thob nas dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du mjal bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub ste/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur yongs rdzogs zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ rigs kyi bdag nyid dbang chen sku: shin tu gsang ba'i dbang mchog nyid: rdo rje 'dzin gyis bdag la bskur: bka' dang dam la 'da' re kan: zhes zhus pas bka' yi gnang ba byin song snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dngos gzhi dbang la bum gsang sher ye tshig gi dbang bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum pa'i dbang*/ nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/

gsang ba skal ba ster bar byed pa rdzas dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las drag po'i bsgral dbang dang bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang gi slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ bum pa dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang du khro rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor dang bcas pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i bdud rtsi khyod rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'khor lo lnga po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ dbang chen yab yum gyi sku dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rnam bum thogs la/ hūm̐/ bum pa'i ngo bo chos kyi sku/ /bum pa rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs/ /bum chu thugs rje sprul pa'i sku/ /dbang chen sku yi dbang thob shog /oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes brjod/ de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas: bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan par gyur/ gnyis pa nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par/ gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyi khro tshogs grangs med 'phros pa khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas/ gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

gtso bo'i sku spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ dbang chen sku yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /rab 'jigs khros pa gar dgu'i bdag /sgyu ma chu zla bzhin du bsgom/ /gnyis med sku yi dbang thob shog /hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ de ltar phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ dpal gyi che rtags kyis mnga' gsol bar khams gsum gyi gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phyir dur khrod chas brgyad de/ gnas rnams su byugs pa'i rdzas gsum gyis mtshan pa/ sku'i stod smad la bgo ba'i gos gsum gyi na bza'/ mgul dang phyag zhabs la gdags pa'i rgyan gnyis kyis spras shing dbang bskur bas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rje bor bskur zhing dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpal stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la/ hūm̐: prog zhu cod pan khrag zhag tshom: seng glang zhing lpags thod pa'i phreng : rus rgyan sbrul chun stag sham gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na shrī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ngag gi nus pa ster bar byed pa la sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar/ sngags phreng g.yas bskor rang sgra bcas 'khor ba/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ mgrin pa'i lam brgyud de thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar 'khod cing g.yas bskor du 'ur ldir gyis 'khor ba las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros/

'gro ba'i las rgyud sbyangs/ tshur 'dus pas gsang sngags mtha' dag la dbang brnyes pa'i mos pas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ baṃ badz+ra wā rā hī nā ga nā tha hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ti ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug / de nyid brtan par byas song snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas sngags phreng thogs la/ hūm̐: rang byung grags stong snying po'i sgra: bzlas brjod bsnyen sgrub brtson par gyis: shes rab phreng ba'i dbang bskur ro: gsung rab yan lag dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar gsung gi dbang bskur bas ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa dag /grags stong dbyer med kyi bzlas brjod la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa de kho na nyid kyi dgongs pa ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas te/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med par nyams su myong bzhin du brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das pa'i bden gnyis zung 'jug lhag pa chos sku chen po'i dbyings su 'dzin med ngang du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ cung zad mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug / me long lag tu gtad pas ye shes de nyid mi nyams brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me long thogs la/ hūm̐/ de ltar bskyed bzlas bsgom pa'i rim/ /spros bral chos sku'i yo langs su/ /ma rtogs gzung 'dzin rgyun mi grol/ /bsgom med stong gsal dbang thob shog /dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/

bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ longs spyod dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni thabs shes dbyer med kyi gtor mchod phun sum tshogs pa lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba thugs rje thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod: gtor ma lte bar gtad de: hūm̐: bha liṃ drag po'i dngos grub mchog: yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i phyir: skal ldan khyod kyi lte bar btad: lhun grub brda yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar dngos grub yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang bskur ba la/ mngon spyod rtsom pa po rang nyid skad cig gis dbang chen rta mchog he ru ka gtum drag shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i sku lam gyis gsal zhing*/ rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas mngon spyod kyi las rtsom pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig / nya bo mdun du bkod cing*/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dbang chen rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas mdun du srid pa las kyi brub khung gi nang la dmigs bya'i dgra bgegs thams cad/ sha rul la sbrang ma 'tshub pa bzhin du rang dbang med par gzugs kyi liṅga la bstim zhing las byed pho nya rnams kyi bsgral ba'i las la sbyor ba'i mos pa mdzod cig

/hūm̐: mdun du gru gsum lcags khang du/ dmigs bya'i dgra bgegs myur du khug: sras mchog badz+ra kī la yas: bsgral zhing gtub pa'i dus la bab: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad: gsal ba gsum ldan gyi ngang du tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas dmigs pa'i 'ben la rdeg par zhu/ hūm̐/ dbang chen 'bar ba kī la yas/ /gzir ba tsam gyi rdul du brlag /btang na lha yang brlag par byed/ /dgra bgegs tsam la smos ci dgos/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa kī li kī la ya phaṭḥ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ phur pa 'dril zhing btab pa sogs byed du gzhug /gtub cing mchod pa ni/ de ltar bsgral ba'i phung khams kyi rnam pa sha khrag gi longs spyod la ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can 'di dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du phul bar mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes bdud rtsis bran zhing*/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: lhag med 'bul zhing dgyes par rol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: slar de dag gi nus pa brtan pa'i phyir rdo rje phur pa lag tu gtad par mos mdzod/ phur pa gtad la/ hūm̐/ 'jigs byed 'bar ba drag po'i lha/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /bdud sde log 'dren tshar gcod phyir/ /mngon spyod drag po'i dbang thob shog /oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī li kī la ya phaṭḥ de nas phrin las bzhi'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ dbang chen yab yum gyi phyag mtshan 'di gtad pa tsam gyis phrin las rab 'byams kyi las mtha' yongs su sdud pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas ral gri dang dbyug to khyung gsum g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐/ shes rab ral gris log rtog gcod/ /dbyug tos bgegs kyi mgo bo 'gems/ khyung gis klu gdon zas su za/

/nyon mongs bdud 'joms dbang thob shog /oṃ badz+ra khaḍ+ga hā ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de nas lcags kyu dang thod khrag sbrul zhags rnams g.yon du gtad la/ hūm̐/ g.yon gsum lcags kyu thod khrag sbrul/ /lcags kyus khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /thod khrag srid gsum 'khor ba stongs/ /sbrul zhags tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin/ /srid gsum zil gnon dbang thob shog /oṃ badz+ra mu tra bha la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ gri thod lag g.yas g.yon du gtad/ hūm̐/ gri gug 'khor ba'i skye 'chi gcod/ /thod khrag rtog med dbyings su rol/ /yum chen bka' rtags phyag mtshan 'dis/ /phrin las yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog /h+ya ghṛ wa dha ki nī mu dra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ āḥ de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bskyed pa ma hā yo ga spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /phyi nang snod bcud thams cad snang stong dag pa rab 'byams su spyod pa la dbang*/ 'dzin rtog sogs zhi ba'i las thams cad 'grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dag pa gnyis ldan sprul sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /de nas dbang gong ma gsum zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsang dbang gi ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ dpal chen he ru gar gyi bdag /bde chen mchog khyod de nyid stsol/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig nus pa'i dbang*/ /de nyid bdag la stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du langs te thal mo spyi bor bzhag /snying gar rdo rje phag mo nas 'bru tsam zhig gis drag tu 'khrab pa la sems ma yengs par gtod cig / bla mas thod rnga 'khrol zhing*/ hoḥ bu mchog las kyi rdo rje khyod/ /snying gar phag mo phra ba la/ /ma yengs rtse gcig de la gtod/ /bde bas lus kun khyab par ltos/ / zhes brjod/ bla ma dbang chen yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang chub kyi sems nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi lce la bzhag pas/

rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gyi gang bu kha bye ba lta bus gang ba rnams dwangs ma'i bde bas tshims/ gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig / bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/ hoḥ gsang ba'i dam tshig mchog chen po/ /bde ba'i rang bzhin dga' ba che/ /rtsa khams dag pa'i rang bzhin la/ /mchog gi dam rdzas bla med 'dis/ khyod ni bde bas mchog dam 'gyur/ /bde ba'i rang bzhin stong par ltos/ a ho su kha dharma mu dra ra sa ghu ya sa ma ya ho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi thog mar byin dbab pa'i slad du langs te thal mo spyi bor bzhag /snying gar rdo rje phag mo nas 'bru tsam zhig gis drag tu 'khrab pa la sems ma yengs par gtod cig / bla mas thod rnga 'khrol zhing*/ hoḥ bu mchog las kyi rdo rje khyod/ /snying gar phag mo phra ba la/ /ma yengs rtse gcig de la gtod/ /bde bas lus kun khyab par ltos/ rig tsaka gtad la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ma lag tu gtad pas slob ma yab yum rta mchog dang phag mor gsal ba lha'i 'du shes/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang mkha' gsang rdo rje pad+mar byin gyis brlabs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs lam zab mo 'di la bsten nas 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ de gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ 'dod chags bde ba chen po'i 'gros las shar ba'i 'khor lo bzhi ru yas bab dang mas brtan gyi rim pas dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba/ dga' bral bde stong chen po'i ngo bor ngos zungs shig /bde la ma chags bde ngos zung*/ /bde ba'i rang bzhin brjod mi shes/ /smra brjod bral ba chos kyi sku/ /stong pa nyid dang dbyer mi phyed/ /bu khyod 'di la sred zhen spongs/ /sred zhen spongs la bde stong skyongs/ /phyag rgya'i bha gar 'o byed cing dwangs ma lce yis blangs pas rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad bde bas tshims pa dang*/

yum gyis 'di skad brjod par mos shig /nga yi bha ga gsang chen 'di/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul te/ /bu khyod bde ba'i mchog 'dod na/ /'di las slar yang bde ba longs/ /zhes bskul ba la rjes su gus pas 'di skad brjod par mos la rjes zlos gyis/ rā ho3haṃ/ bde ba'i rang bzhin shes rab ma/ /stong dang snying rje dbyer mi phyed/ /pad+ma la ni lces len par/ /bdag gis gus pas cis mi len/ /zhes brjod cing slar yang pad+ma'i gting nas dwangs ma lces gzhibs te lus gnas khyab par bkram par mos shig /de nas bla mas phyag rgya'i srin lag g.yon nas bzung ste slob ma'i lag g.yas su gtad par gyur/ slar yang rig tsaka gtad la/ a hoḥ sangs rgyas kun bskyed bde ba'i lam/ /bud med mi spang dwang du longs/ /'di bral sngags kyi dam tshig nyams/ /de bas rigs ldan dang du longs/ / zhes brjod/ bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi rol du gzhug go /bzhi pa ni/ de nas don dam tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul bar mos la zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du slob bu'i snying gar yi ge a dkar po sran ma tsam ye shes lnga'i 'od 'phro ba'i stobs kyis lus nam mkha' la yod par mos shig / bla mas thod rnga 'khrol zhing*/ a ni skye ba med pa la/ /lus ni ye shes lnga yi lus/ /nam mkha'i klong nas 'od gsal 'bar/ /lus med nyams kyi rang zhal ltos/ / zhes brjod la nyams bskyed/ slob bu rnams lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ lta stangs dang rig pa nam mkhar gtod cig /bu khyod sems kyi ngo bo ltos/ /bltas pas mi mthong ngang la zhog khyod kyi rig pa shar phyogs sam/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su phya ler thong*/ /de bzhin lho nub byang du yang*/ khyod kyi sems ni thogs med thong*/ /btang tshe phyi nang 'gro 'ong med/ /'gro bar snyam yang rang gi sems/ /sems ni ngos bzung 'dzin pa bral/

/ngo bos stong la rang bzhin gsal/ /thugs rje'i 'char sgo ma 'gags gsal/ /de yi rang bzhin nang du ltos/ /smra bsam brjod med sa le ba/ /dper na gzhon nu'i bde ba bzhin/ /nges pa'i shes pa stong gsal 'di/ /bu khyod 'di yi rang zhal ltos/ /'di zhes mtshan mar ma grub kyang*/ /gsal rig stong pa sing bag can/ /de don rtogs la ngang du zhog /'di ni rig pa'i rtsal dbang yin/ /bu khyod 'di yi rjes skyong na/ /tshe gcig thar pa'i lam bgrod 'gyur/ / zhes dal bus brjod la snod bcud kyi rten 'brel 'dzoms na de'i don ngo 'phrod nges su bshad do/ /bzhi pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ de ltar na rim pa de dag rnams kyis bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig /rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul gyi smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa legs par grub pa yin pas/ rjes su dbang srog dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gis bsdus pa'i sa ma ya 'bum sde srog bzhin du bsrung ba dang*/ nyams pa sor chud pa'i skong bshags la 'bad pa sogs lung dang man ngag las/ ji skad bshad pa thams cad nan tan gyis slob cing nyams su blang ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ de nas dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa ltos med du bla ma la 'bul bar cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol/ dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams?

sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ yi dam yongs 'dus dbang chen rtam̐ mchom̐g dpal/ /dug gsum las gyur steng bar 'og gi gdon/ /nām̐ gam̐ klum̐ 'dum̐l gsaṃng sngaṃgs stobs 'dus dbam̐ng*/ /bstanaṃ 'dziṃn dam pa'i gzhung las gsal bar byas/ de dag ni so gsum pa gsung rigs dbang chen rta mchog rol pa nā ga klu 'dul gyi dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ rgyal kun thugs kyi ye shes dpal chen po/ /gsang ba'i bdag po drem̐gs pam̐ zim̐l gnom̐n gyi/ /rdo rje ye shes 'bebs byed dbam̐ng chom̐g gi /rim pa spyi yi 'gros bzhin 'di na dgod/ so bzhi pa thugs kyi rigs dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang chog la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba bsham bkod la/ mdun gyi stegs bu dar mthing kha'i khebs ldan gyi thog tu dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa kha rgyan mthing nag bum tsaka /bhan+dha/ rdo rje dril bu/ 'khor lo/ phyag mtshan rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri/ khyung kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags/ gtor ma sku 'bag khyung*/ gza'/ thun phur/ rdzas brgyad sogs dbang gi ca chas ma tshang ba med par 'du bya/ de nas sngon gtor/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ gsol kha/ sman raka gtor ma sogs bsham pa'i mdun du nyer spyod sna bdun gyi bskor bsham spyi mthun bzhin bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas brtsam brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed las gzhung bzhin btang la bstod pa'i mjug tu dzap khang dbye/ bsnyen sgrub ci nus mthar bum pa gnyis sgrub rjes dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod grub pa dang bum lha 'od zhu bya/

de nas bka' gter srung ma'i gsol kha rgyas bsdus dang*/ skong bshags nas tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar song nas slob ma mdun du bos te khrus bstsal pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus phyag byas te gral la 'khod/ de nas bgegs gtor h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab/ sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i? khyad par du bcom ldan 'das gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sogs kha bsgyur nas drag sngags spos rol dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas las rdor gyis me tog bkye bsdu bya zhing*/ slob dpon gyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ gsan bya'i chos kyi skabs su babs pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid/ sa bdag klu gnyan rnams 'dul ba'i don du phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung dang bcas pa'i sprul pa'i/ cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par snang bar mdzad nas/ nā ga bdud 'dul chen po'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig gi bdag nyid can du gsungs pa sprul pa'i sku dga' rab rdo rje la bka' babs shing*/ de nyid kyis rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi gzugs slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la gtad/ des rgyud don rnams dbang dang sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i man ngag tu bsdebs/

phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med par mdzad cing*/ khyad par bod yul mun pa'i gling du dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me/ 'phags yul gyi bstan pa rdzogs ldan gyi skabs bzhin gsal ba'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs par 'grigs nas/ gdams pa 'di nyid jo mo mtsho rgyal dang gnubs ban bud+dha dz+nyā na la gnang zhing*/ snyigs ma'i gdul dka' rnams kyi don du gter la sbas par mdzad/ de nas gdul bya dus la babs pa'i tshe gnubs kyi rnam 'phrul gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes lci'i smug po lha rtse'i brag nas/ gter srung chen po nā ga rak+sha'i gter rgya dngos su phul ba las byung ba'i/ dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dregs pa zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de la'ang rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub zin/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ byas la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / de nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas/ /kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum po/ /byang chub ma thob bar du ni/ /skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi/ /sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags/ /'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya snyam/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed cing*/

/gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad/ /don dam spros bral byang chub sems/ /rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ / zhes lan gsum/ tshogs bsags yan lag bcu pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags/ /gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang*/ /smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor/ /lhun gyis grub par bzhugs su gsol/ /snying po sems can don du bsngo/ /yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog / lan gsum/ khyad par du gsang sngags bla na med pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa bzung bar bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /nam yang bdag gis mi spang ngo*/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg gsum gyi/ /dam chos ma lus yongs su bzung*/ /sdom pa thams cad dang ldan pas/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyid/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ / zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ de dag ni phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ de nas nang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i slad du sbyor ba dam la bzhag pa ni/ bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'i dam tshig gi mna' chu 'di nyid bzhag pa lce la bzhag cing thim pa snying gi dkyil du thim ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig thob par mos shig /hoḥ nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi chen po 'di/ khyod kyi lce la bzhag pa yin/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig thub par srungs/ dam tshig khas len pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ dpal ldan chen po gsang ba'i bdag /bdag cag dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs dang yan lag gi /dam tshig ji ltar bstan pa bzhin/ /yengs pa med par sems kyis bsrung*/ /gsang bdag gral du bkod par 'tshal/ / zhes zhus/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag ste/ hūm̐/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu/ /gsang chen dam tshig ma nyams na/ /ye shes sems dpar gyur nas ni/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par byed/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig las 'das na/ /lcags kyi sdig par gyur nas ni/ /snying gi dkyil du rab zhugs nas/ /rdo rje'i dmyal bar sreg par byed/ /de bas bka' las ma 'da' srungs/ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du/ sa phyogs 'di nyid dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur pa'i nang du/ slob dpon nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i rnam par bzhugs pa la mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bla ma dus gsum gsang bdag sku/ /bdag cag bde ba'i lam bgrod cing*/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par 'tshal/ / zhes lan gsum/ de nas spro ba dri ba ni/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /nga yi gsang sngags rgyal po 'di/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang yin pas/ /rang gar 'jug pa mi gnang gis/ /dam tshig bsrung bar nus na sbyin/ zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon gsang ba'i bdag /dman chos yid phyung dad par ldan/ /thabs chen theg par 'jug par mos/ /dam tshig rang gi srog ltar bsrung*/ /gsang bdag thugs rjes gnang bar mdzod/ /ces zhus pas bka' yi gnang ba thob par mos shig /de nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du/

khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad bcings la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig / las sngags dang bum chus bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar/ klu rigs lnga bgegs dang dam sri kha sbubs su mnan pa'i steng du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ gdug pa can gyis nus mthu bcom/ rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus te slar thim pas yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams khro rgyal gsang ba'i bdag po zhal gsum rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ spyan dgu sdang mig tu bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ag tshom me ltar 'bar zhing dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu gtsug tu thugs kyi bya khyung gnam lcags kyi mchu sder dang me gshog can/ khro chu'i rwa dang zhal nas me 'bar ba/ shangs nas rlung 'tshubs pa/ spyan nas khrag khol ba/ sbrul rigs lnga bzung zhing za ba/ krang krang kring kring king king zhes stong gsum khengs pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ phyag drug g.yas gsum gyis rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon gsum gyis khyung khra kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ sku la dur khrod rol pa'i chas brgyad dang dpal gyi chas bcu rdzogs par spras pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa dang ba spu'i bu ga nas me 'bar ba/ sku che zhing yan lag rags pa 'jigs su rung ba/ rdo rje'i gad rgyangs ha ha hi hi sgrogs pas ri rab ldeg cing hūm̐ hūm̐ gi rkan sgra brdabs pas/ klu dang rgyal bsen sde brgyad thams cad 'bog cing brgyal ba/ bskal pa'i me dpung dmar nag rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs par mos/ de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas thugs las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/

'og min chos kyi dbyings dang lcang lo can gyi gnas nas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i/ lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byon nas/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dbus: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru?stsol: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags pa bzla zhing spos rol bya/ phebs pa na/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes mgor rdo rje rgya gram du bkod de brtan par bya/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma bla ma gsang ba'i bdag /sangs rgyas sku yi dbang rnams kun/ /bdag cag rnams la bskur du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas da dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ bum pa ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang du gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i/ lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas phung khams skye mched kyi dri ma bkrus/ lus gsang bdag gi sku dang dbyer med pa'i gzi brjid ldan par mos shig / bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ bum pa bzang po gzhal yas khang*/ /gsang bdag gtum po'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /bum pa sku yi dbang bskur bas/ /bu khyod lag na rdo rjer gyur/ /lha dbang lus la rdzogs gyur cig / rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ bum chu spyi bor blugs la khrus bya'o/ / des sku'i dbang thob/ lus lhar bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /bhan+dha rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du lha tshogs bde bar sbyor ba'i byang chub sems kyi rgyun lce la bzhag pas rtsa khams bde ba chen por smin/ dus sbyor 'pho ba'i dri ma bkrus/ ngag gsang bdag gi gsung dang dbyer med pa'i nus mthu 'bar bar mos shig

/ bhan+dha mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐/ bhan+dha chos dbyings dkyil 'khor na/ /dam rdzas gsang ba'i bdud rtsi sbyar/ /gsang ba'i ngag la nus dbang bskur/ /rtsa khams bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ /ngag la nus pa'i dbang thob shog / rtsa sngags sham bur/ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes ngag tu blud/ des gsung gi dbang thob/ ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ khyed rang rnams la thabs shes rdo rje dang dril bu/ zung 'jug hūm̐ yig ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyis mtshon nas rang rig gsal stong zung 'jug ye shes lnga'i ngo bor rtogs/ rtog tshogs brgyad khri bzhi stong dag /yid gsang bdag gi thugs dang dbyer med pa'i mkhyen rtogs kyi rtsal rdzogs par mos shig / rdo rje dang dril bu lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐/ ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje che/ /dril bu shes rab sgra chen sgrogs/ /skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ /thabs shes dbyer med dbang thob shog / rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes rdor dril snying gar bsnol du gzhug go /

des thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /bzhi pa yon tan rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba la/ 'khor lo 'di nyid gtad pa tsam gyis dug gsum gyi zug rngu las grol zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par mos mdzod/ de nas yon tan 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das gnyug ma'i shing rta ltar/ /'du tshan 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can/ /don rtogs gos sngon 'chang ba yis/ /de ring yon tan dbang bskur stsol/ rtsa sngags sham bur/ gu ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar yon tan rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas/ rtog tshogs nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag /gzhan don re ba yid bzhin du skong ba la dbang*/ yon tan pa mi zad brgyan gyi 'khor lo la dbang bsgyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas 'gro 'dul phrin las mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lor mnga' dbang sgyur bar mos shig / phyag mtshan rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri rnams g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'bar bas steng gdon gzhom/ /'khor los bar gdon thal bar brlag /ral gris zhing bcu'i dgra srog gcod/ /mi bsrun 'dul ba'i dbang thob shog /karma kro ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ khyung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags g.yon du gtad la/ hūm̐/ khyung chen 'og gdon klu srin za/ kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gsum g.yul ngo bzlog /sbrul zhags srid pa'i log 'dren 'ching*/ /phrin las drag po'i dbang thob shog /tsakra sarba pā shaṃ sarba duṣ+ṭān a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ des phrin las kyi dbang thob/ las rab 'byams bsgrub pa la dbang*/ rtag cing khyab pa'i phrin las dang ldan par 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gtor snod chos dbyings ye shes yangs pa'i pho brang chen por gtor ma gsang ba'i bdag po'i/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas par gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs las byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rgyun byung*/

khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum la thim pas dbang bzhi rtsal rdzogs su thob par mos shig / dpal gtor sku 'bag spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings 'bar ba'i bhan+dha ru/ /gtor ma ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /gsang bdag sku dang gnyis su med/ /skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ /'bras bu sku bzhi lhun grub par/ /dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ zhes gnas bzhir bzhag go / gtso 'khor gyi sku las rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig 'phros te khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs yongs rdzogs thob/ sngar las gzi brjid dang nus mthu lhag par 'bar ba'i mos pa mdzod/ khyung gi sku spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ dpal chen yang sprul klu gnyan gshed/ khro rgyal stobs 'chang ga ru ṭas/ /skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ba'i/ /rtsal chen phrin las dbang thob shog /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kro ta ga ru ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de nas gza' mchog gi sku thogs la/ hūm̐/ snang srid dbu ma'i zom du 'jug /stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal can/ /gza' mchog khyab 'jug chen po yis/ /bstan dgra tshar chod dbang thob shog /oṃ ra hu la kro ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de dag gis dbang gi dngos gzhi grub nas mtha' rten du/ thog mar thun rdzas lag tu gtad cing phur pa klad la bskor bas/ drag po mngon spyod gtso bor gyur pa'i phrin las rab 'byams la mnga' brnyes te gsang ba'i bdag po dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig / thun rdzas gtad/ thun phur klad la bskor du gzhug / hūm̐/ de ring nas ni gsang ba'i bdag /bu khyod ngo bo gcig tu gyur/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bka' gtad dbang*/ /rab 'byams bka' dbang thob par shog / rtsa sngags dang sde brgyad 'dul sngags kyi sham bur/ om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ khroṃ raṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ki kang hrīḥrā hu la ke sha ke ta hūm̐ dza dzaḥ

om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa he kro ta kā la sa ha tsakra lo hi tsakra ti tri tsakra ya gnod byed 'byung po byad ma rnams kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbad: om̐ kri ti ma tri baṃ bh+yo tsa tur mu kha ram̐ ha la ya: pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de ltar dpal phyag na rdo rje dregs pa zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i bya ba bsgrubs zin pa yin pas/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung sdom gyi 'dun pa drag pos 'di'i rjes mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ de ltar dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa ltos med du bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol/ dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams? sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ gsang ba'i bdag po gtum po che/ /drem̐gs pam̐ zim̐l gyis gnom̐n mdzad pa'i/ /dbam̐ng chom̐g gsaṃng sngaṃgs rigs mthun las/ /bstanaṃ pa mi nyams 'dziṃn phyir bsdebs/ de dag ni so bzhi pa thugs kyi rigs dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang chog gi le tshan no// // ༈ so lnga pa dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo'i gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i dbang chog ye shes me 'bar mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa phrin las me 'bar zhes bya ba/

'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyi chog khrigs bzhin skabs 'dir bya ba lags so// // ༈ gza' klu rgyal 'gong dam sri gdug pa'i gdon/ /ma lus kun 'joms gtum̐m pom̐ gos sngon can/ /nām̐ gam̐ ram̐k+sham̐ drag po khros pa'i tshul/ /bstan des dgos dbam̐ng zab gnad 'di na spro/ so drug pa gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i dgos dbang gi rim pa ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba bsham bkod la/ mdun gyi stegs bu dar mthing nag khebs ldan byas pa'i thog tu dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa kha rgyan mthing nag /bum tsaka /sngags phreng*/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ thod phreng rus rgyan/ dug mtsho/ phyag mtshan gri gug sbrul zhags/ khyung dang dug gi ri rab/ gdol pa pho mo dang thod rdzas/ gtor ma/ sku 'bag dang rdo rje/ de nas sngon gtor/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ gsol kha/ sman raka gtor ma sogs bsham pa'i mdun du nyer spyod sna bdun gyi bskor bsham spyi mthun bzhin bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas brtsam ste brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed las gzhung bzhin btang la bstod pa'i mjug tu dzap khang dbye/ bsnyen sgrub ci nus mthar bum pa gnyis sgrub rjes dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod grub pa dang bum lha 'od zhu bya/ de nas bdag dbang blang ba ni/ dbang rdzas rnams spyi bor blangs la/ hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi pho brang dbus: yang dag snying po'i don ston pa: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: 'byung po 'dul byed gtum pa po: che mchog gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: bum pa gzhal yas bdud rtsi lha: snying sngags pho brang rdo rje'i thugs: brda sogs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang : gnyis med dkyil 'khor gcig gi dbang : dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs stsal du gsol: ye shes chen po'i sku gsung thugs:

deng 'dir de ltar bdag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gnang ba zhu ba spyi ltar bya/ de nas bka' gter srung ma'i gsol kha rgyas bsdus dang*/ bskang bshags nas tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar song nas slob ma mdun du bos te khrus bstsal ba nas dbyung ba dang bgegs bskrad srung 'khor brtan por bsgom/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ chos bshad spyi dang bye brag gi mtshams sbyor la/ de'ang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs su byon pa gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya nyam thag pa rnams kyi don du rig 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ nā gardzu na/ pra bha hastī/ khrag 'thung nag po sogs las 'jam dpal klu 'dul/ rta mchog klu 'dul/ gtum po klu srin/ bya khyung klu 'dul/ klu bdud dug ri me 'bar la sogs pa'i rgyud dang man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan cing*/ bod du dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshe chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la grogs po klu'i dug zer gyis bsnyun mdze btab pa'i tshe/ nā ga rak+sha'i gsang rgyud rgya mtsho dug ri me 'bar gyi khong bcud gdams pa'i gnad btab pas rgyal po bsnyun las grol/ ma 'ongs snyigs dus yang mtha'i 'gro ba rnams gdug pa'i gdon gyis nyen pa la dgongs te/ ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad pa'i nā ga rak+sha'i gdams skor rgyas bsdus du ma mdzad nas gter gnas du mar sbas pa rnams/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug /chos rgyal rin chen gling pa sogs kyis spyan drangs shing 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ de dag las zab bcud gcig tu dril ba'i gtum chen nā ga rak+sha'i gdams skor 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus cung zad 'chad na/ ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mor/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje mi shigs pa rab tu 'bar ba'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe: ri de'i mdun du dza len spu rang sha bya ba'i chu mig nag po byang du kha gyu ba zhig yod de:

de'i shar phyogs su grong khyer chen po bdun yod pa las: grong khyer dbus ma der rgyal po ha ling sha bya ba mu stegs gi chos la dad pa zhig yod pa des: yul de'i phywa gyer ba'i tshe chu mig de'i gong gi shing bcad nas phywa rten la btsugs yon du khrag mchod: de'i tshe bā su ta bya ba'i klu de la phog thug song bas kho rab tu khros nas yul de la klu'i nad sna tshogs btang : khyad par mdze shu 'brum nag kre kre ho srin glang rgyug 'gyel sogs mang du mched pa'i grong khyer gcig tsam stong par gyur: khyad par du mu stegs kyi rgyal po de la mdze nad snying kun bya ba'i nad drag po thebs: de'i tshe mu stegs kyi ston pa gu na tri ra bya ba la phan pa'i thabs zhus: 'jig rten gyi lha la phywa gyer zhing gsol ba btab pas phan pa'i thabs ma byung nas 'chi ba la thug pa na: rgyal po yi mug cing mya ngan chen po shin tu mi bzad pa ri rab kyi dpangs yin yang zhig nus pa tsam du gyur: de'i tshe nang pa'i drang srong mo lha mo mngon shes can bya ba nags na gnas pa zhig yod pas srod kyi dus su lung bstan pa: he badz+ra pā ṇi satwaṃ: gsang sngags 'chang ba rdo rje'i sku: mi shigs rtag tu rgyal byed pa: klu dang sa bdag gzir ba yi: rig sngags 'chang ba'i nga ro sgrog: brtan dang g.yo ba ma lus kyi: sa rnams rab tu 'jigs byed can: me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: 'byung po log 'dren sngangs skrag byed: ma rig pa yi dpung tshogs 'joms: de la gus dang mos gyur na: klu yi gdug pa'i nad rnams sel: the tshom bral bar dwang du longs: khyed la phan par lung bstan no: zhes lung bstan pas mu stegs pa chos la mi mos kyang : gtum pos 'dul ba'i dus la bab pas: rgyal pos kyang gsol ba btab ste smre sngags kyi 'o dod bos: de'i tshe drang srong mo yis gsang ba'i bdag po la zhus te: kyai gsang ba'i bdag po chen po rig sngags kyi nus pa 'chang ba lags:

mu stegs kyi rgyal po klu'i nad kyis gzir ba 'di la phan pa'i thabs gsung du gsol: khyad par ma 'ongs pa'i dus su klu srin gyi kha rlangs dar ba la bcos thabs kyi man ngag bka' stsal du gsol: zhes zhus pas: hoḥ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro legs par nyon cig: mu stegs pa'i chos dang bstan pa phan dge'i rtsa lag thams cad 'di ltar du mchis pa yin pa la: 'jig rten pas lha klu'i dug mi bsal te: dper na klu kho rang yang 'jig rten gti mug gi rgyu las byung ba yin pas: ma rig pas ma rig pa bsal bar mi 'gyur te: zhing rdul brtsegs pa'i phung po la ri rab chen por gyur pa bzhin: nyon mongs pa la nyon mongs pa shin tu mched de 'phel ba ltar ro: dper na mu stegs kyi lta ba ni mngon zhen gyi chos can yin pasa'atshang mi rgya: chad lta had po can gyi mjug mar 'chang ba lta bu'o: nyon mongs pa ma rig pa'i rgyu bsags pa'i nad la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i sgo nas bskyed rdzogs gi don zab mo nyams su myong ba'i thabs dang : shes rab kyi rtsal rdzogs pa'i sdom pas gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag bdag gis bstan par bya ste: 'chang zhing yid du bsgoms nas rgyal po la bstan par gyis shig ces gsungs nas rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs drag sngags kyi yi ge bzhi po sham bu bcas gsungs pa rnams mkha' 'gro'i brda skad du rgyal po la bsgyur: rgyal po'ang rig sngags kyi tshig la dad pa thob nas bsgrubs pas zla ba bdun nas klu nad las grol: klu nag snying kun shin tu reng bar gyur: de'i tshe rgya gar gyi skad du badz+ra nā ga rak+sha be ṇ+ya: bod kyi skad du rdo rje srin po klu 'dul bya bar grags so: rgyal po yid rab tu ches te: gsang ba'i bdag po gdan drangs shing man ngag gab pa'i rgyud mang du zhus: nang pa'i bstan pa la zhugs: khyad par rgyal po des mnga' thang gi grong khyer thams cad nang pa'i bstan pa la btsud de gsang ba'i bdag po'i 'dul zhing du gyur:

de yi tshe gsang ba'i bdag po'i lha mo mngon shes can la gsungs pa rnams mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger btab nas: dbyings rang byung 'phrul gyi za ma tog tu sbas so: phyi mor bid+yot+ta ma la ru pra bha hastī la bka' bab ste gdan drangs: pra bha hastīs rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung la gnang ba pad+ma 'byung gnas las mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis zhus te: mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger btab nas rdo rje phur pa'i cha rkyen du bzhag pa'o: de lta bu'i bsgrub pa la 'jug cing dbang thob pa rnams la yon tan gyi mtshan nyid dpag par dka' ba yod pa ste: ci zhe na: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi: bka' yi bsdu ba gsang bdag gtum: dpa' bo lag na rdo rje 'chang : mtshan thos log 'dren kun kyang sngangs: lcang lo can nam srid rtse'i khyon: 'gengs shing ma lus zil gyis gnon: phra mo'i bgegs tshogs lta ci smos: de bas 'di nyid rab tu 'chang : zhes pas sgrub pa'i go cha bgyis pa rnams: gza' klu dang rgyal po'i gdon sogs gang la'ang 'di nyid sgrub pa gtso che ste: phan yon ni: gza' steng grib kha shol nag pos dbang po lkug pa rnams la dar dmar po la mdud pa gsum bgyis nas drag sngags kyis mnan nas btags pas steng gdon 'joms par 'gyur ro: dar mthing nag la mdud pa dgu byas nas nyer dgu la sngags nas btags pas bar gyi sde brgyad spyi'i byad khas mi tshugs par 'gyur ro: khyad par du klu nad mdze dmar gyi sna gzhom pa: mig bud pa: yan lag chad pa: khrag rnag gi rdzing 'khyil ba rnams la'ang bskyed rdzogs ldan pa'i ngang la zla ba bdun bsgrubs pas sel bar 'gyur ro: phra mo rnams ni dbang tsam zhus pas kyang sel lo: khyad par du 'di la rgyud don gsum yod pa ste: 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha bya ba ni slob dpon mañju shrī bsil ba tshal du bzhugs pa'i tshe tshong dpon gyi bu'i don du dgongs pa mdzad: rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul bya ba ni:

klu sog ma med nā gardzu nas gnam mtsho ka len dzar 'dul ba'i tshe dgongs pa mdzad: bya khyung nā ga klu'i rgyal po bā su tas klu yul du 'dul ba'i tshe dgongs pa mdzad: 'di nyid he ru ka gos sngon can bya ba'i ye shes kyi sprul rgyud dang mthun pa rdo rje ya rtse'i dgongs don dang 'brel ba ste 'di lta bu'i gdams pa dang 'phrad pa ni: skal ba'ang rab tu gyur pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes khyad chos yon tan du mas bsngags pa gtum po nā ga rak+sha zhes snyigs dus kyi gza' klu rgyal 'gong sogs 'dul ba'i gnyen po stobs kyi lha mchog man ngag zab khyad can 'di nyid gsang 'dzin ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis gu ru'i bka' bzhin zab mo gter du sbas par mdzad pa las/ dus phyis tshe lo nyi shu'i kha dar dang nye ba'i skabs/ 'don pa'i dus rtags rnams mngon du gyur pa'i tshe gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'am/ pad+ma gter bdag gling pa de nyid kyis mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi cha lag tu spyan drangs/ gsang rgya rten 'brel sogs mthar phyin par mdzad nas/ skal ldan chos bdag rnams la spel ba'i gdams zab 'di nyid kyi smin byed dbang gi rim par sgrub pa la bdag nyid kyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir bla med dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba stsol: de nas sngon 'gro skyabs sems sdom bzung rnams chabs cig tu sgrub pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bla ma lha dang dbyer med rdo rje 'chang*/ bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i ngang mdangs/ thugs rje'i rnam rol bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa/

dgongs klong zab gsal mchog tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ phyag 'tshal ba saugs bsags sbyang so so'i 'dun pa dang*/ phyi ltar so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang ltar gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom pa gsum dang bsags sbyang spel gsum cig car du nod de bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: phar phyin drug la bslab sdom bzung : ma bsgral bsgral zhing ma sgrol sgrol: dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god:

ces lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung*/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas khyod rang rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos shig /de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ gsang ba'i bdag po khro bo rje: dpal chen rdo rje gtum 'chang ba: bdag nyid dkyil 'khor la 'jug phyir: gtso bos bdag la dbang bskur stsol: zhes pa'i lan du slob dpon gyi ngag las gsan par khyab pa gda'/ kyaiḥ khyed rnams las sad skal bar ldan: bla med dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra dkon: snod ldan lags na dbang bskur 'tshal: de nas dam tshig spang blang gi rim pa las nam yang mi 'da' bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ snying po yang dag rdo rje che: gsang bdag gtum gyi dkyil 'khor la: gus par gyis dang 'jug stsal gyi: de bas dam srung sdom par gyis: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: sa ma ya ti tha na na ra kan: lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par gcun te dam tshig pa'i lha sku 'di bzhin gsal thob cig: oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang : swa bhā wa sa maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi dang mthun: hoḥ slob ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa chen po khyab brdal gyi ngang las ngad ldan khro chu rgya mtsho'i dbus su klu gdol pa pho mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i steng du: dug gi ri rab bang rim dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dang gnam lcags kyi rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid 'joms byed kyi khro bo nā ga rak+sha sku mdog mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad yod pa: g.yas pa dgus gri gug dang g.yon pa dgus sbrul zhags bsnams pa: thod skam gyis dbu la brgyan cing rus pa'i lan tshar drwa ba:

rus pa'i phreng ba spu gri dang chu gri'i sgro gshog dbyings su brgyangs shing : lte bar chu srin rngam pa'i zhal gdangs pa: sku smad dug sbrul nag po'i mjug ma 'khyil ba: sku la bya khyung gi tshwa tshwa 'phro bas steng 'og bar gsum gyi: sde brgyad 'byung po klu srin thams cad bsngangs yed yed byed pa ste drag tu khros pa'i rnam pa can no: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can nam rngam drag dpal la dgyes pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal 'byung po 'dul byed rdo rje me 'bar gyi lha tshogs rnams skad cig gis spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas spyan drangs pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min dbyings nas thugs dam bskyod pa'i lha: me ri 'bar ba'i gnas nas dgongs pa mdzad: snying rje khros pas ma rungs zil gyis gnon: theg pa rim dgu'i khro zhal rngam la bzhad: steng phyogs gdon tshogs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: bar gdon gzhom phyir sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs: gnas drug lam bzhi khebs pa'i rus rgyan la: thogs med mtshon cha drag po'i zar bu 'phyangs: snang srid 'byung po 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: g.yas dgu'i gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: g.yon dgu'i sbrul zhags ma rungs sde brgyad 'ching : thugs rjes mi gtong chu srin rngam zhal can: ma rig 'khrul ba gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: klu bdud 'joms mdzad sku smad sbrul mjug can: 'og gdon 'dul phyir ri rab gdan du 'khyil: gdol pa pho mo 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: ba spu'i dbyings nas bya khyung sprul pa 'gyed: za byed sku la me dpung tshwa tshwa 'phro: shin tu mi bzad klu srin 'byung po'i gshed: gsang bdag rdo rje srin po gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i phrin las bskul: oṃ badz+ra dha ra phe lam du ye dzaḥdza:

a be sha ya a āḥ de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra satwaṃ: spyi bor rdo rje bzhag / de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub bo/ /dngos gzhi la phyi phan par byed pa'i dbang dang*/ nang nus pa 'jug pa'i dbang*/ mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po bum dbang gis slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ bum pa dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang du khro rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i bdud rtsi khyod rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'khor lo lnga po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ste lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gtum chen gsang ba'i sku dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ bum pa ye shes gzhal yas khang : bum chu lha dang gnyis su med: bcud ni gsang bdag gtum po dngos: deng 'dir sku yi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster ba sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i/ thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas bskor rang sgra bcas 'khor ba slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon te/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ mgrin pa'i lam brgyud de thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar 'khod cing*/ g.yas bskor du 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros/

'gro ba'i las rgyud sbyangs/ tshur 'dus pas gsang sngags mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes pa'i mos pas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ sngags phreng bgrang la sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum du byar gzhug / de nyid brtan pa'i phyir gsung sngags phreng gi dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa ni/ hoḥ 'byin 'jug sgra rnams rdo rje'i gsung : snying po bgrang phyir ma pi ta: dpal chen tshangs dbyangs brgyud ldan phyir: de ring gsung gi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de ltar gsung sngags kyi dbang bskur bas ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa dag /grags stong dbyer med kyi bzlas brjod la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa de kho na nyid kyi dgongs pa ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas te/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med par nyams su myong bzhin du brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das pa'i bden gnyis zung 'jug lhag pa chos sku chen po'i dbyings su 'dzin med ngang du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ cung zad mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug / de nyid brtan par bya ba'i slad du thugs phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur zhing mi shigs pa'i rgyas gdab par mos mdzod/ de nas thugs rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ gdod nas skye med rdo rje'i thugs: 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes che: gsang bdag kun gyi yang snying phyir: de ring thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar thugs phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur bas yid tha mal du 'dzin pa dag /rig stong 'od gsal gyi t-ing 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/

/bzhi pa yon tan rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba la/ 'khor lo 'di nyid gtad pa tsam gyis dug gsum gyi zug rngu las grol zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs pa'i dbang thob par mos mdzod/ de nas yon tan 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das gnyug ma'i shing rta ltar: 'du tshan 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can: don rtogs gos sngon 'chang ba yis: de ring yon tan dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gu ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar yon tan rig 'dzin rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /gzhan don re ba yid bzhin du skong ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /lnga pa phrin las khams gsum yongs sgrol las kyi mtha' sdud rnams kyis dbang sbyin pa la/ thog mar dpal gyi chas rnams byin pas rgyal byed dpa' bo'i chas rtags yongs su rdzogs pas gdug pa can zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig /dug mtsho'i dbang bskur bas srid pa'i dug chen gzhom par gyur cig /phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa dang dgra bgegs ma rungs pa rnams tshar chod par gyur cig khyung gi dbang bskur bas klu gnyan gdug pa can zil gyis non par gyur cig /thod rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas gdon bgegs 'byung po rtsad nas chod par gyur cig de nas thod phreng dang rus rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin rdzas: phar phyin drug ldan rab rdzogs pa: kun tu rtog pa bshig byed pa: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: oṃ bhan+dha ku mud ka ri ṭa sa ma ye swā hā: de nas dug mtsho'i dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ srid pa'i khron pa dbyug pa'i dug: ma rig g.ya' dag bsal ba'i phyir: dpa' bo rdo rje srin po yis: de ring phrin las dbang bskur stsol: oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan gri gug sbrul zhags kyis dbang bskur ba ni:

hoḥ rdo rje'i mtshon chas nyon mongs gcod: ma rig nag khra mthar byed pa: rdo rje'i sdigs mdzub rnam pa can: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin: oṃ ka ra ti ka nā ga bhan+dha sa ma ya swā hā: khyung dang dug gi ri rab kyis dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ klu 'dul gnam lcags mchu sder can: myos byed dug gis ri rab 'joms: rtag tu de ltar bgyis pa'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin: oṃ ga ru ṭa hā la ma sa ma ye swā hā: de nas gdol pa pho mo dang thod rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ klu bdud nag po gzhom pa'i phyir: myos byed rig sngags nag po'i rdzas: ma rungs gdon la gdab byed 'di: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin: oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha nā ga rak+sha phe laṃ bhi na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pas/ che mchog he ru ka'i bdag nyid du che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba la/ gtor snod rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang du gtor ma nyid gtum chen nā ga rak+sha gtso bo'i chas yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba khyed rang gi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pas: sde brgyad dregs pa mi bsrun pa'i gnod 'tshe mtha' dag zhi zhing khyad par du klu gnyan sa bdag ma rungs pa'i mthong reg kha rlangs kyi dug la sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi: dbang bzhi rtsal rdzogs su thob: mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stan thog gcig tu thob par mos shig: rten gtor spyi bor bzhag / hūm̐: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki dam can chos srung tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs skal ldan slob bu la: dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thun dngos grub stsol:

sarba sa ma ya badz+ra ghan+dhe a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra a āḥ de nas byin rlabs bka' bsgo'i dbang bskur ba ni sku 'bag dang rdo rje thogs la: hoḥ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa: rdo rje gsang ba: rdo rje dgyes pa: rdo rje lhan skyes: rdo rje mi shigs pa: rdo rje yang dag: rdo rje snying po: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa: rdo rje dpa' bo: rdo rje gtum po: rdo rje khro bo: lag na rdo rje: gsang ba'i bdag po klu dang 'byung po 'dul byed: mkha' 'gro gsang ba: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rig 'dzin pra bha hastī: rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes/ chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa/ o rgyan rog rje gling pa/ thugs sras rig 'dzin rnam bzhi la sogs pa/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lha dbang lus la bskur bas skye 'chi dang bral bar gyur cig: sngags dbang ngag la bskur bas bgres rgud dang bral bar gyur cig: chos dbang sems la bskur bas bying rmugs dang bral bar gyur cig: tshig dbang don gyi ngo sprod pas dgag sgrub dang bral bar gyur cig: chas dbang lus la brgyan pas he ru ka'i don dang ldan par gyur cig: rdzas dbang lag tu gtad pas klu srin 'byung po thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cig: de ltar dbang bzhi don lnga'i phrin las dang yon tan rdzogs par gyur cig: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: de rnams kyis dbang gi bya ba grub nas bla ma dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis shis pa'i tshigs bcad dbyangs su len cing*/ me tog gi char rgyun sil mar bsnyil bas dbang don gyi ye shes brtan cing gong 'phel du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ye dharma dang*/ bkra shis brjod: hoḥ gsang ba'i bdag po nam mkha'i gos 'chang ba: log 'dren 'joms byed dpa' bo gar sgeg can:

rig sngags rdo rje cod pan rab g.yo ba: dpal chen he ru ka yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyis bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi cha lag gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i dbang bskur thob pa yin pas/ de'ang dbang srog 'dzin par byed pa dam tshig yin pas dam tshig gi gnad rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyis/ lan gsum/ dbang bskur zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzungs nas su/ /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i/ dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /rjes chog gzhung ltar bya'o/ /gtum po khros pa nām̐ gam̐ ram̐k+sham̐ yi/ /dgos dbam̐ng zab gnad gsaṃng ba chen po'i mdzod/ /sngaṃgs 'chang che ba'i nus mthu 'byin pa la/ /mkho phyir bstanaṃ pa 'dziṃn pa'i rgyan du longs/ de dag ni so drug pa gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i dgos dbang gi le tshan no// //

༈ yam̐ng dag mchog grub phum̐r pas bar chad sel/ /nyi zla gwam̐'um̐ kha sbyor rgyud dmam̐r nam̐g /sbrags sgrub 'di ko yang phur brgya rtsa'i phul/ /pad+ma'i thugs dam rjes 'jug dbam̐ng skal rmad/ so bdun pa bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring gnyis las/ 'di ni spros bcas dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba rngam klong rab tu 'bar ba'i smin byed dbang chog chu 'bab kyi lugs su bkod pa la sta dngos gnyis las/ dang po sta gon ni/ shin tu spros bcas ni sgrub chen dang sbrags pa ste/ sgrub khog ltar slob ma sta gon gyi skabs su sta gon byas la/ bsnyen grangs thems rjes bum gsang sogs dbang chen dkyus ltar bskur ba'i phyag srol bzhin deng sang lag len byed srol cher med la/ 'dir dbang rkyang gi khong du sgrub khog nang du bshad pa'i sta gon dang sgrub dbang rnams kyis 'thus par mdzad pa'i gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes bzhin 'chad par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la'ang sa chog dang sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ spyir sgrub gnas rnying pa'am ras bris lta bur ma byas kyang chog mod/ mdo tsam spros par mos na/ dkyil 'khor gang la bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus su tshom bu/ mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum gnyis nyer spyod lngas bskor/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar tshom bu bkod la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ skyabs sems lan gsum gsum/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi sgom pa bcas song nas/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid gzhal yas khang : e las rab 'jigs drag po'i pho brang dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi chos 'byung ti ra'i steng : rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag rngam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur pa bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan:

brkyang bskum zhabs kyis dam sri ru tra mnan: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gsang ye pang du 'khyud: gri thod mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: rus pa'i rgyan ldan bde chen rgyas par bsgom: yab yum sku la 'jigs byed me dpung 'khrigs: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dpa' bor gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ brgya tsam bzla/ mthar bdag bskyed nyer bsdus ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bsdu/ a a āḥ sa mnyam par bzhag / phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis lhar ldang*/ thog mar gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams nas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bka' brgyad dkar gtor ram spyi mthun ltar sa gzhi bslang ba ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngo/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag?kun 'grub mdzod/ / ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas gdab pa ni don dam pa'i sbyong ba'o/ /gtor ma phul rjes tshom bu bsdus la phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag nas

rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la y rtsa sngags phreng skor ram/ nyer gcig sogs sbrags pas sa bzung*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi ma da na dang sbyar ba stegs bur 'thor la chag chag gdab bo/ /de nas sta gon dngos la gsum las/ dang po lha dang bum pa sta gon chabs cig tu bshad na/ mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi snang brnyan sogs bkram pa'i mdun stegs khebs ldan steng*/ maṇ+ḍa lar dri'i thig le dbus dang*/ tshom bu lha grangs ltar bsnyen sgrub sngags kho na'i mthar sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes btags pa brjod bzhin du 'bru tshom gtso 'khor bye brag phyed par bkod pa'i rgyab phyogs su sman raka gtor ma mtha' bskor du phyi nang gi nyer spyod g.yas su bskor bar bshams te/ de nas bum pa rnams gu gul gyi dud pas bdug hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod la yungs dkar gyis brab/ bdud rtsi chos sman dang dri bzang bum rdzas so lnga rnams sbyar ba'i chu gtsang phyed ka kheng bar blugs/ rnam bum la mgul chings mthing ga dang*/ las bum la mgul chings ljang gu sgron/ kha rgyan gzung thag dang bcas pa 'du bya la tshom bu'i steng rkang gsum thog dgod/ gzhan yang sta gon gyi rdzas dang dbang gi ca chas rnams kyang stegs thog tu bkram/ hūm̐: ye nas tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: sogs mchod pa byin rlob nas brtsams te bstod pa'i bar btang la bsnyen sgrub kyi bzlas pa khyug tsam byas la rnam bum dang las bum sgrub la mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/ spros med skabs/ sgrub gzhi rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen po bla ma yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs dwangs ma'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar bkra lam gyis gsal btab la/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa'i mthar mchod bstod dang yan lag bdun pa'i tshogs bsags pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal? snyan gsan dbab pa ni/

spos dang thal mo sbyar la/ hoḥ ye nas gnyis med chos sku dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal 'bras bu so sor smin: de ldog phyir na rgyal ba'i dam mnos te: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: zhes pas nongs par bshags shing*/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba ni/ dril spos dang bcas/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dgongs: khyed rnams mchod dang slob ma la: phan phyir dkyil 'khor 'bri 'tshal na: thugs rjes dgongs te byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab bo/ /gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma phyi rol du bos la khrus nas dbyung ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus dang maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul khro bcu phra thabs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang*/
