mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐: snying rje'i sbyin yul ma rig bgegs kyi tshogs: rtog med de bzhin gtor mas tshims par dengs: ci ste mi 'gro zhen pas bcings srid na: rig pa rdo rje'i mtshon cha des choms shig: oṃ badz+ra bidh+wa dz+nyā na mā ra sarba bigh+nān tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ ham̐'u: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bdag: ye nas ma bcos gzhal yas khang : rang bzhin rlung lnga srung ba'i gur: so 'thab 'khrigs pas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra tra ya maṇ+ḍa la yaṃ pañca sarba badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ de nas slob dpon gyis zhwa chos dang bcas te/ lo rgyus brjod pa ni/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /de'ang thun mong theg pa'i lam la zhugs na bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par rtsol sgrub kyi yun 'gor bas/ de'i bar du ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dos drag pos mnar bar 'dug pas/ da res tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bras bu rdo rje theg par zhugs par bya'o/

/de'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sngon du ma song na mi rung ste/ rgyud gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /nyan la sogs par brtson pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la slob par bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ de'ang bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag ces pa gnyis med zung 'jug gam/ thabs shes kha sbyor te gnyis su med pa'i don yin/ slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i gter lung las/ sha 'ug stag sgor ma ning gter bcu sbas: zhes pa ma ning ni: yang dag rdzogs pa chen po: phur pa bdud bzhi g.yul rgyal: phur skyong dgra bgegs tshar gcod de: lha gcig la don gsum tshang pa ma ning gi mtshan nyid do: gu ru pad+mas yang le shod du dpal yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe bar chod kyi rnam pa byung bas rdo rje gdan nas rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba ltar/ phur pa'i glegs bam phebs pa tsam gyis bar chod kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshul/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: yang dag bde chen snying po bsgrubs pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: zhes bka' gter gyi lo rgyus rnams su rgya cher gsal ba ltar ro/ khyad par du sgrub skor 'di ga'i lo rgyus las/ rgya gar yul du dga' rab rdo rje nas pra bha hastī dang : pad+ma 'byung gnas la brgyud te ye shes mtsho rgyal la gtad: bal yul nas bal po ji la ji sa dang shākya de ma: ku la ku sa gnyis kyis brgyud pa bal po ba su dha ra la bka' gtad: bsam yas su rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge: gru gu e bag sha: ru gyong dar ma ra tsa: gnubs nam mkha'i snying po rnams nas khri srong lde'u btsan la lung phog:

phur pa'i rgyud la sa ya gcig dang 'bum tsho gsum yod: de'i nang nas byin rlabs che ba yang gsang phur gcig ma yin: brgyud pa nye lam du 'khod pa bal po ba su dha ra yin: thugs kyi bu bzhi'i nang nas che ba yin: de ltar gyur pa las yang phur 'di nyid sngon slob dpon chen po pra bha hastī la zhus pa dang : phyi mor slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra la yang phur sbrags ma bya ba'i gdams pa yod pa bod nas rgya gar du len du phyin pa'i rgyud bcas phyogs gcig tu dril ba ste: yang phur gwa'u dmar nag tu grags pa'o: de lta bu'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang : sngon byung gi rgyud bcas dpal gyi bsam yas su rgya bod dang mkha' 'gro gsang mdzod nas gdan drangs pa bcas gab pa mngon phyung gi rgyud do: de'i nang nas lhag pa khyad par du 'phags pa gnam lcags 'khyug mo zhes yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gong khug mar grags pa yin no/ /de lta bu sgrub pa'i phan yon yang jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas: e ma yang zab 'di nyid byin rlabs bcud du dril: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas lam: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu nor gyis phyug: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus phrin las 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus bar chod sel: phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i jo mo ngas: blo phugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di la bca': gdams pa sgrub thabs rin chen gter du sbas: rje yi bka' bzhin bdag gis slur blangs pa: ma ning gter bcu sbas pa'i gnas su 'os: bal bod mon kha phur pa bsten pa'i gnas: yang phur gcig dril gdams ngag zab mo'i chos: zhes gsungs pa bzhin byin rlabs de ldan gyi smin byed dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/ de ring gi skabs su sta gon gyi chos rnams bsgrub par bya ba yin la/

de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar/ de ring gi skabs lhag gnas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir yang phur dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i bka' yis gnang ba thob par mos mdzod/ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das/ yang dag rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la/ skyabs yul rgya mtsho'i bskor bar gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na moḥ dran rig ngo bo gcig la kun rdzogs pa'i: gdod nas lhun grub rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs: dbyer med sna tshogs zung 'jug sgyu ma'i ngang : kun nas klong yangs chen por skyabs su mchi: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pa'i/ smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ 'khor 'das chos rnams smra brjod blo las 'das: de don ma rtogs rmongs pa'i 'khrul gzugs rnams:

dran shes bag yod lam la dgod bya'i phyir: nges don rtogs pas mi dmigs sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar/ yan lag bdun pa'i don tshul bzhin yid la bya ba dang*/ ngag gis 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ de nas khyad par sngags kyi sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rdo rje gzhon nus zhe sdang gcod: ma spangs dam srung me long ngang : rin chen nor bus dga' chen ston:

ma spangs dam srung mnyam nyid ngang : pad+ma las 'dzin rab tu spyod: ma spangs dam srung sor rtogs ngang : rgya gram phyag rgyas mi btang bzung : ma spangs dam srung bya grub ngang : las rab dbang chen sdom bzung ngo : om̐ dharma sa ma ya sha ra ṇa tsit+ta hūm̐:

lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis nang mchod nas bdud rtsi bsres pa'i dam chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni rten 'brel ye shes chu: dam tshig can gyis ci ltar gnas: rgyun bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs rnyed: nyams dang ma bsrung dug chur 'gyur: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ na ra ya i dan+te sa ma ya: lan gsum 'thung la 'phro ma rgyab tu 'dor/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad bsrung phyir dpung skud sbyin pa ni: sngags 'dis gang mang byin rlabs bya: pho'i lag g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du 'dogs: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ mdud pa'i sngags ni: raṃ tri tri tsakra ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas sngags/ de'ang dpung skud sbyin pa la pho'i dpung pa g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du bcings la phyag mtshan rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi 'gyu lam gcod/ srung skud ye shes rigs lnga mtshon pas kha dog lnga ldan dang sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas gdab phyir rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor/ ba 'di nyid bcings pas phyi ltar rlung mkhris bad kan thams cad srung zhing nang ltar ma dag nyon mongs pa thams cad sbyangs/ gsang ba ltar dag pa ye shes kyi rtsa sgo bye/ 'bras bu sku gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: snying po brtan par 'gyur ba dang : dkyil 'khor 'jug la bgegs bral phyir: gsang ba sngags kyi rgya chings gdab: gnas par gyur cig badz+ra hoḥ om̐ bh+rūm̐ tsakra ye swā hā: zhes rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab/ rmi lam brtag phyir skye med yi ge āḥre gtad/ om̐ dang po skye med stong par āḥ bar du 'gags med gsal snang āḥ tha ma bde stong 'dzin med āḥ

rang sems dri med āḥdakar sgoms: om̐ a a āḥ snying gar gtad/ de nas gdan ku sha gtad pa ni/ om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa sogs kyis bsang : swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs kyis sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las dhī dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i ku sha sngo ljang rma bya'i mgrin mdog ltar 'jam la reg na bde ba/ slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs shing gsal ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur: dhīḥhūm̐: bdun tsam bzlas rjes/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa de nyid mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas zhing 'dir phebs skabs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor ba'i sngon du chu bo nai rañja ni'i nye 'gram ma gha dha'i shing la sku rgyab gtad cing rtswa mchog ku sha'i gdan la skyil krung bcas nas/ dran pa mngon sum du bzhag ste byang chub mchog tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa bzhin/ deng 'dir smin grol gyi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum smin par bya ba la rten 'brel zab mo'i rmi lam du legs nyes brtag pa'i rtswa ring ba'i rtse mo mdun du bstan nas sngas pa dang*/ thung ba gdan byas te seṅge nyal stabs kyis gnyid log la mgo bo dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su gtad cing rmi lam gang shar ba de sba gsang med par smra bar bya'o/ /hūm̐: sngon byon rig 'dzin 'phags pa yis: rtswa mchog la ni gdan byas shing : rten 'brel rmi lam brtags pa bzhin: khyod kyang legs pa'i brda de zungs: om̐ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na ā li kā li swā hā: de nas rten 'brel brtag pa ni: dkyil 'khor rigs lnga tshang ba zhig gi steng du skyer pa'i shing la mgo bo me tog dang rtsa ba phur bur bgyis pa'i so shing smon lam dang bcas nas dor te: de'ang slob dpon gyis so shing sbyin pa'i dus thal sbyar bar du blangs: rjes zlos kyi tshe mkha' dbyings phyag rgya zhes mthe bong lto sbyar ba'i bar so shing gi rtsa bar bzung nas sos 'cha' ba'i tshul dang*/

sor mo rnams thad kar brkyangs pa'i gung mos so shing gi rtse mo me tog dang ldan pa bzung : de lta bu'i phyag rgya'i bar gyi so shing cung zad sos 'cha' ba dang lhan cig tu dmigs pa so shing las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis khong pa'i nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin/ nag 'dur gyis phyir thon te dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thim song snyam pa dang*/ sngags lung 'bog pa'i āḥde ni sems nyid dbye ba med pa de nyid kyi rtse mo me tog 'dor yul gyi maṇ+ḍa lar gtad de dngos grub kyi mtshan ma gsal por ston cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hūm̐: bdag lus phung po rnam dag ljon: drwa bas brgyan par me tog shing : dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul dmigs nas: dor nas rten 'brel gang 'grub ston: om̐ mu la iṣ+ṭa puṣ+pe ye swā hā: zhes bden tshig dang bcas pas dor bas: dbus su babs na mchog gi dngos grub shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po/ mtshams bzhir thun mong gi dngos grub phran tsheg re thob pa'i ltas yin/ gal te dal gyi phyi rol du lhungs na ngan pas lan gsum du bskyar/ ma phog na shin tu ngan pas dbang gi snod du mi rung ba'i ltas yin pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la bshags pa dang dge ba rlabs chen bya/ ma byas na chos bsgrub pa la bar chad 'byung bas/ lhag par tshogs brgya sāts+tsha dar lcog sbyin pa sogs rgya cher 'bad dgos so: de nas spyi bor cod pan gyis brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dbang rtags phyir: sna lnga'i cod pan spyi bor brgyan: deng nas lha dang skal ba mnyam: rtag tu yi dam 'di zungs shig: om̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na ku mu ṭa dha ra satwaṃ: 'di'i don lnga ni/ dam chu khar blud pas dam tshig mi nyams pa'i khas len/ mna' tho rang chad kyi rnam dbye/ cod pan spyi bor brgyan pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang rtags/

dpung skud legs par 'dogs pa mi 'gyur ba'i rgya chings/ āḥsnying khar sgom pa sems mi 'khrul ba'i dam mdzer/ rtswa gdan 'og tu 'ding ba sgrub pa mthar ma phyin bar mi 'gul ba'i dam bca' ste sngon du 'gro ba'i gzer bu lnga'o/ / de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni/ thams cad kyis phyag rgya spyi bor thal mo sbyar la rdor sems sgom lung 'bog pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bdag nyid sgyu lus snang stong spyi bo'i steng : rig pa skye med dung mdog rdo rje sems: rdor dril bsnol zhing phyag rgya snyems mar 'khyud: skyil krung thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor: sngags phreng 'khor zhing 'od zhu bdag la thim: bdud rtsis lus khengs bag chags g.ya' bral bsgom: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas shing skong bshags sogs la 'bad pas bar chad sel zhing dbang gi snod rung du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / rmi lam bzang po'i ltas dang ngan ltas gang byung yang re dogs kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i lam 'khyer la slob pa gal che/ de dag gis bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i thog mar sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub zin te dngos gzhi ni sang nyin 'byung ba lags so/ /de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di? de dag gis sta gon gyi le tshan no// // ༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las spros bcas dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba rngam klong rab tu 'bar ba'i smin byed dbang chog gi dngos gzhi la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sbyor ba ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dbus su/ stegs bu mthing nag gi steng du/ phur pa'i dkyil 'khor ras bris dgram/ de'i steng du 'bru tshom lha grangs bkod pa'i khar/ rkang gsum thog tu rnam rgyal bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings mthing nag gis brgyan pa/

de'i thog tu ka pā lar bdud rtsi chos sman btab pa'i dza gad kyis dgang*/ de'i khar dar dmar brgyad ltebs kyis bkab cing me long sin+dhu ras chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar mūm̐ḥ zur bzhi ha ri ni sa bris pa man shel zur drug bcas dgod/ mdun rgyab gang bder gong gtor la/ gdan gru bzhi sum brtsegs kyi steng du phur so gyen du bslang*/ de'i steng du rtsibs bcu/ de'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ de'i steng du chos 'byung bsnol ma'i khar dpal gtor zur gsum rtse thon dpung gshog sna rdze byas la pad 'dab dang pad tshab bya'o/ /de nas phur srung bcu drug spungs gtor/ gter srung btsan rgod kyi gtor ma/ dbang gi bzlog gtor/ gzhan yang rang lugs rgyun gsol gyi gtor ma/ chad brtan bskul gsum dkar bgegs bcas mkho ba'i yo byad dang*/ de bzhin dbang gi yo chas a yig /dor ra/ cod pan/ bum tsaka che mchog /sgrub phur/ yang dag che mchog /phyag mtshan la zhi ba zhe gnyis/ khrag 'thung nga brgyad/ rdo rje gzhon nu/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan/ yum gyi phyag mtshan/ gsal byed rdo rje/ yang dag rdo rje/ yab yum phyag mtshan/ kī la sras bzhi/ khro bcu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi/ bka' gnyan nyer bzhi/ zhi ba'i rgyan chas/ drag po'i rgyan chas/ drag po'i las chas/ srog sngags hūm̐ bh+yo/ pad phreng*/ me long*/ mchod rten/ sman raka gtor gsum/ rdo rje rgya gram/ me long shel rdo/ rig tsaka /shel rdo/ srung 'khor/ bzlog 'khor/ hom khung*/ ral gri/ me hom/ hom gzar/ dkyil 'khor/ po ti/ dung dkar/ 'khor lo/ bkra shis rtags rdzas bcas dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rdzas mchod rdzas sogs ma tshang ba med par gzhung bzhin du 'du byas la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ skyes rabs gsol 'debs song nas/ las gzhung gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar song nas dzpa khang dbye zhing*/

bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum bsgrubs nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas kyi mthar rig pa'i me tog tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i gsol gdab rnams bya la dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ rang lugs gsol kha spyi dang bye brag phur srung bcu drug dang gter srung btsan rgod kyi gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ sta gon sngon du song ba'i slob ma rnams phyi rol du 'khod par ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du yang dag che mchog he ru ka /yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul khro bcu phra thabs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen rang byung he ru kaḥ nga yi bka' las bgegs tshogs 'da' ma byed: gtor ma khyer la rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: rtsal chen las kyi pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: me 'od mtshon cha drag po'i thog ser gyis: brdung zhing phye mar bcom par gdon mi za: de bas gnod byed 'byung po phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las khro bcu phra thabs 'phros: steng 'og phyogs bcur khengs shing mu mtha' khyab: mtshams gcod khro tshogs drag sngags 'u ru ru: gzi brjid me char tshwa tshwa si li li: glags lta bgegs srin 'byung po mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ sarba da ha a mu ka bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ slob dpon shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du bzhengs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i phyi nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ ye shes sgo ba dgongs su gsol: bla med yang gsang dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug pa'i phyir: rnam dag smon lam sgo phyes 'tshal: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir las can skal ldan ma gtogs pa skal med rnams kyis blta bar mi rung bas rigs dang skal ba 'dri ba 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/

hoḥ nged rnams 'bar ba drag po'i rigs: pho brang chen po'i sgo skyong ste: skal ldan srung zhing bdud rigs gzhom: de bas dam tshig bsnol nus sam: zhes dris pa'i lan du de lta bu'i slob ma snod kyi skyon dang ldan pa ma lags shing*/ rigs dang skal bar ldan pa yin pas thugs brtse bas dgongs nas 'jug par gnang ba zhu bas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ nged rnams skal ldan dam tshig can: yang dag dkyil 'khor gnyan dag la: dad mos gdung zhing 'dun lags pas: 'jug pa'i brda sgo legs phyes 'tshal: zhes zhus pas phyogs kyi sgo ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phyes pa la nang du 'jug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pas sgo dbye la nang du spro ba dang bcas 'jug pa la phyi 'brang gi bgegs rdo rje ging chen rnams kyis bskrad pa'i las mdzad par mos mdzod/ sgo drung du ging dkar nag gis rdo thun thogs te/ rngam stabs ha ha dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas te phyir 'brang gi 'byung po bskrad/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa khyed cag skal ldan na: bsgrub la mi dbang gnod byed bgegs: mthar zhing mtshams bcad phyir dengs shig: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ ging ka ra ging ka ra gnod byed thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha phaṭḥ

ces thun brdeg go /de nas nang du zhugs la gral du 'khod par/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i drung du thal mo me tog dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'jug pa'i phyir gnang ba zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: bla med yang gsang dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan bdag cag 'jug smin phyir: gtso bos deng 'dir bka' gnang stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la mkhyen brtse ye shes chen pos bka' yi gnang ba sbyin par bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal/ hoḥ 'di nyid ngo mtshar gsang ba'i mchog: yang phur sngags kyi dkyil 'khor te: shin tu bka' gnyan dam lci bas: yang dag nus na legs par bstan: zhes gsungs pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rmad byung dag pa rab 'byams la: bdag cag don ldan cis mi dad: nges don bsgom phyir srog ltar bzung : mi 'da' dam tshig ldan lags so: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag tu rdo rje thogs la dbye rgya dang bcas/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phye bar mos mdzod/ hūm̐: pho brang chen po ye shes dbyings: yang dag rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nyid: de ring khyed rnams 'jug pa'i phyir: rten 'brel brda yi sgo dbye'o: om̐ dz+nyā na pra be sha ya phaṭḥ yol ba bsal/ de nas ye shes lnga'i dar thag ring po'i sne mo slob ma rnams kyis bzung ste slob dpon gyis ye shes lnga'i lam la khrid cing nang du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: nga ni yang dag slob dpon nyid: deng phyin skal ldan khyed rnams kyang : rig pa rdo rje'i lam bstan phyir: dkyil 'khor 'di bzung nang du shog: om̐ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la dha ra hūm̐: zhes pas nang du khrid nas gral la 'khod: sngon chad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar dar dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i gdong g.yogs re bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/

tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wā ra ma ṇa ya hūm̐/ slad nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas phyag rten du u dum wā ra la sogs pa'i mchog gi me tog rnam pa lnga'i chun po yang zhing ma nyams pa re thogs par mos shig: om̐ puṣ+pe sid+dhi hūm̐: da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /de'ang thun mong theg pa'i lam la zhugs na bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par rtsol sgrub kyi yun 'gor bas/ de'i bar du ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dos drag pos mnar bar 'dug pas/ da res tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bras bu rdo rje theg par zhugs par bya'o/ /de'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sngon du ma song na mi rung ste/ rgyud gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /nyan la sogs par brtson pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la slob par bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug mi 'dzin pa lnga dang bcas pa spangs nas legs par gsan dgos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ zhes gsungs pa thugs nges dang*/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes/

chos nyams su len pa ni/ sman bsten na nad nye bar sel ba'i 'du shes te yang dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi dang ldan pa/ pha rol du phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dngos su mos gus dad pa ldan dang pas sgo gsum legs par bsdams te gzhan du ma yengs pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar rang re rnams yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu lon pa'i dpe brgya stong gis char yang mi phod pa/ shin tu rnyed par dka' la rnyed na don chen po dang ldan pa dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus rten bzang po zhig rnyed zin kyang*/ de kho nas mi chog ste phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos shig bsgrub dgos/ de'ang 'phral du ma sgrub tshe/ lar snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'tsho rkyen ni dkon zhing*/ 'chi rkyen ni mang bas/ nam 'chi cha med 'chi rkyen nges med yin pa ma tshad tha na de ring dang sang nyin tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ 'chi ba'i tshe gnyen nye 'brel grogs dga' mdza' thob go sa nor longs spyod sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang ste/ las dkar nag 'ba' zhig rjes su 'brang bas bde sdug gi 'bras bu mi bslu bar myong dgos/ de'i tshe da lta dge ba ma sgrub par khyer rgyu ni med/ sdig pa mi 'dod kyang 'dor du ni mi btub/ de bas da lta nyid nas blang dor phyin ci ma log pa zhig sgrub pa gal che/ las nyon gzhan dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das shing*/ des na pha ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs rnam grol gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos rnam dag cig sgrub dgos/ de'ang bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje can de nyid kyis gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa'i bag la nyal gyi rim pa dang*/ mthun par chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad bsdus na/

theg pa dman pa dang theg pa chen po gnyis su 'du la/ de'ang nyan rang theg pas dngos su lam dang 'bras bu thar pa cha shas tsam las rnam grol gyi lam rdzogs par ma bstan cing*/ rang 'bras mthar phyin thob nas kyang*/ gzod theg chen la 'jug dgos pas lam dman la theg chen ni theg dman las khyad par chen po bdun gyis 'phags tshul/ mgon po byams pas/ dmigs pa chen po nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub gnyis dag pa dang*/ /ye shes brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang*/ /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*/ /yang dag grub pa chen po dang*/ /sangs rgyas phrin las chen po dang*/ /chen po 'di dag dang ldan phyir/ /'di ni theg chen zhes byar brjod/ ces gsungs pas/ dmigs pa chen pos chos nyid nam mkha' dang 'dra ba la dmigs pa/ sgrub pa chen pos rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don sgrub pa/ ye shes chen po bdag 'dzin gnyis ka stong pa'i chos nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes/ brtson 'grus chen pos bskal pa grangs med par sems can don la brtson pa/ thabs mkhas chen po srid zhi'i mtha' gang la mi gnas pa/ grub pa chen po stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan tshad med pa/ phrin las chen po 'khor ba ji srid bar gzhan don lhun grub tu 'byung ba bcas thabs bdun gyis khyad par 'phags pa'i theg chen ni lam gyi mchog yin/ de la'ang gnyis te/ gal po las/ mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas rgyu ru shes/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas nyid du shes/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gang yin pa/ /phyogs kyis rab tu shes par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu lam du byed pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa rdo rje theg pa gnyis/ spyir bsgrub bya byang chub thob par 'dod pa don gcig kyang*/ sgrub byed thabs kyi sgo nas khyad par che ste/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/

/thabs mang dka' ba med pa yi/ /dbang po rnon pos rkyen byas te/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ zhes 'jug sgo dbang sogs thabs la ma rmongs pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'bad med du sgrub par byed pas thabs mang po/ dka' ba mang po spyad mi dgos par 'bras bu mngon du byed pas thabs sla ba/ dbang po rnon po'i dbang du byas te gsungs pas snga ma las khyad 'phags kyi chos du ma ldan pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la'ang rgya gar 'phags yul du de lta'i dbye ba med mod/ gangs can gyi yul 'dir lo tsā bas 'gyur snga phyi la brten nas sngags gsar rnying gnyis su btags pa las/ 'di ni phyi 'gyur rdo rje theg pa gsar ma las spyan 'dren pa po yon bdag /phyag bzhes gtsug lag khang*/ zhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta/ sgyur byed lo tsā/ zhu rten me tog /bsgyur bya'i chos kyi khyad par te/ khyad chos drug ldan gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ de la'ang*/ ring brgyud bka' ma nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang gi chos sde gsum du yod pa las/ da lam 'dir bka' ma las bka' bab lung bstan/ smon lam dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya ste/ khyad par gyi brgyud pa gsum dang*/ gtso bo brgyud thag nye zhing*/ gter yig gi dpe dpang mnga' bas khungs btsun pa/ gang la gang 'dul gyi dus dang mtshon par mngon par snang ba'i zab lam nub pa med pa khyad par du 'phags pa zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa yin de'i zab khyad kyang*/ o rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi bka' yi thang yig tu/ shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug snying po rnams: spyir ni bod khams gsar dad che ba dang : snyigs ma'i 'gro la phal cher snying brtse bas: dbus mtha' thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag: las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab: ma 'ongs dus su rtog ge tha snyad mkhan: sgom chen la sogs phyogs dang ris dregs can: rang che 'byin zhing gter la rtsod na yang :

snyigs ma'i chos byed phal cher gter gyis 'dren: zab la kha tshang ma 'grib mtha' rgyas shing : gdams pa sna res gang zag grol bar nges: de bas las sad skal ldan sbyang pa can: 'chi ba dran rnams gter chos nyams su longs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob bo rje 'bangs grogs/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag ni dus bab zab gter la rag las pa yin/ de lta bu'i zab gter rnams gu ru yab yum gyis phyi ma'i bstan 'gro'i btsas su dgongs nas/ gangs can gyi ri brag mtsho gsum nam mkha' bar snang thams cad du ting 'dzin mi shigs pa'i rgyas btab ste/ ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter srung rnams la gnyer kha gtad cing*/ dus la bab tshe chos bdag bu la sprod ces smon lam dang bcas sbas par mdzad la/ de nyid spyan 'dren po'ang sngon gyi chos rgyal lo paṇa sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i 'phags chen rnams/ gang 'dul sprul pa'i gter ston brgya rtsa sogs byon par mdzad pa las/ 'di ni gu ru'i thugs sras snying gi bu dgu zhes/ 'phags yul gyi grub chen rig 'dzin brgyad dang tha mi dad par sgrub sde brgyad kyi bka' bab bu dgu'i nang tshan/ 'jam dpal sku'i bka' bab dang*/ khyad par du mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa'i shing rta chen po/ gangs ljongs sngags 'chang phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar gsal zhing*/ grub gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa/ grub pa'i rtags dang rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur zhing nyi zla gdan du bting ba dang*/ brag la phur pa 'debs pa/ sdigs mdzub gtad pa tsam gyis sra mkhregs brag gi ri bo'ang rdul phran du bshig nus pa sogs/ mdor na bdud rje glang dar ma'ang rje 'di'i nus mthus zil gyis mnan pas/ mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa gos dkar lcang lo'i sde dang bcas par glags blta bar ma nus pas mtshon/

bstan pa 'dzin srung spel ba la bka' drin che zhing*/ sku tshe'ang mnga' bdag khri srong nas rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi bar mi lo sum brgya ma zin tsam du bzhugs pas mtshon/ nus pa'i mthu/ rnam bzhi'i las/ 'chi med tshe sogs thun mong gi grub pa dang*/ thun min sku tshe de ny-id la theg mchog snying po'i lam mthar son zhing*/ mthar sku mi snang bar 'od lus su gshegs pa de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar sprul pa'i gter chen gtsug lag dpal dge /dum rgya zhang khrom/ dri med kun dga' sogs gter ston rkyang pa bdun dang gzhan du ma byon par gter lung rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ gnubs chen khyod 'di nas skye ba bcu bdun pa'i mtshams su/ ming gnam lcags las grub pa ma nges par rlung ltar rgyu ba zhig 'byung ngo zhes gsal ba las phyi ma 'di ni/ o rgyan gling pa'i gter lung las/ de nyid mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'og tu: chos log khrims ral dam nyams lung pa 'geng : lha mi'i gnas su grags pa'i gtam ngan khyab: sha 'ug stag sgor sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas byung : u rgyan gter bdag gling pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes dang*/ lung byang chen mor/ da lta'i dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes khyod: skye ba 'phrul med mdo khams phyogs su 'byung : rgyal khams rngam sgra nag po yul gyi ming : bya nag gshog rdeb gcan gzan ngar ba'i rong : rtsi shing mdung rtse gzengs pa lta bu'i tshal: yab yum gshed gzhi zhe sdang lo 'dzin pa: shes rab blo ldan zab gsang las sad pa'i: lus la brda rtags sha mtshan ri mo ni: drag po'i rtags rgya spyi gtsug me ris brgyan: rgyud smin dbang rtags so zho tshe bum ldan: stong nyid don ldan snying khar sme bas brgyan: tshigs rnams pad+ma brda ni shes rab ldan: gsang bar hūm̐ mthing karma las 'brel gling : mi 'gyur rtags ldan sku lnga'i chos la dbang : ma nges brtul zhugs smyon pa lta bur spyod:

phyogs med 'gro don rgyal khams rlung bzhin rgyu: ti sgro g.ya' lung brag gsum nas bzung ste: rong chen lnga yi zab gter rtags bdun dbang : bka' gsang shog dril bdun cu don lnga 'di: dbang bzhi blang zhing phab nas yang gter sbos: zhes gsungs la/ de lta bu'i bka' gsang zab mo gter gyi ring lugs la dbye na dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu/ shar gter 'dril ba sdong po lta bu/ lho gter gyes pa yal ga lta bu/ nub gter gsal ba me tog lta bu/ byang gter smin pa 'bras bu lta bur gsungs pa las/ da lam 'di ni zug pa rtsa ba lta bu'i dbus gter gyi khongs su gtogs pa yin/ de la'ang phyi gter nang gter gsang gter yang gter ma ning gi gter kha la sogs pa gter rigs bco brgyad du grags pa las 'di ni ma ning gi gter khongs su gtogs tshul yang*/ sha 'ug stag sgor ma neng gter kha sbas/ zhes au rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas bod khams phan bdai'i rtsa lag dam par rdo rje lung gis bsngags pa rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'am/ pad+ma gter bdag gling pa sogs mtshan dgu dang ldan pa de nyid/ gu ru yab yum gnubs chen sogs kyis rjes su bzung shing grub pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ snang ba thams cad sgyu mar shar bas snang srid 'dod rgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes/ chos skyong rnams bran du khol zhing*/ ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag ces bya ba 'byin pa'i dus rtags lung bstan mngon du gyur ba'i skabs/ mi min ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol mas gsang ba'i las rgya mdzad cing*/ chu rta sngon po rlung gshog can gyi chibs 'phangs su drangs nas/ mig 'phrul bzhin shwa 'ug stag sgor 'byor ba dang gter srung btsan rgod chen pos sa g.yo ri 'gul stong gsum g.yo ba'i 'ur sgra dang bcas/

shog ser las phur dam rdzas dang bcas zab gter du bzhes pa'i chos sde yin la/ bsgrub bya'i lha yi tshul yang*/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: yang dag bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: zhes gsal ba ltar/ gu ru nyid bal yul yang le shod du dpal yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe bar chad kyi rnam pa byung bas/ bal mo ji la ji sa dang ku la ku sa gnyis rgya gar du gser phye bre bdun dang bcas brdzangs pas/ bid+yot+ta ma'i rgyud 'bum sde las phur pa'i glegs bam mi khur gnyis tsam dang*/ khyad par du hūm̐ ka ra'i yang phur gong khug ma nyi zla kha sbyor 'di nyid phebs pa tsam gyis bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshul/ bka' gter gyi lo rgyus rnams su gsal ba ltar gu ru pad+ma nyid kyis kyang thugs dam lhag pa'i lha 'di kho na yin la zhal gsung las/ dngos grub che ba yang dag dang*/ bdud dang bar chod 'dul ba ni rdo rje phur pa las lhag pa med par gsungs nas/ yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa mdzad par yongs su grags kyang da bar sa steng du dngos su thon pa ni nyung bar snang ngo*/ /de'ang gter gzhung las/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag bya ba ste: bla med ces pa ni: theg pa thams cad kyi gong ma yin pa'i bla med do: yang phur ces pa yang dag pa'i lta ba ma nor zhing khong du chud pa'i rdzong chen te: nyi ma'i snying po ltar grags shing rang bzhin gyi don thams cad gcig tu bsgril ba'o: phur pa bya ba ni: yang dag ye shes rol pa'i sgrub khog gis bar chod bsal phyir phur pa sku gsum skye med kī la yar grags pa'o: gwa'u dmar nag ces pa ni: rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa yin pa'i thabs shes tsam du mtshon pa'o: sbas pa'i yul sha 'ug stag sgo dgos pa ni: sha 'ug stag sgor ma ning gter kha sbas: zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan no: ma ning zhes pa ni:

yang dag rdzogs pa chen po: phur pa bdud bzhi g.yul rgyal: phur skyong dgra bgegs tshar gcod de: lha gcig la don gsum tshang ba ma ning gi mtshan nyid do: de'ang rdo rje phur pa'i bla brgyud ltar na: brgyud pa gsum ste: rgya gar yul du dga' rab rdo rje nas pra bha hastī dang : pad+ma 'byung gnas la brgyud te ye shes mtsho rgyal la gtad: bal yul nas bal po ji la ji sa dang shākya de ma: ku la ku sa gnyis kyis brgyud pa bal po ba su dha ra la bka' gtad: bsam yas su rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge: gru gu e bag sha: ru gyong dar ma ra tsa: gnubs nam mkha'i snying po rnams nas khri srong lde'u btsan la lung phog: phur pa'i rgyud la sa ya gcig dang 'bum tsho gsum yod: de'i nang nas byin rlabs che ba yang gsang phur gcig ma yin: brgyud pa nye lam du 'khod pa bal po ba su dha ra yin: thugs kyi bu bzhi'i nang nas che ba yin: de ltar du gyur pa las yang phur 'di nyid sngon slob dpon chen po pra bha hastī la zhus pa dang : phyi mor slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra la yang phur sbrags ma bya ba'i gdams pa yod pa bod nas rgya gar du len du phyin pa'i rgyud bcas phyogs gcig tu dril ba ste: yang phur gwa'u dmar nag tu grags pa'o: sa ma ya: e ma dbyings yangs pa chen po skye med kī la sgrog pa'i zhing khams bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa ru dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas yang dag bzhugs so: gnas de dang nye bar: lha'i dbang po rin chen 'phrul snang bya ba'i dad dpon chen po zhig bzhugs pa la: lha min rgyal po tri sha ta bya ba'i gdug rtsub che ba zhig yod pas: lha'i dbang po la dmag drangs te the tshom pa'i tshe lha'i dbang pos: dpal gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed la gsol ba btab pas: mdun gyi nam mkha' nas lag na rdo rjes lung bstan te: lha'i dbang po shin tu bred par mi bya'o: byang shar mtshams kyi kha che he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du:

mchod rten shrī prañja bya ba'i mgul du bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rab tu rgyal ba'i yang phur sbrags ma'i gdams pa yod de: de dag 'byin pas lha min gyi g.yul pham par 'gyur ro: zhes bka' bstsal to: rin chen 'phrul snang de ltar 'byin pas mchod rten de'i bum pa'i nang du: gnam lcags las grub pa'i gter sgrom sdig pa ra tsa mgo dgu'i rnam pa can zhig yod pa gdan drangs: de'i nang nas yang phur bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i drag sngags chig brgyud yod pa de bklags pas lha ma yin gyi dmag rnams rab tu pham par gyur: de'i rgyud dang gdams pa rnams rlung gi gsal byed kyis sgam bur bcug nas lha'i yul du sbas so: lha bu de tshe 'phos nas 'dzam gling du slob dpon pra bha hastī bya ba bla med kyi don la mkhas par gyur: de'ang pra bha hastī bya ba lta ba'am dri med 'od zer du grags pa de nyid: yul bi twa ta ma la zhes pa'i rig pa'i ye shes klong las rang bzhin du khyab pa'i gnas su byon: rig 'dzin rdo rje chos dang mjal te rdzogs pa chen po'i nam mkha' klong yangs kyi rgyud rnams gsan: mchog gi rig 'dzin brnyes: 'og min du byon: dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po dang mjal: a ti mtha' bral gyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur: me ri 'bar bar byon te rdo rje sems dpa' dang mjal: phyi rgyud rdo rje yang rtse'i rgyud rnams rdzogs par mdzad: ma la yar byon nas dga' rab rdo rje dang mjal: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i phyi rgyud gsan: bi twa ta ma la ru mchog dang thun mong thams cad skad cig gis rdzogs par gyur: de'i dus su phyi pa mu stegs dang nang pa sangs rgyas pa gnyis 'khrug pa'i tshe: mu stegs nag po 'phur shes bya ba'am zhang zhung rlung 'khor bya ba ru yod pa kho khros te: nam mkha' nas thog char phab: de'i tshe pra bha hastī rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te mu stegs kyi sde thams cad pham par brlags pa dang :

khyad par du gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa dngos su byon te slob dpon dang dbyer med du gyur: de'i tshe kī li kī la ya gnam lcags kyi phur bu sor brgyad pa zhig mkha' nas byung ste mdun du babs te: slob dpon gyis rtsol med kyi phyag gis 'dzin nas gsor thabs kyis gdeng bas mu stegs kyi dmag rnams dran med du 'gyel bar gyur: stong pa'i rang sgra las: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sgras bskul te yang phur gnam lcags thog mda' ru grags so: gnam lcags thog mda' yi rgyud de nyid la phur pa spa ma gong khug ces bya ste: spa ma ni mu stegs pa'i yul de'i ming ngo : gong khug bya ba ni gzhan phal mo che la ma spel zhing dar tshon sna lngas dril te gong ba'i nang du 'chang ba'i gong khug ces bya'o: gdams pa de dang 'brel ba'i rgyud rnams phyi mor rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin bi twa ta ma la ru byon: dus de'i tshe rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud thams cad rdzogs par thugs nyams kyis bzhes: phyi mo'i dus su bal yul yang le shod du phebs skabs: bal po thams cad kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams kyis cho 'phrul bstan: lo gsum du bkra mi shis pa'i ltas sna tshogs byung : de'i tshe bal po'i rgyal po ji la ji sa dang : bal mo ku la ku sa gnyis rgya gar du gser bre bdun dang bcas nas brdzangs: rgya gar gser brag bya skyib tu slob dpon hūm̐ chen ka ra'i spyan sngar du bslebs: sngar bzhin gyi lo rgyus zhus pas hūm̐ ka ra'i phur pa gnam lcags 'khyug mo zhes yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub skor shog dril gcig la tshang ba gzhan mi khur tsam bcas bskur: slob dpon pad+ma'i phyag tu phul bas dgongs pa shin tu dgyes: yang le shod du sgrub pa mdzad pas zhag bdun gyis yi dam gyi zhal gzigs:

de'i tshe sku lus la phur pa rnam gsum gyi go cha bzhes shing bdud dang dam sri thams cad dam la btags: khyad par klu gyong po sna: bar snang glog ma sprin gnod sbyin rgod ma kha bcas mtha' ru spyugs: de'i tshe bal yul du thams cad bkra shis pa'i ltas sna tshogs pa byung : khyad par btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs shing dpal bsam yas su gsang sngags rdo rje phur pas sa 'dul mdzad pas bsam yas grub: de'i tshe yang phur yid bzhin nor bu ba'am: phur pa yon tan phun tshogs su grags pa'o: de lta bu'i rgyud yang phur bi twa ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud la: ye shes snying po phur pa pha'i rgyud: dam pa gsang chen phur pa ma'i rgyud: kī la ya bcu gnyis phur pa sras kyi

gnyis ka'i rgyud: rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud: sangs rgyas rtse mo'i rgyud: rnal 'byor rtse mo'i rgyud: gzhan yang yan lag gi rgyud la: zlog phur bcu gnyis kyi rgyud: phrin las rnam bzhi'i rgyud: srung ma bcu gnyis kyi rgyud: rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga: snying po'i rgyud gsum: yan lag gi rgyud bcu: lo ma'i rgyud bzhi: me tog gi rgyud bcu: 'bras bu'i rgyud bzhi: ma tshang ba kha bskang ba'i rgyud do: de lta bu'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang : sngon byung gi rgyud bcas dpal bsam yas su rgya bod dang mkha' 'gro gsang mdzod nas gdan drangs pa bcas gab pa mngon phyung gi rgyud do: de'i nang nas lhag pas khyad par du 'phags pa gnam lcags 'khyug mo zhes yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gong khug mar grags pa ste: 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa nye zhing byin rlabs dang 'brel ba'i khungs bstan pa ste: jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas: e ma yang zab 'di nyid byin rlabs bcud du dril: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas lam: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu nor gyis phyug: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus phrin las 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus bar chod sel: phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i jo mo ngas: blo phugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di la bca': gdams pa sgrub thabs rin chen gter du sbas: rje yi bka' bzhin bdag gis glur blangs pa: ma ning gter bcu sbas pa'i gnas su 'os: bal bod mon kha phur pa bsten pa'i gnas: yang phur gcig dril gdams ngag zab mo'i chos: ma 'ongs 'di 'byin rjes 'brangs grogs lnga 'byung : sa rtags mtha' bzhi'i so kha mngon du mtshungs: dus rtags ru bzhi chu ltar khol bar byed: gdul zhing 'gro don rong chen bzhi la 'byung : bka' yi chos bdag nyi shu rtsa lngar spel: gnubs ston mthu chen yid la de ltar zhog: zhal gdams thams cad mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhir ltos:

man ngag phal cher lung byang gong ma yin: gdams ngag them med rgyud byang so sor yod: yang mtha'i don du rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum 'byung : rgyas par lta ba klong yangs nam mkha'i mdzod: 'bring po don rdzogs bye brag lde mig gnad: gcig sgril yang phur sbrags ma 'di kho na: de phyir kho mo bdag gis legs par gdams: sa ma ya: da lam dpal chen yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor du/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la/ de lta bu'i dbang de ji ltar bskur na/ klong gsal las/ skyabs 'gro thun mong nas brtsams te: dbang bzhi yongs su bskur bar bya: zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor du/ dbang skur zab mo sgrub par bgyi ba la'ang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las/ da lam dngos gzhi dbang bskur bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad gsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs bdag nyid kyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ zhes thun mong gi maṇ+ḍal spyi dang khyad par gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba 'di'i don yid la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ hoḥ bdag lus phung po phyi snod ri rab gling : nang bcud dbang po dge rtsa ci bsags tshogs: blos blangs rtse gcig yid kyis 'bul lags na: bdag gzhan tshogs bsags 'bras bu don ldan shog: om̐ i pa gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/

slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas/ thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir yang phur dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka' yi gnang ba thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad par/ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na moḥ dran rig ngo bo gcig la kun rdzogs pa'i: gdod nas lhun grub rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs: dbyer med sna tshogs zung 'jug sgyu ma'i ngang : kun nas klong yangs chen por skyabs su mchi: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ 'khor 'das chos rnams smra brjod blo las 'das: de don ma rtogs rmongs pa'i 'khrul gzugs rnams: dran shes bag yod lam la 'god bya'i phyir: nges don rtogs pas mi dmigs sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/

rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ dus gsum?chen por bsngo/ slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan dpal chen zhi khro dang*/ /bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ de nas khyad par sngags kyi sdom pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rdo rje gzhon nus zhe sdang gcod: ma spangs dam srung me long ngang : rin chen nor bus dga' chen ston: ma spangs dam srung mnyam nyid ngang : pad+ma las 'dzin rab tu spyod: ma spangs dam srung sor rtogs ngang : rgya gram phyag rgyas mi btang bzung : ma spangs dam srung bya grub ngang : las rab dbang chen sdom bzung ngo : om̐ dharma sa ma ya sha ra ṇa tsit+ta hūm̐: lan gsum/ dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni 'da' ka rdo rje'i chu: mos 'thung dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'grub: nyams na na raka chen por ltung : bsrungs pas dngos grub kun thob gyur: khyed rnams kyis kyang don de las mi 'da' bar bgyi'o snyam pas bro bor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/

dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis bsang sbyangs la/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas par mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams gang du gnas pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten/ e chos dbyings lhun grub kyi pho brang chen po/ de'i dbus su rdo rje'i brag dmar pad nyi ro'i gdan la/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen yang dag he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag dbu nyer gcig: phyag zhe gnyis kyis zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan pa: zhabs bco brgyad dor stabs kyis sa bcu gnon pa: de'i pang du yum dbyings phyug kro ti shwa ri dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad ma rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khril cing yab yum gyi sku las bskal pa'i me ri 'bar ba: gtso bo'i thugs kar 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag: dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: g.yas dgus rdo rje gri gug ral gri dbyug to dgra satwa tho ba beng dang gsal shing 'dzin pa'o: g.yon dgus me dpung bhan+dha lcags sgrog zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ sog le 'dzin pa'o: phyag gi mtha' gnyis kyis ri rab phur pa bsgril zhing dur khrod chas brgyad zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum dor stabs can: yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs zhal gsum phyag drug ma ste: g.yas gsum gyis rdo rje rin chen ral gri: g.yon gsum gyis tshe bum bhan+dha dung dmar bsnams nas yab la 'khril ba: yab kyi thugs kar gsal byed rdo rje: de'i thugs kar yang dag rdo rje sems dpa' yi ge gsum du gsal ba'o: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bzhir khro chen bzhi: steng 'og phyogs bcur khro bo yab yum bcu:

mtshams su phur 'debs nyi shu: phyi rol tu dbang phyug nyer brgyad: ging chen pho mo bco brgyad dang sgo srung skyong ma la sogs pa: zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor snang srid thams cad rdul ltar 'khrigs pa gsal thob/ de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa ste de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog ste thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dang*/ khyad par du gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod dang phyogs bcu khro bo'i zhing khams nas dpal yang dag dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu/ zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha tshogs ma lus pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang bar spyan drangs/ de'ang sku che ba rnams ri rab tsam/ chung ba rnams yungs 'bru tsam/ bar pa rnams rang gi lus kyi bong tshad tsam/ snang srid thams cad yom yom shig shig tu g.yo zhing dus mtha'i rlung dang*/ 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra/ gnam lcags kyi thog rgod tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs drag dang bcas byon te/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la sib sib thim pas sku che la yan lag rags pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin ltar 'bar bas snang srid kun na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i sku mngon sum du grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la byin dbab kyi rdzas bsregs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa la: ye shes rdo rje phur pa'i lha: mi 'gyur dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya āḥ de ltar dam tshig sprul sku'i lha dang ye shes longs sku'i lha tshogs dbyings rig zab gsal gyi chos skur dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid brtan par bya phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/ me tog 'dor ba'i tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'du bya ste/ sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid khyed rang dang tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i rigs kyi lha gang yin pa la phog par shog cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dor bar zhu/ kyaiḥ bdag gis tshe rabs 'di bar du: sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi: lhag pa'i yi dam lha de dang : rang rang smon lam ldan par sprod: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes me tog dor bas gang du babs pa'i rigs mthun gsang mtshan gyi ming 'dogs so: hoḥ khyod ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas rdo rje'i 'od zer zhes kun tu snang ba ru sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: zhes ming nas smros pa'i tshe lan thob cig: de nas phur pa gtad pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rang bzhin las: phrin las kun 'grub gsang phur spro: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: 'chang zhing dam tshig srog ltar srungs: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya kī la ya hūm̐: de nas slob ma rnams kyis mig dbye ba'i ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ ma rig tshogs gzhom ye shes spyan: theg chen sa mkhan sman pa'i rgyal: khyed nyid zang thal slob dpon te: bdag gi rab rib mun sel stsol: slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer gser gyi thur ma ltar 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal bar mos shig

/ slob dpon gyis gser thur thogs la: hoḥ bdag nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ngang : mi g.yo ting 'dzin zer chen gyi: rig pa'i gnas lugs thur ma yis: ma rig ka dag dbyings su bsal: om̐ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas rim bzhin mig dar rnams bsal: rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po sngon chad bdag gis ma mthong ba'i mthong ba bstan pa dang*/ don ngo sprod par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor rlabs po che: ngo mtshar yang dag che 'di nyid: sngon chad bdag gis ma mthong bas: don ston ngo sprod gsung du gsol: zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ slob dpon gyis/ de ltar glo bur gyi sgrib pa bsal nas rnam dag ye shes kyi mig thob pas bla med yang dag ye shes rol pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ kyaiḥ khyed rnams skal ldan las 'phro can: deng 'dir bla med dkyil 'khor bstan: zab pa'i man ngag 'di 'dra dkon: yang dag ngo mtshar che 'di zungs: om̐ dharma gu h+ya badz+ra tsakra satwaṃ: slob mas: hoḥ bla ma la ni sangs rgyas lta: man ngag ye shes lnga ru myong : spyod 'gros sna tshogs chos su mos: dam tshig snying ltar brtse lags so: bla mas:

hoḥ ngo mtshar don ldan dal 'byor gyi: las can rigs kyi skal ldan sras: de ring dkyil 'khor bka' rtags 'bog: zab pa'i dbang mchog stsal bgyid do: de nas slob ma bde chen gyi lam la 'khrid pa ni: slob dpon gyis phyag shing thogs la/ hoḥ 'di don gshis lugs ma rtogs na: ngo sprad brtse ba'i yid kyis zungs: 'di ni klong dgu gcig tu 'dus: rang byung pho brang chain por shar: om̐ swa bhā badz+ra dharma hūm̐: hoḥ bla med yang gsang snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di: mdor bsdus te ngo sprad pa la: thog mar pho brang 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin du chags pa ni: rang lus gdod nas ye shes lnga'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i brda: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan tog mtshan nyid rdzogs pa ni: chos sku brdal khyab lhun grub yin pa'i brda: phyi nang sgrib med du gsal zhing bkrag mdangs ldan pa ni: longs sku zang thal 'gags med yin pa'i brda: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar nyi zla'i gdan rnams rim par brtsegs pa ni: srid pa rdo rje gzhon nu yon tan du mas brgyan cing gdod nas brtan pa'i brda: de dbus hūm̐ yig gnas gyur te yang dag he ru ka mthing nag tu bzhugs pa ni: chos sku sgyu ma lta bu'i rang rtsal ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzhugs pa ni: byang sems snying rjes bskyed pa'i dpa' bo'i thig le de rang rtsal ḍāk+ki'i rtsa'i sbubs su rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du rdzogs pa ni: longs sku sna tshogs thabs kyis cho 'phrul so sor ston te 'gro ba 'dren pa'i brda: rdo rje'i sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas kyis spras te zhabs bco brgyad dor stabs su bzhugs pa ni: sprul sku'i thugs rje'i nus pa'i gzi byin phyogs dang ris bral zhing bgrod 'gyu med par sa lam rdzogs pa'i brda: thugs kar dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dpa' bo'i cha lugs dang ldan pa ni:

ting 'dzin mi g.yo rdo rje'i ngo bo 'bad stsol dang bral zhing yon tan kun rdzogs yin pa'i brda: thugs kar sems dpa' gsum dang ldan pa ni: sku gsum sku lnga rang rtsal nyid las grub pa'i brda: dbu dgu ni theg pa rim pa dgu: phyag bco brgyad ni grol lam bco brgyad: zhabs brgyad ni yul dang yul can rnam par dag pa: yum dang sbyor ba ni bskyed rdzogs lung bzhi sde snod spyi'i theg pa zung 'jug yin pa'i brda: 'khor du sprul pa'i khro bo phra thabs yang sprul sna tshogs kyis bskor ba ni: chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid med kyang snang tshul du ngo bo grangs las 'das pa'i byed las ston pa'i brda: zhi ba'i lha 'dzum pa ni thugs rje'i mdangs: khro bo'i lha gtum pa ni snying rje'i gar: rgyas pa'i lha sgeg pa ni rol pa'i gyad: dbang gi lha chags pa ni bde stong gi shugs: ma nges pa'i lha ci rigs su 'dod pa ni: so so'i 'khrul 'khor te ci yang bsgyur ba'o: de'i phyi rol kyi dkyil 'khor la che ba dgu'i rgyan dang ldan pa ni: brgyud pa mtho la chos dar rgya che zhing nyi zla dang nam mkha' ltar khyab pa'i brda: gser g.yu la sogs rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pa ni: phyi 'byung rten 'brel legs tshogs du mas brgyan cing dgos 'dod mchog gi dngos grub zad pa med par nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du stsol ba'i brda: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor bag dro zhing gzi 'od mdangs dang ldan pa ni: thugs ye shes kyi dgongs pas 'gro la gzigs shing nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i brda'o: de ltar brda don rtags gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor/ nang rdo rje phung po lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzhan gdod nas bzhugs pa'i gnas yul gyi dkyil 'khor gsum/ rang rig bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rtsal dang rol pa nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du skad cig 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i rang zhal rang rig 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes de nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces de dag gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub ste dngos gzhi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes thun mong gi maṇ+ḍal spyi dang khyad par gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba 'di'i don yid la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon dang : yang gsang bla med lha tshogs la: bdag lus dge rtsa maṇ+ḍal 'bul: dngos grub snying po'i don chen stsol: om̐ i pa gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de/ ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: chos sku bla ma dbyings nas gshegs: āḥ rtog med longs sku gdan la bzhugs: oṃ: gnyis med sprul skur phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ zung 'jug bla med mchod pa 'bul: hoḥ bdag gis tshe rabs sdig sgrib bshags: trāṃ: dbang bskur chos 'khor bskor du gsol: de nas dngos gzhi khyad par gyi dbang ni/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa dang smad las dgra bgegs bsgral ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ seṅge rtsal rdzogs las/ dbang la rnam pa bzhi yod de/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*/ /de bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyi sprul sku bum pa'i dbang*/ nang longs sku rlung gi dbang*/ gsang ba chos sku thig le'i dbang*/ de kho na nyid rig rtsal brda'i dbang dang bzhi las/ dang po la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum dbang*/ nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba skal ba ster bar byed pa rdzas dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang dang bzhi las/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/

nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du khrag 'thung khro rgyal yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pa/ rim bzhin mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang gnas sogs rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar nas/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: me long ye shes bum pa ru: snang stong bla med bdud rtsis bkang : dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang nyon mongs pa lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa de la/ sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing*/ bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs du ma dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal paur mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyed dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'dor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gnyis pa nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/

thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa la de ltar yin pa'i nges shes bskyed cing*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos su mos pa bskyed la/ gsang chen khro bo rol ba'i dur khrod sogs zhing rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam pas gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyi khro tshogs grangs med par 'phros pa khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dag gi sku thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen yang dag he ru kar: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog rdzogs: kro ti shwa ri yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kro ti shwa ri a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas gsal byed g.yas kyi phyag mtshan zhi ba bzhi bcu thogs la: hūm̐: dbyings rig ka dag ngo bo nyid: rab 'byams zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: dpal chen phyag gi dkyil 'khor te: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ ā li kā li dz+nyā na pañca sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: g.yon gyi phyag mtshan 'bar ba lnga bcu thogs la: hūm̐: zang thal longs sku'i cho 'phrul nyid: khrag 'thung 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: dpal chen phyag gi dkyil 'khor te: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra he ru ka kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rdzogs: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: phyag mtshan g.yas pa thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje gri gug ral gri dang : dbyug to dgra satwa gnam lcags tho: beng dang lcags kyi gsal shing bcas:

g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dbang bskur ro: om̐ ka ra dha ha na ā yur dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: g.yon gyi phyag mtshan thogs la: hūm̐: me dpung bhan+dha lcags kyu dang : lcags sgrog tsit+ta zhags pa nag: kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gi sog le bcas: g.yon gyi phyag mtshan dbang bskur ro: om̐ ka ra ba me ā yur dha dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas yum gyi phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje bhan+dha bco brgyad dang : rdo rje rin chen ral gri rno: tshe bum bhan+dha dung dmar bcas: khro mo'i phyag mtshan dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra ka ra dha ha na ba me ā yur dha dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas gsal byed rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje 'bar ba gsal byed pa: mi g.yo rdo rje rgyal po che: rdo rje bla med he ru kaḥ sbyor yum dang bcas dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra rid+dhi dh+riṣ+ṭa pradz+nyā tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas yang dag rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje dgyes pa dga' ba che: dang po kun kyang rdo rje'i gzhi: rdo rje sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ sam+bha badz+ra dz+nyā na hūm̐ bh+yoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas yab yum gyi phyag mtshan thams cad thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje be con 'khor lo dang : bhan+dha par bu dung chen dmar: gri thod la sogs phyag mtshan bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ ka ra dha ha na ba me ā yur dha dha ra sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas kī la ya rigs bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra: las bzhi'i rtsal las shar ba'i sku: khrag 'thung yab yum kī la bzhis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra karma kī la ya tsa tur hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas khro bo bcu thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: stobs bcus rol rtsal 'gyed pa yi: khro bcu yab yum phra thabs bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro:

om̐ kro ta kro ti tsa tur dā sha hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo bh+yo: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: rang bzhin gnas yul skyong mdzad ma: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu brgyad: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ ma hā iṣ+ṭa shwa ri ma kau rī aṣ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sgo skyong ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: phrin las bzhi yi las byed ma: rngam pa'i sgo skyong chen mo bzhis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ dā dra bā la ma tri tsa tur a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rdo rje phur pa'i bka' nyan nyer bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: las kyi mtha' skyong shan pa'i gzugs: phur 'debs 'bar ba nyer bzhi yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kro ta kro ti kī la ya sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas zhi ba yongs rdzogs kyi rgyan spyod thogs la/ de nas chas dbang bskur ba la zhi drag gnyis yod pa las/ dang po khyed rang rnams gdan gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba la/ che rtags kyi mnga' gsol bas sku lnga dang ye shes lngar lhun gyis grub/ sa lam thogs med du bgrod cing gang 'dul longs spyod rdzogs pa'i phrin las 'dod rgu'i dpal la longs spyod/ don gnyis lhun grub khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal srid la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang dam pa thob par mos shig / de nas zhi ba'i rgyan thogs te: hūm̐: prog zhu dar dpyangs cod pan dang : stod g.yogs dang ni rin chen rgyan: ga shal rus rgyan ang rag sogs: zhi ba'i chas kyis dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra rat+na ar+bha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gnyis pa phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa ye shes lha'i sgyu 'phrul che mchog rdo rje gzhon nu drag po'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ dpal chen po'i che rtags kyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du brgyan pas/

ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rje bor bskur te dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas/ 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpal stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ drag po'i chas kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: dbu rgyan thal tshom khrag zhag thig: zhing glang seng lpags mgo phreng dang : sbrul chun stag sham rus pa'i rgyan: drag po'i chas kyi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ar+bha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: 'di'i mtshams su bka' brgyad kyi dbang ngam gang rung nas dur khrod chas brgyad kyi dbang rgyas par bskur/ de nas gtor ma gtad la: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā rar: mchod pa'i rmad byung ba liṃ rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: dus mchod skong bshags las mtha' zungs: om̐ bha ling+ta sarba pū dza dha ra hūm̐: de nas las chas kyi rdzas gtad de: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa rak+sha'i phreng : thun snod zhwa nag gos nag dang : rus rgyan me long phag rgod mche: dmod pa'i chas dag 'dzin par gyis: om̐ maṇ+ḍal sarba karma tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /

zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar/ nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing ga'i mthar dbyangs dang sngags phreng g.yas bskor du rang sgra dang bcas 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba las/ mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du sngags phreng bar ma chad par 'phros te 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces ru rak+sha'i bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis gzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis dbyangs gsal dang bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kī li kī la ya sarba maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas nam mkhas gar khyab tu theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos sgra bsgrags shing*/ 'gro ba'i las rgyud sbyangs te 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas stong gsal brjod med rang byung ye shes kyi ngang la gnas pa ni/ chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don ston pa sogs phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du 'grub pa'i gsung gi mdzod klong rdol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas srog yig thogs la: hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo bh+yo skye med sgra: rang byung snying po dbyings las shar: dran rig 'od gsal 'dus ma byas: srog yig snying pos dbang bskur ro: om̐ tsit+ta li ṣi ti hri dha ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma'i phreng ba thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes chen po'i rlung sgra las: shes rab 'gyu 'ong 'khril shing can: gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dga' bzhi mos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu h+ya dz+nyā na pra mo ti maṇ+ḍa dha ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar gsung sngags phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/

bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying por longs spyod cing dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bar/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag stai rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bo me long g.ya' dang bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin/ dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i slad du me long la brten nas ngo sprod pa ni/ hūm̐: ma ni skye med kun gzhi klong : bu ni gsal ba'i rig pa nyid: zung 'jug snang stong 'ja' lus ngang : gzhon nu bum sku'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ rū pa swa bhā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gnam lcags kyi mchod rten thogs la: hūm̐: mchod rten chos dbyings ye shes ngang : ka dag gsal stong zang thal nyid: dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ longs spyod dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur bar gtor mchod phun sum tshogs pa lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba thugs rje thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod:

gtso gtor thogs la/ hūm̐: gtor ma mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : bcud ni bde stong bla med rdzas: dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra gu na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje rgya gram thogs la/ hūm̐: bya grub bla med gsang ba nyid: sna tshogs phrin las phyag mtshan 'di: dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar dngos grub yon tan rin chen bcud kyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang bskur ba la/ dpal chen po'i phrin las rnam pa bzhi gang la gang 'dul ston pa'i phyag rgya sna tshogs rdo rje phyag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa'i dbang dam pa thob par mos mdzod/ rdo rje rgya gram gtad la/ hūm̐: phrin las bzhi yi phyag mtshan te: gang 'dul der ston las 'chang phyir: brda yi rten 'brel rab tu zungs: deng 'dir rjes gnang yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ badz+ra tsakra dha ra hūm̐: de ltar phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur bas bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje thogs pa med pa'i nus rtsal mngon du byas la/ nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi/ tshe bsod 'byor drug rgyas/ khams gsum mos bzhi dbang du bsdus/ bdud rigs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod cing rjes 'dzin gyis bla med mchog la sbyor ba'i dpal dang ldan zhing 'bras bu mngon par byang chub pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/

/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa che mchog he ru ka'i bdag nyid du che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang stong dag pa gzhal yas khang dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces me long dang shel rdo thogs la/ hūm̐: ma bcos gnyug ma ka dag nyid: gsal stong 'gags med mtha' dbus bral: ye stong nyag gcig zang thal ngang : rig pa bde chen dbang bskur ro: om̐ bhi dho su khaṃ dz+nyā na shū n+ya te a bhi ṣiñca ham̐'u: zhes spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa la 'ja' lus snang stong brda'i dbang bskur ba la brten nas/ snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rang bzhin gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur sgom ste/ de'ang ye nas yin par ngo shes par gyis la brnyas pa ma byed/ tha mal gyi zhen rtog spong la dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod dang bkur sti rgya chen po bgyid cing*/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pa dwang du blangs shing sgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig /de yan chad kyis tshad med snying rje'i phur pa'am/ phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ ma hā yo ga'i spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas/ bskyed rim srid pa phur bu'i rnal 'byor spros pa dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam lnga las sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag

/'dzin rtog sogs zhi ba'i las thams cad 'grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dag pa gnyis ldan sprul sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes gzengs bstod/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba la bhan+dha 'di nyid tha mal ma yin zhing gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i pho brang du mos pa'i dbus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dpal rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum lha tshogs dang bcas pa sbyor ba mdzad pas/ bde chen gyi sgras phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs khro bo rab 'byams spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mkha' gsang nas yab kyi byang sems dri ma med pa mdangs can dang*/ yum gyi byang sems mtshal zhun lta bu gnyis lhan cig tu babs pa bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'khyil ba'i/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kyi dbyig tu gyur pa/ 'di nyid khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing myangs pa la brten nas/ lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs pas/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zag pa med par nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: sor rtogs ye shes bhan+dha ru: gsal stong bla med bdud rtsis bkang : dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar yab yum sku yi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba byang chub kyi sems spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob pas/ bde chen byang chub sems kyi phur pa rang lus bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam lnga las don dam byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa mthong lam dang po'i rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /las rlung dbang du sdud pas las thams cad 'grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/
