/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa gzungs ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas byung ba'i rdo rje'i rig ma/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa gcer bu bde nyams dang ldan pa zhig byung*/ slob dpon gyi rig ma'i lag g.yon pa khyed rnams kyi lag g.yas su gtad de zung 'jug dgyes rgur rol pas/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dga' bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i 'dun pa mdzod/ rig ma thogs la/ hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren zungs: dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ pra mo ti rā ga mi dharma hoḥ zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar khyed rang rnams dpal rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ rig ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma gsal ba dang*/ yab kyi gsang nas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭ dang bcas pa yum gyi mkha' la a las pad+ma aḥs mtshan pa yab kyi rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i rtsa g.yas la oṃ dkar po/ g.yon la āḥdamar po/ dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag /yab yum 'khyud pa dang tsum+ba na dang rdo rje pad+ma sbyar bas/ chags pa chen po'i me drod skyes te thig le'i dwangs ma rnams zhu/ spyi bo nas 'khor lo bzhi brgyud de rdo rje'i rtsa bar byon pas dga' ba/ dbus su byon pas mchog dga'/ rtsa gsum 'dom pa'i gnas su byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor byon pas mthar thug lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par mos te cung zad mnyam par zhog /phyi la ba thag tsam yang ma 'dzag par byas te rlung gi gdangs dang bcas hūm̐ zhes gyen du drang bas/ gsang ba nas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor la drangs shing gang ba dga' ba/

snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gang ba mchog dga'/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang ba dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang ba lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon du byas par mos pas lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang*/ rlung dang spyod lam gyi sgo nas lus kun khyab par dgram pa la brten nas rtsa thams cad byang chub sems kyis khyab/ de thams cad la bde stong zung 'jug gis khyab pa ste/ bde stong zung 'jug rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag par zhu/ des tha mal gyi rtog pa lha sngags chos nyid kyi thabs mkhas su bsgyur nas/ rjes chags snyom 'jug la brten nas zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byas te/ bde chen rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du nges par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lhag pa byang sems phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ spros med a nu yo ga'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gzhan lus bde chen pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam lnga las rgyu'i theg pa mthar phyin nas sgom lam kun tu 'od kyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ ma dag pa'i rlung sems dbyings su nub cing dag pa ye shes mngon du 'char la yid kyi sgrib pa dag /dbyings mi shigs pa mchog gi las thams cad grub/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med par chos sku bde ba chen po thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams phan tshun ma reg par rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nger zhog cig / ces mnyam bzhag rang ngo skyong du gzhug /de ltar bzhag pas sems zhes bya ba gzugs dbyibs kha dog dngos po mtshan ma can du ma grub pas/ rtag pa'i mtha' las grol ba chos sku blo 'das ye nas stong pa/

de'i mdangs ma 'gags par 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad shar ba'i gzhir gyur pas na/ chad pa'i mtha' las grol ba/ rang bzhin gsal la mi dmigs pa rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba ka dag tu rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsal bzhag dang bral bas ye gnas rang byung rig pa rjen pa la/ blo yi bcos bsgyur ma byed par 'dzin med yeng sgom dang bral ba'i ngang la so mar zhog mdzod/ ces man shel thogs la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid: ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dz+nyā na hrī da hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag la/ de ltar rig pa ye shes kyi phur bu'i dkyil 'khor du/ de kho na nyid rab tu spros med a ti rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob pas/ rig stong don gyi ye shes rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam lnga las 'bras bu'i theg pa mthar phyin pa mi slob pa'i lam bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ sgo gsum gyi sdig ltung shes bya'i dri ma dang bcas pa sbyangs/ nyams rtogs kyi yon tan sogs rgyas pa'i las grub/ 'khrul snang thal 'byin du phug te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi/ rdo rje gnyis med ye shes ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /de dag gis stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang gis rgyud smin par byas nas/ da smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa la/ mngon spyod rtsom pa po rig pa ye shes kyi phur bu'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pas lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong la zhugs shing*/ bskyed rim srid pa phur bu dang*/ rdzogs rim byang chub sems kyi phur bus sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phrang la 'grim ste/ spyod pa tshad med snying rje'i phur pa'i srog dang ldan pas/

mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur bus dgra bgegs bsgral ba mngon spyod kyi las rtsom par bya ste/ ji skad du/ phur pa grub nas gdab las bya/ zhes gsungs pas/ de la'ang srung ba/ zlog pa/ bsad pa/ 'phang ba/ bsregs pa/ mnan pa dang drug las/ dang po bsrung ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: dmigs pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā rid+dhi sarba badz+ra bh+rūm̐: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: de nyid brtan pa'i slad du srung 'khor gyi rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/

srung 'khor thogs la/ hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la: rang shar pho brang srung ba'i gur: ma dag mtshams gcod 'khor lo phyir: rtag tu bsgom zhing gnas par mdzod: om̐ dz+nyā na tsakra sa ma ya dha ra hūm̐: zhes srung 'khor gnas lngar bskur ro/ / de'ang mi dmigs pa chos kyi dbyings su rgyas gdab cing nus pa brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ye dhar dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ gnyis pa bzlog pa'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru kas: grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: dmigs pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: de nas bzlog par dpal 'bar btsugs te lag tu gtad/ hūm̐: dpal chen pho nya rbad pa'i rdzas: mu stegs nag po'i thod pa ru: dmar nag gtor ma rtsang gis brgyan: bskul lo phyi nang rkyen ngan zlog: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad zlog zlog: gsum pa bsad pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor: bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtub: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: dmigs pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan: bsad pa'i dngos gzhir mdun du hom khung liṅga las phur dbye sgro bsgral chas rnams 'du bya la/ de nas slob dpon drag po'i chas su zhugs shing dar nag dang bcas 'bru sna btab pa'i gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ dbyangs rol dang bcas/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon phur srung dam tshig can: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'dir gnas yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum por gser skyems 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la sogs/ de nas gdab las bya bar phrin las rtsom pa'i yul nyams pa bdun ldan gyi dgra bgegs la/ ji ltar brtsam pa'i phrin las dmigs pa'i rim pa gsal 'debs gnang bar zhu/ de'ang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad e khrom 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can/ nang bcud rnams rdo rje phur pa rig 'dzin dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs thams cad 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs te/ rngam pa'i hūm̐ sgra sgrogs shing las la chas par gyur/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dam sri pho mo red cing nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur/ 'gugs pa'i rgya dang bcas/ na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das/ dpal chen yang dag rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bka' sdod chos skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la snga dgra lag gis bsdo ba/ phyi dgra yid la bsam pa/ da dgra thad nas langs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod byed ky-i bgegs/ dam sri 'byung po log par 'dren pa thams cad kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa gzugs liṅga 'di nyid la khug cig /tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ rgya bzhi dang bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slob dpon dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i/ bde gshegs kyi sras mchog badz+ra ki' la ya phyag gnyis phur bu 'dril ba/ sku smad dbal phur zur gsum 'bar ba la thog mda' skar chen gyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ srid gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus rtsal dang ldan pa 'di nyid lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis/ thabs kyis mi thul ba'i gdul bya log 'dren bdud kyi dpung rnams shugs kyis sgrol ba'i mthu stobs dang nus rtsal yongs su grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa gsal gdab pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen po/ phur bu sras mchog /liṅga dgra bgegs kyi snying gar tshe srog gi rten nṛ tri dang bcas pa dngos su gsal ba/ phur bu'i dbal rtse las a yig dkar po'i 'od kyis sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ srog rten la reg pa tsam gyis sgo lnga'i rnam shes dbal rtser bsdus/ nyon yid rtsad nas bcad/ lnga 'dus dwangs ma tshe bsod thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes a yig dkar por gyur pa phur rtses ling gis btegs nas dpal chen po'i thugs kar stim/

phur bu'i dbal zur nas 'phros pa'i mtshon cha'i char pas bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan dum bur gtub par gyur/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ rngam byed 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: spros pa'i pho nya kī la ya: rbad do 'dril 'debs dgra bgegs sgrol: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ru tra mā ra kī la ya thum ril rbad nan: drag sngags so lnga phur bskor dang bcas 'debs tshul bya/ de nas rdo rje phur pa gtad de: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: las kyi mtha' sdud pho nya ba: 'debs dang 'bebs pas 'byung por brdeg: sras mchog gyad 'di 'chang bar gyis: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas gtub cing rol ba ni/ slar yang shes rab kyi ral gri ye shes kyi rtsal dang*/ rno ngar rab tu 'bar ba 'dis ma rig bdag 'dzin gyi btson khang dbyings su khrol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ral gri thogs/ hoḥ dpal chen che mchog yang dag ku mā ra: 'jigs byed drag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: rngam yangs bde chen 'khyil ba'i zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs sha khrag lhag med bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā hi: bzhi pa pha rol gyi g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i don du 'phang ba ni/ dmigs bya rten la 'gug gzhug drag po dang bcas/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang du bzhugs nas/ gtor ma'i dam tshig pa srid gsum phung ba'i nad mtshon dug gi sdong por dmigs la/ gtor zor lag tu thogs nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /da khyed rang rnams che mchog rdo rje gzhon nu drag por gsal ba'i gtor zor mtshon cha'i 'khor lo gnam lcags kyi thog ltar 'phang bas/ bstan dgra bdud dpung brlag pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ kī li kī la y ma hā bha ling+ta dgra bgegs sarba nṛ tri mā ra ya phaṭḥ

a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gtor zor lag tu gtad la dbang bskur/ de nas 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐: rbad pa'i zor mda' sha ra ra: brnag pa'i dgra srog chod la shog: bzlog med yin no dus la bab: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: om̐ lok+t+ri pā la ya dgra bgegs ru tra nṛ tri hur thum rbad ya: zhes gtor zor me hom gyi dbus su 'phang du gzhug /lnga pa drag po bsregs pa'i las mtha' brtsam pa ni/ shin tu mi bsrun pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa'i phyir du dug shing gi me hom/ lcags snod du sbar la sreg ling dgra bgegs dngos su dmigs la bden brdar ni/ 'gugs pa'i rgya dang bcas/ na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das/ yang dag dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bka' sdod chos skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la snga dgra lag gis bsdo ba/ phyi dgra yid la bsam pa/ da dgra thad nas langs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod byed ky-i bgegs/ dam sri 'byung po log par 'dren pa thams cad kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa gzugs liṅga 'di nyid la khug cig /tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ rgya bzhi dang bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas liṅga me hom du bstab la/ gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta l ma hā kiṃ ni ri ta l ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ dgra bgegs gshed ma'i lus ngag yid gsum l kha rje dbang thang l

srog lus rlung rta l yul mkhar longs spyod l skye rtsa bdun rgyud l ha ha ha/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i pho brang me hom du: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i bud shing bsregs: bstan dgra sgos dgra'i tshogs rnams kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: om̐ ru tra nṛ tri raṃ dz+wa la ye swā hā: slar yang de'i nus pa brtan par bya ba'i slad du thabs shes kyi phyag mtshan lag tu gtad pas phrin las myur mgyogs kyi dbang thob par mos mdzod/ hom gzar dang thab gtad la/ hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: las mtha' bsreg cing bstab pa'i snod: rdo rje'i snod la chos 'byung hom: bskur ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul bar gyis: om̐ badz+ra a ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ drug pa las mtha' mi mngon par rgyas gdab pa'i don du mnan pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ slob dpon dpal chen po'i thugs rje drag po'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas phye mar gas pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong du/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas hab sgra dir gyis lhags pa la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bden stobs drag pos srid pa gsum gyi dgra bgegs dam sri bdud rigs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas 'chi bdag gi zhal du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ shing tsher ma can gyis byang bur liṅga bris te sgrub khang de'i phyi rol gom pa dgu'i mtshams su mnan pa'am/ gong gi bsregs thal rnams mnan la/ de steng gtor gzhung kha sbub bden stobs 'gugs gzhug snga ma ltar byas pa'i mthar/ hūm̐: mdun du gshin rje'i brub khung du: nṛ tri dam sri dgra bgegs khug: 'chi bdag kha tham khyod la gtad: nam yang ma shor sa ma ya: om̐ nṛ tri dam sri ya ma nan kha tham swā hā: zhes gtad pas mthar shor med rgya mtsho'i klong du/ chol sgra dang bcas nas thim pa'i steng du ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa dpal chen po'i pho brang du gsal ba'i dbus su/

khyed rang rnams dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu thugs rje drag po'i phyag rgya rdzogs pas/ srid pa spyi gnon gyi bro brdung gzir zhing bdud tshogs nam yang ldang med du bcom pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces slob ma rnams mtheb chung sbrel ba'i bro ra bskor zhing*/ las gzhung bzhin rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rngam byed rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas: ru tra dam sri thal bar brlag: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ro ṣa na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ru tra a mu ka bigh+nān mā ra ya bh+yoḥbh+yoḥnan nan: zhes gtor gzhong kha yar slong la me tog 'thor/ de nas tshe 'gugs bya ba ni: skad cig gis bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba'i/ thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad tshe'i rang bzhin nṛḥdang āḥdang hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du bkrag me re re snod bcud thams cad zhu zhing khengs pa 'ub 'ub bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas la/ hūm̐: rdo rje'i tshe yi pho brang nas: mi shigs srog gi g.yung drung nyid: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsol: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub gyur cig: om̐ gu ru dz+nyā na ā yur sid+dhi hūm̐: de rnams kyis mngon spyod drag po'i rjes gnang grub pa lags pas/ deng nas brtsams te snang srid thal 'byin gyi dgongs pas phur bu rnam bzhi yul so sor gdab pa'i las la brtson par mdzod cig /de ltar zab gsang bla na med pa yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi dbang bskur rtsa ba dang yan lag gis brgyan pa legs par grub ste/ rgyal bu rgyal sar mnga' gsol zhing rgyal srid la mnga' dbang bskur ba bzhin/ dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob cing khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por slob ma khyed rang rnams/

mnga' gsol ba'i skabs su bab pa yin pas rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang sbyin pa ni/ rgyal tshab 'os pa yin na khri la bzhag ste glegs bam/ dung dkar/ 'khor lo rnams gtad la/ de nas dkyil 'khor lag tu gtad cing*/ hūm̐: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dag: de ring slob bu khyod la sbyin: rdo rje 'dzin par mnga' gsol bas: dkyil 'khor kun la dbang gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐ ra ye swā hā: 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang sbyin pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor phyag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ 'dzag med bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsams shing*/ thabs la brten pa'i rgyu dus kyi yan lag bdun la goms pas/ 'bras bu'i dus su sku gsum kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku'i go 'phang mngon du bsgrigs pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ste dbang de bskur ba'i byed las su gzhan gyi don phyir slob ma 'du ba dang*/ zab mo'i chos 'chad pa la sogs pa bgyid par rjes su gnang zhing rten 'brel legs par 'grigs pa yin no/ /

de nas po ti gtad de: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la po ti glegs bam gyi dbang bskur bas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis/ wā rā ṇā si/ bya rgod phung ri/ ma ga dha sogs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan nas rgyal po dzā la gsang sngags kyi bka' bab pa ltar/ khyed rang rnams la rgyud lung man ngag gi chos kyi mdzod chen bskur cing 'dzin pa'i bka' gtad chig rdzogs su thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bka' yi 'dus sde ma lus kun: chig rdzogs rgyud chen 'di ka ste: brjod pas mtshan nyid dpag par dka': nam mkha'i klong mdzod 'di zungs shig: om̐ dharma li khi ti puṣ+ṭa ga ga khaṃ dha ra swā hā: de nas dung dkar gtad de: hoḥ sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar phul bas/ snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po phyogs bcur bsgrengs te rdo rje theg chen gyi snyan pa'i chos sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pa bzhin du/ khyed rang rnams la dung dkar phyag tu gtad pas bka' yi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs dam pa'i tshul dgus/ gzhan don dpag tu med pa mdzad par bskul ba'i gnang ba thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /hoḥ bla med nam mkha'i mdzod chen dag: gsang ba dbyings kyi pho brang nas: skye med snying po'i rang sgra sgrogs: 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ldan par gyis: om̐ rasma lak+ṣa pri ka ha sa swa bhā ga ga khaṃ swā hā: de nas gser gyi 'khor lo gtad de: hoḥ sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lha tshangs pas/ gser gyi 'khor lo phul ba'i rten 'brel la brten nas chos kyi 'khor lo brgyad khri bzhi stong bskor ba bzhin du/ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la gser gyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur bas/ 'gro ba gang 'dul der ston gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing*/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po byed nus pa'i dpal la longs spyod par gyur cig

/hoḥ deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: 'gro ba lha yi sgra skad du: don ston chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: mtha' yas smin grol mdzad phyir bskul: om̐ dharma rat+na tsakra tu ta ghaṇ+ḍe ye swā hā: bkra shis rdzas rtags lag tu sprad de/ de nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: rgyal srid sna bdun dgos 'dod yid bzhin mdzod: bkra shis rdzas rtags mthar thug dge ba'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis: rdo rje slob dpon rtag tu bsnyen bskur bgyid: oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal maṅga laṃ shrī ye swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de dag gis dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa yin pas/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bden tshig gi shis pa brjod cing*/ me tog gi char chen po bsnyil bas dbang gi byin rlabs gong du 'phel zhing nyams med brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces bkra shis brjod/ hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyis dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba thob pa yin pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang mi 'bral zhing bsnyen sgrub 'bad rtsol las kyi mtha' sogs/ phyi nang gi go rim thams cad byed du rung ba yin no/ /de'ang dbang srog 'dzin par byed pa dam tshig yin te/ klong gsal las/ gsang sngags srog ni dam tshig ste/ khyad par smin byed dbang dang ni/ /grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa la/ /bla ma mchog bsten 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ /de yi rtsa ba dam tshig srungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ ji ltar bsrung na/ sgra thal 'gyur las/ dbang brten pa yi dam tshig bshad/ /dbye na brjod kyis mi lang yang*/ /mdor bsdus sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la sbyar/ /dmigs pa bla ma rdo rje mched/ /bsrung ba'i yul gyi rnam par dbye/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i gnad bzung bya/ /zhes sngags bla med kyi don la dam tshig gi rnam dbye dang bsrung tshul dpag tu med par gsungs kyang*/

rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la 'dus te/ sku'i dam tshig tu gzhan phyi nang snod bcud thams cad la ma dag pa'i 'dzin rtog spangs te yi dam lha'i bskyed rim rgyun chad med par bsgom/ gsung gi dam tshig tu yar sangs rgyas nas mar gang zag phal pa yan gyi gsung rab mi brnyas par/ snod bcud 'byung ba'i sgra thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gsung du mos pas sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar bya/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu mi dge ba'i rtog pa skad cig ma yan chod spangs la/ phan bde byang chub kyi sems rgyun chad med par nyams su blang zhing chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo bar bya: gal te dam tshig las nyams na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba stor ba klong gsal las/ bla ma dang ni dbang mchog gi /gsung dang rgyud las 'gal ba na/ /na raka sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang ji bzhin ma 'gal bar bsgrubs pa'i yon tan ni/ de nyid las/ bka' dang ma 'gal yon tan ni/ /chos sku kun tu bzang po 'grub/ /phrin las bzhi la thogs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ dam tshig gi gnad rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa che: dam pa'i bka' ni legs bstsal pa: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung : lan gsum/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i slob bus slob dpon gyi dgyes pa skong dgos te/ rig pa rang shar las/ de ltar man ngag slob dpon la/ khu bo pha dang ma dang mig /bu dang chung ma nor dang mchog /sgo gsum zol zog med pa yis/ /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad 'bul/ /zhes dang*/ de ltar mnyes pa'i yon tan yang*/ de nyid las/ brten pa de las yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yi/ /yon tan dpag tu med par 'thob/ /ces gsungs pas/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen 'grub pa'i dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar ma byas na las mtha' mi btsan pas/ 'di ltar bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mdo las/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ zhes dang*/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ bdag gi smon lam mtha' yas de tsam mo/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ yam̐ng phum̐r thabs shes nyi zla'i gwam̐'um̐ sbyor/ /dmam̐r nam̐g yang gsaṃng rgyud bcud drag sngaṃgs dang*/ /bsdebs 'di bstanaṃ 'dziṃn yongs kyi gces nor te/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'jo la med thabs med/ /de dag ni so bdun pa bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi dbang chen rdo rje'i phreng ba rngam klong rab tu 'bar ba'i smin byed gyi dbang chog chu 'bab kyi lugs su bkod pa ste yang phur gyi dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ yam̐ng le shod du yang phum̐r sgrub pa mdzad/ /mchog gi grub brnyes sbrags sgrub brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mdzad ces grags pa che yang deng gi dus/

/gwa'u dmar nag tsam las cher ma dbam̐ng*/ so brgyad pa bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi dbang 'bring po la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sbyor ba ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ stegs bu mthing nag gi khar 'bru tshom lha grangs bkod pa'i thog tu rnam rgyal bum par kha rgyan bum tsaka dang mgul chings mthing nag gis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du ka pā lar bdud rtsi chos sman btab pa'i dza gad kyis dgang*/ de'i khar dar dmar brgyad ltebs kyis bkab cing me long gi ngos su sin+dhu ras byas pa'i chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar mūm̐ḥ zur bzhir ha ri ni sa bris pa man shel zur drug bcas dgod/ mdun du gtso phur nyer spyod/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ sngon gtor sogs dang*/ mdun chas las bum/ ḍā dril/ g.yab dar/ yungs thun/ las phur/ nang mchod sogs ma tshang ba med par gzhung bzhin 'du byas la/ dngos gzhi la thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang skyes rabs gsol 'debs gnyis song nas/ las gzhung gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed rgyas 'bring gang rung mchod bstod kyi bar song nas dzpa khang dbye zhing*/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum bsgrubs nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas kyi mthar rig pa'i me tog tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i gsol 'debs rnams bya la dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ rang lugs gsol kha spyi dang bye brag tu phur srung bcu drug dang*/ gter srung btsan rgod gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la slob ma rnams mdun du bos la khrus bya ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur:

om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang? khyad par du yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu bdud 'dul khro bcu phra thabs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug / steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bas srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i phyogs su bka' gter dag snang gi bab so gsum du bzhugs pa las/ 'di ni nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa dang*/ de la'ang rje 'bangs lo pan rnams kyis rnam 'phrul gter ston brgya rtsa sogs du mar byon pa'i nang tshan/ pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am/ rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rjes gter gnas so dgu nas zab gter don lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/

yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs te/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: yang dag bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: zhes gsal ba ltar/ gu ru nyid bal yul yang le shod du dpal yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ grub pa thob la nye ba'i skabs/ srid pa'i lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams ma bzod nas klu gyong po dang*/ bar snang glog ma sprin/ gnod sbyin rgod ma kha sogs sbran nas lha 'dre mi gsum gyi rgyud dkrugs shing*/ lo gsum du char med than chen byung zhing*/ nad mug sogs mi dge ba'i ltas ngan sna tshogs btang*/ yul mi kun kha 'cham nas a tsa ra 'dis ngan sngags kyi mthus byas pa yin pas/ 'di nyid yul nas phud rgyu'i gros ngan shom ste/ stong gsum dgrar langs pa lta bu'i bar chad kyi rnam pa byung bas/ bal po ji la ji sa dang*/ bal mo ku la ku sa gnyis bar chad sel ba'i chos zhu bar/ rgya gar du gser phye bre bdun dang bcas slob dpon pra bha hastī drung du brdzangs pas bid+yot+ta ma'i rgyud 'bum sde las/ phur pa'i glegs bam mi khur gnyis tsam dang*/ khyad par hūm̐ ka ra'i phur pa gnam lcags 'khyug mo zhes yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub skor shog dril gcig la tshang ba bcas bskur ba: slob dpon pad+ma'i phyag tu phul bas dgongs pa shin tu dgyes: yang le shod du sgrub pa mdzad pas zhag bdun gyis yi dam gyi zhal gzigs: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mngon sum du brnyes/ thun mong du mkha' nas char babs shing rtsi shing lo thog rnams dus gcig tu skyes/ de'i tshe sku lus la phur pa rnam gsum gyi go cha bzhes te bdud dang dam sri thams cad dam la btags: khyad par klu gyong po sna: bar snang glog ma sprin: gnod sbyin rgod ma kha bcas mtha' ru spyugs: de'i tshe zhal nas kyang*/

yang dag ni tshong pa dang 'dra ste dngos grub che/ phur pa ni skyel ma dang 'dra ste phrin las myur/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa dang*/ bdud dang bar chod 'dul ba ni rdo rje phur pa las lhag pa med gsungs te/ yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad par yongs su grags kyang da bar sa steng du dngos su thon pa ni nyung bar snang ngo*/ /de nas bod yul du btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bsam yas sa 'dul la slob dpon spyan drangs pas/ rdo rje phur pas sa 'dul mdzad pas bsam yas grub/ de'i tshe yang phur yid bzhin nor bu ba'am phur pa yon tan phun tshogs su grags pa'o/ /de'ang rdo rje phur pa'i bla brgyud ltar na: brgyud pa gsum ste: rgya gar yul du dga' rab rdo rje nas pra bha hastī dang : pad+ma 'byung gnas la brgyud te ye shes mtsho rgyal la gtad: bal yul nas bal po ji la ji sa dang shākya de ma: ku la ku sa gnyis kyis brgyud pa bal po ba su dha ra la bka' gtad: bsil ba tshal du slob dpon chen po pra bha hastī las zhus pa dang : phyi mor slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra la yang phur sbrags ma bya ba'i gdams pa phyogs gcig tu dril ba ste yang phur gwa'u dmar nag tu grags pa'o/ /slob dpon chen pos phur pa'i gdams skor mang du bstan te/ rgyal po'i lugs/ lcam gyi lugs/ jo mo'i lugs/ 'khon gyi lugs sogs mang du mched do/ khyad par du mtsho rgyal nyid la phur pa'i bka' bab nas phur pa'i gdeng tshad thob/ phrin las nam mkha'i pha mthar brgal ba de byung ste/ nyid kyi zhal nas kyang*/ e ma yang zab 'di nyid byin rlabs bcud du dril: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas lam: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus dgos 'dod 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bu nor gyis phyug: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus phrin las 'grub: phur pa yid bzhin nor bus bar chod sel:

phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i jo mo ngas: blo phugs yid bzhin nor bu 'di la bca': gdams pa sgrub thabs rin chen gter du sbas: rje yi bka' bzhin bdag gis lhur blangs pas: ma ning gter bcu sbas pa'i gnas su 'os: bal bod mon kha phur pa bsten pa'i gnas: yang phur gcig dril gdams ngag zab mo'i chos: ma 'ongs 'di 'byin rjes 'brangs grogs lnga 'byung : sa rtags mtha' bzhi'i so kha mngon du mtshungs: dus rtags ru bzhi chu ltar khol bar byed: 'dul zhing 'gro don rong chen bzhi la 'byung : bka' yi chos bdag nyi shu rtsa lngar spel: gnubs ston mthu chen yid la de ltar bcag: ces gsungs pa bzhin gnubs chen gyi rnam 'phrul o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas/ mon kha sha 'ug stag sgo nas bzhes pa'i/ yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ de nas phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir yang phur dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka' yi gnang ba thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad par/ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: gdod nas lhun grub gnyug ma'i rtsa ba gsum:

kun tu rang sems ma g.yos skyabs su mchi: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ho: 'khor 'das mnyam yang phyogs lhung bye brag gnad: legs par rtogs pa de bzhin sems bskyed do: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan dpal chen zhi khro dang*/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/

dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni 'da' ka rdo rje'i chu: mos 'thung dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'grub: nyams na na raka chen por ltung : bsrungs pas dngos grub kun thob gyur: khyed rnams kyis kyang don de las mi 'da' bar bgyi'o snyam pas bro bor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes pa dbab pa la/ khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis bsang sbyangs la/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /mtshan tshang drag po'i pho brang bsgom/ de dbus rdo rje'i brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi steng : hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'dus las: che mchog yang dag he ru kaḥ dbu dgu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro: bco brgyad phyag mtshan rim pa bzhin: gri gug ral gri dbyug to dang : rdo rje tho ba gsal shing khyung : 'khor lo nor bu bcas pa g.yas: bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ thong gshol rnga: lcags sgrog rgyu ma dril bu zhags: phur pa dang bcas g.yon du bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: zhabs brgyad khro rol gyad kyi 'gros: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: gri thod drug bcas mgul 'khyud stob: thugs kar mchod rten bum pa'i dbus/ pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng :

ma hā badz+ra ku mā ra'i: thugs kar sems dpa' srog yig bcas: mi bzad 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin para.āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing dang khyad par du gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas dpal yang dag rdo rje gzhon nu/ zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha tshogs ma lus pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang bar spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la byin dbab kyi rdzas bsregs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub pa la: ye shes rdo rje phur pa'i lha: mi 'gyur dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya āḥ de ltar dam tshig pa dang gnyis me du thim par gyur/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/ de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ dngos gzhi la bum gsang shes rab tshig gi dbang dang bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang gis slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ bum pa dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang du khro rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi khyod rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'khor lo lnga po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ dpal chen po'i sku dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: me long ye shes bum pa ru: snang stong bla med bdud rtsis bkang : dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro:

om̐ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu rgyan par gyur/ des phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ ma hā yo ga'i spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas/ bskyed rim srid pa phur bu'i rnal 'byor spros pa dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam lnga las sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /'dzin rtog sogs zhi ba'i las thams cad 'grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dag pa gnyis ldan sprul sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes gzengs bstod/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba la/ bhan+dha gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i pho brang du bdud rtsi dpal chen yab yum lha tshogs dang bcas pa sbyor bas/ byang sems nyid bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'khyil ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kyi dbyig tu gyur pa 'di nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing myangs pa la brten nas/ lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs pas/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zag pa med par nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: sor rtogs ye shes bhan+dha ru: gsal stong bla med bdud rtsis bkang : dpal chen dkyil 'khor ngo bo mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba byang chub kyi sems spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob pas/ bde chen byang chub sems kyi phur pa rang lus bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/

lam lnga las don dam byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa mthong lam dang po'i rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /las rlung dbang du sdud pas las thams cad 'grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa gzungs ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas byung ba'i rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa gcer bu bde nyams dang ldan pa zhig byung*/ slob dpon gyis rig ma'i lag g.yon pa khyed rnams kyi lag g.yas su gtad de zung 'jug dgyes rgur rol pas/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dga' bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i 'dun pa mdzod/ rig ma thogs la/ hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren bzung : dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ pra mo ti rā ga mi dharma hoḥ zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar khyed rang rnams dpal rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ rig ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mar gsal ba dang*/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mar 'du shes pa dang*/ yid chos su 'du shes pa ste 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus su yas bab dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong zhing zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byas shing*/ bde chen rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du nges par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yum mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ spros med a nu yo ga'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ byang sems gyi phur pas gzhan lus bde chen gyi pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam lnga las rgyu'i theg pa mthar phyin nas sgom lam kun tu 'od kyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/

yid kyi sgrib pa dag /dbyings mi shigs pa mchog gi las thams cad grub/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa chos sku bde ba chen po 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams phan tshun ma reg par rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nger zhog cig / ces man shel thogs la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid: ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dz+nyā na hrī da hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag la/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ de kho na nyid rab tu spros med a ti rig rtsal gyi dbang thob pas rig pa ye shes kyi phur bu rdo rje lta bu ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam lnga las 'bras bu'i theg pa mthar phyin pa/ mi slob pa'i lam bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ sgo gsum gyi sdig ltung shes bya'i dri ma dang bcas pa sbyangs/ nyams rtogs kyi yon tan sogs rgyas pa'i las grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /de dag gis stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang gis rgyud smin par byas nas/ da smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa la/ mngon spyod rtsom pa pos/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur bu'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pas lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong la zhugs shing*/ bskyed rim srid pa phur bu dang rdzogs rim byang chub sems kyi phur bus sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phrang la 'grim ste/

spyod pa tshad med snying rje'i phur pa'i srog dang ldan pas mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur bus dgra bgegs bsgral ba mngon spyod kyi las rtsom par bya ste/ ji skad du/ phur pa grub nas gdab las bya/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin mngon spyod kyi las brtsam pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ na moḥ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyi sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig /dgra bgegs nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ slob dpon gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i/ sras mchog kī la ya srid gsum dus gcig tu sgrol ba'i nus rtsal dang ldan pa de nyid/ khyed rang tsho'i lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis thabs kyis mi thul ba'i log 'dren bdud dpung rnams shugs kyis sgrol ba'i mthu stobs dang*/ mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod pa'i dbang thob par mos shig / tshe khrus lung gsum gyi dgongs pa gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ rngam byed 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: spros pa'i pho nya kī la ya: rbad do 'dril 'debs dgra bgegs sgrol: zhes bdag nyid dpal chen po/ phur bu sras mchog /liṅga dgra bgegs kyi snying gar tshe srog gi rten nṛ tri dang bcas pa dngos su gsal bar/ phur bu'i dbal rtse las a yig dkar po'i 'od kyis sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ srog rten la reg pa tsam gyis sgo lnga'i rnam shes dbal rtser bsdus/ nyon yid rtsad nas bcad/ lnga 'dus dwangs ma'i tshe bsod thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes a yig dkar por gyur pa phur rtser ling gis btegs nas/ rnam shes chos dbyings su spar/ phur bu'i dbal nas 'phros pa'i mtshon cha'i char pas bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan dum bur gtub par mos la bsgral ba'i las la 'jug par zhu/ om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ru tra mā ra kī la ya thum ril rbad nan: drag sngags so lnga phur bskor dang bcas 'debs tshul bya/ slar de dag gi nus pa brtan pa'i phyir rdo rje phur pa lag tu gtad par mos mdzod/ de nas rdo rje phur pa gtad de/ hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra ku mā ra'i: las kyi mtha' sdud pho nya ba: 'debs dang 'bebs pas 'byung por brdeg: sras mchog gyad 'di 'chang bar gyis: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas gtub cing rol ba ni/ ral gri gtad cing gtub la rol du gzhug pa ni/ hoḥ dpal chen che mchog yang dag ku mā ra: 'jigs byed drag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: rngam yangs bde chen 'khyil ba'i zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs sha khrag lhag med bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā hi: slar yang shes rab kyi ral gri ye shes kyi rtsal dang rno ngar rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ ma rig bdag 'dzin gyi btson khang dbyings su khrol bar mos la gtub pa dang*/ bsgral rdzas bdag mdun gyi lha la stob pas phyir mi ldog pa'i sar bkod par mos mdzod/ de rnams kyis mngon spyod drag po'i rjes gnang grub pa lags pas/ deng nas brtsams te snang srid thal 'byin gyi dgongs pas phur bu rnam bzhi yul so sor gdab pa'i las la brtson par mdzod cig /de dag gis dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub pa la/ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas shis pa brjod pa'i glu dbyangs sgrogs shing*/ me tog man+da ra ba'i char phab pa'i dge legs kyi snang bas phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis brjod/ de nas dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ de nas de dag gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams? rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar shes par bya'o/ /yam̐ng dag sgyu ma bde mchog ma yi rgyud/ /phum̐r pa ta ma 'bum sde pha yi rgyud/ /mnyam sbyor gwa'u dmar nag 'dus rgyud kyi/ /gsaṃng sngagaṃs dbang chog bstanaṃ pa 'dziṃn des spel/ de dag ni so brgyad pa bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las dbang 'bring po'i le tshan no/ /de dag gis yi dam gyi skor song ngo*// // ༈ smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen las/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro zhi drag gi skor las/ so dgu pa zhi ba sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dbang chog kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyi chog khrigs bzhin mthar chags su bya/ ༈ gter chen rnam 'phrul pad rgyal gling pa yi/ /dam̐g snangam̐ chos sde tshogs gnyis myur lam zhes/ /myur mdzad 'pham̐gs mam̐'i rjem̐s gnam̐ng 'di ka tsam/ /gong 'og zab gter 'phro mthud rten 'byung bzhag / bzhi bcu pa dag snang sgrol chog tshogs gnyis myur lam dang 'brel bar gzhan rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pas/ sbyor ba'i tshe zhi gtor rgyan spros can sku tsaka dang dar ljang gis bklubs pa dang*/ mchod pa phreng tshar bskor bsham gyi dbus su maṇ+ḍal 'bru tshom lha grangs can mañji'i steng du stegs kyi khar dgod/ sgrol chog tshar gcig dbang len bar btang zhing gtor ma nyid 'phags ma dngos su gsal ba rang gi gnas bzhir 'god la/

rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gnas gsum las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser rim cig char: bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par shog: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes gtor mar dbang bzhi blang pa'i bdag 'jug sngon du 'gro ba'i slob ma bos la khrus dang bgegs bskrad de/ mtshams sbyor gyi khyad par ni/ chos bshad ji ltar rigs pa sngon du long skabs dang bstun par 'chad de/ da lam 'dir rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las kyi rang gzugs rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje'i bdag nyid can 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgo nas byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur mdor bsdus shig bskur ba yin la/ de'ang mdo sngags dang bka' gter dag snang gi gdams srol bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa las/ da lam skabs su bab pa rgyal dbang o rgyan chen po dang*/ gangs can phur thogs yongs kyi gtso bo gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes zung gi /thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa chu zla bzhin snyigs 'gro'i dpal du shar ba/ sprul pa'i gter 'byin 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i zab mo dag snang gi chos sde las byon pa/ sgrol ma'i cho ga tshogs gnyis myur lam dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba la/ de'ang*/ lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pa'i/ /blo ldan gang gi rab dad brjod pas/ /srod dang tho rangs langs par byas te/ /dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster/ /sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba/ /ngan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa nyid do/ /rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis/ /myur du dbang ni bskur bar 'gyur la/ /'di las che ba nyid ni 'thob cing*/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang mthar thug der 'gro/ /de yi dug ni drag po chen po/ /stan la gnas pa'am gzhan yang 'gro ba/ /zos pa dang ni 'thung pa nyid kyang*/ /dran pas rab tu sel ba nyid 'thob/ /gdon dang rims dang dug gis gzir ba'i/

/sdug bsngal tshogs ni rnam par spong ste/ /sems can gzhan pa rnams la yang ngo*/ /gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na/ /bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur zhing*/ /nor 'dod pas ni nor ni nyid 'thob/ /'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te/ /gegs rnams med cing so sor 'joms 'gyur/ zhes pa ltar gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod 'bras gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i nor bu bsam 'phel lta bu/ khyad par du kha ba ri pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog 'di'i dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du zhing khams dbul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug / thog mar bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma dbyer ma mchis par bzhugs pa la/ thal sbyar me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ 'od dpag med mgon phyag gi dkyil 'khor dang : 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan las legs 'khrungs pa'i: ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i sprul gzhi myur zhi yum: bcom ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid nyer gcig gar: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las myur ma dpal: dbyer med rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rjer: phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug khyed rang rnams kyi thugs rgyud dag par sbyang ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang 'phags ma gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas/ phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul ma lus pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa'i drung du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ ma gyur sems can thams cad bla med byang chub la 'god par bya ba'i ched du/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na moḥ skyabs yul rgya mtsho'i ngo bo rje btsun mar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings pa'i ma gyur 'gro: rje btsun 'phags ma'i go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi:

lan gsum dang*/ de nas tshogs zhing de dag gi spyan sngar bsags sbyang yan lag bdun pa'i don yid la bsam bzhin tshig 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hoḥ rje btsun 'phags ma rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung snying nas bshags: yi rang bskul zhing bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: dge tshogs 'phags ma'i go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo: de ltar gsol 'debs dang bsags sbyang bcas song nas thugs rgyud snod ldan du bsgrub pa'i slad du/ bla ma dang 'phags ma gnyis su med pa'i drung nas so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa len cing bzung ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ ho/ bla ma 'phags ma dbyer med dgongs su gsol/ /mkha' khyab sems can srid mtsho las bsgral phyir/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags rig 'dzin gyi/ /bslab sdom dam tshig ma lus bdag la stsol/ /bdag gis 'bras bu mngon du ma gyur bar/ /'gro ba'i don du ci nus bzung bar bgyi/ lan gsum gyis khas blang*/ de ltar sbyor ba'i rim pa song ste dngos gzhi dbang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du ye shes pa dbab pa la/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus gnad drag tu gcun la ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis chus bran la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ thams cad mi dmigs pa rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par blo sbyong la mnyam par zhog /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gnas yul rnam par dag pa/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'phro ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams gang du 'khod pa'i gdan zla ba dang ut+pal la gnas pa'i/ rang rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo tāṃ yig ljang gu las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsgom/ skad cig gis de nyid yongs su gyur pas khyed rang rnams rje btsun 'phags ma'i skur lam gyis gsal ba dang*/ slob dpon la mos pa'i stobs kyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas/

phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams sras dang slob mar bcas pa/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs/ lha sngags phyag rgya 'od zer gyi rnam par kha char babs pa bzhin byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod cig /po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas/ /tāṃ yig ljang gu las 'khrungs shing*/ /taṃ yig 'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol/ /sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /slob ma rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ om̐ ta re tut+tā re tu re badz+ra dz+nyā na a be sha ya a āḥ zhes spos rol dang bcas byin dbab/ me tog dang phyag mtshan rdo rje rgya gram slob ma'i spyi bor bkod la/ de ltar byin dbab pa'i ye shes pa ji srid du rgyud la brtan par bya ba'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ de ltar byin rlabs kyi gzhi 'god phyir ye shes pa dbab pa sngon du song zhing dngos gzhi gtor ma'i dbang bskur byed pa la mos pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma rim bzhin slob ma'i gnas bzhir bkod la/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyan sngar thugs bskyed rgyal ba'i yum gyur ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las kun sgrub ma/ /myur ma dpa' mo dbyangs can ma dang bsod nams mchog gter rnam rgyal rig byed ma dang 'jigs byed ma/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gzhan las rgyal dang seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal nor ster ma/ /bkra shis don byed dgra dpung 'joms mdzad khro gnyer ldan mdzad rab zhi ma dang 'bar ba'i 'od can ma/ /dpag med gnon ma rma bya chen mo mi pham rgyal mo ri khrod ma dang 'od zer can mar 'dud/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol phyir byang chub thob 'dod bdag kyang khyod la re'o rje btsun ma'i/ sku mchog mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thob par shog

/ yi ge bcu pa'i sham du/ kā ya sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ des sku'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob par mos shig / yang gtor ma mgrin par bzhag la/ rgyal ba kun?ma'i/ gsung mchog mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thob par shog / yi ge bcu pa'i sham du/ wāk+ka sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ des gsung gi dbang thob/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /mtshan bcas rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob par mos shig / yang gtor ma snying gar bzhag la/ rgyal ba kun?ma'i/ thugs mchog mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thob par shog / yi ge bcu pa'i sham du/ tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ des thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /mtshan med rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob par mos shig / yang gtor ma lte bar bzhag la/ rgyal ba kun?ma'i/ yon tan dang phrin las mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thob par mos shig / yi ge bcu pa'i sham du/ gu ṇa karma sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ des yon tan gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sdig sgrib dag /'od gsal de kho na nyid bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob par mos shig / bsdus na/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thob par mos shig / yi ge bcu pa'i sham du/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ tshar gcig gis 'thus so/ /gang ltar yang sngags kyi rjes gnang gi don du/ de nas sngags kyi rjes gnang gi ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'phags ma bdag la stsal du gsol/ /'phags ma bdag la bstsal nas kyang*/

/bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis sngags phreng thogs la/ slob dpon 'phags mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las/ ye shes kyi sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig zhal nas thon te slob ma'i khar zhugs shing*/ snying gar zla gdan gyi sngags phreng la thim par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ yi ge bcu pa lan gsum sogs rjes zlos bcug la sngags phreng snying gar bzhag ste/ 'phags ma bdag la stsal du gsol/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum dang*/ de nas gtor dbang dang 'brel ba'i mtha' rten bka' bsgo byed par 'dod na/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba bsrung bya'i spyi bor bzhag la/ rgyal ba kun gyi?rje btsun ma'i/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ sems can gang zhig lha mo khyed kyi mtshan tsam brjod par byed pa de dag thams cad rjes su 'dzin zhes sngon gyi thugs dam bzhin/ dgra gdon/ dbul phongs/ me chu/ gcan gzan/ seṅge/ glang chen/ dug sbrul/ lcags sgrog /rgyal po'i chad pa sogs/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen 'jigs tshogs mtha' dag sel ba dang mthar thug 'khor ba dang ngan song las sgrol tā re ma/ zhes yi ge bcu pa'i gzungs bcas mthar/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes pa brgya tshar dang lo grangs sogs byas pas bar chad kyi rigs nges par sel lo/ /mthar rten snying brjod la me tog 'thor nas brtan par bya/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma'i yum gyi bkra shis shog /byang chub bar du bla ma rje btsun mas: 'bral med thugs rjes skyong ba'i bkra shis shog: ces dang bkra shis ci rigs kyis mtha' brgyan no/ / de ltar gter 'byin 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i zab mo dag snang las byon pa'i sgrol ma'i cho ga

/tshogs gnyis myur lam gyi byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur rjes gnang dang bcas legs par phul grub pa'i sku drin gtang rag tu zhing khams dbul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug / slar yang dbang yon gyi don du sgo gsum ltos med du 'bul ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ dbang srog gi gtso bo dam tshig khas len pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ de ltar gsan pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan don du bsngo ba'i thugs 'dun lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di sogs/ zhes dge ba bsngo zhing slob ma gyes so/ /'khor lo'i mgon po gter chen bla ma yis/ /gong ma'i zab gter spel ba'i bka' bab dang*/ /phyi ma'i chos bdag yin pa'i snga phyi gnyis/ /mthud nas phyi rabs gangs ljongs 'gro la ston/ zhes gsungs pa'i bka' stsal mi gcog pa'i slad du rten 'byung tsam la dmigs nas sa bcad bzhag ste phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams nas kyang gong 'og zab gter lhan cig tu smin grol rgyun skyong thugs nges gal che zhu ba lags so/ de dag ni bzhi bcu pa gter ston pad rgyal gling pa'i dag snang sgrol chog tshogs gnyis myur lam sgrol ma nyer gcig gi dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ gsam̐ng bam̐ zab mo'i mthar thug pa/ /yem̐ shem̐s rgyud la 'bebs pa'i thabs/ /mkham̐' 'grom̐'i smin byed khrigs bsdebs pa/ /bde chen lam bzang 'di na dbye/ zhe gcig pa rtsa ba gsum pa mkha' 'gro'i skor las gsang ba ḍāk+ki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ khros ma lha lnga'i gcod dbang dang bcas pa dkyus gcig tu bkod pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ rab rdul tshon/ 'bring ras bris 'dzoms na dang*/ tha ma 'bru tshom bkod pa'i dbus su lding khri rim gnyis kyi dang po'i khar/ dbus su bum pa rgyan ldan dang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i sku bsham/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tsaklis brgyan par bsham/

lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ byang du karma mkha' 'gro/ mdun du gtor ma stod zur smad zlum pad 'dab bzhi dang ril bu bzhi dang ldan pa bsham/ g.yas su bhan+dha/ g.yon du me long sin+dhu ras mtshan pa/ rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grim pa'i cha rkyen mkha' 'gro'i rgya rtags kyi dbang dang 'brel ba'i/ rus rgyan/ gri gug /bhan+dha/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ g.yang gzhi/ rkang gling*/ dom ra rnams bsham/ de'i mthar shar du phyi mchod/ tshogs 'khor bza' btung gi rigs phun sum tshogs pa bsham/ gzhan yang gter srung las kyi ma mo dang*/ btsan rgod kyi gtor ma/ bskul gtor/ chad brtan rnams rang gzhung spyi mthun ltar bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas bzung khros ma'i chog khrigs ye shes sgo 'byed kyi gzhung bsrang la bstod pa'i rjes dzap khang dbye zhing*/ bsnyen pa'i mjug tu bum pa gnyis sgrub pa spyi mthun ltar mchod bstod 'od zhu grub nas rig me dor ba dang*/ gnang ba zhu ba gsol kha skong bshags nas tshogs drang ba'i bar mthar chags su gtong*/ dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab bo/ /dbang bskur ba dngos la/ khrus nas dbyung*/ de nas bgegs gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/

h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhū ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du ma cig khros ma nag mo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir gsang ba zab mo'i byin rlabs kyi dbang bskur bar byed pa la/ bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes drag sngags dang sum+bha ni'i sngags kyis bskrad la gtor ma gtong*/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ sngon chad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs bcing mdzod/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba bzung*/ slob dpon gyis zhwa chos bcas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bka' gsang bla na med pa gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dbang bskur zab mo legs par gsan nas/

tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs te/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba spyi dang khyad par phyin ci log tu gyur pa/ mi bsrun bdud kyi sde tshogs mtha' dag nyon mongs pa'i snang ba rtsad nas gcod de/ gdod ma'i kun bzang mkha' 'gro'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i thugs bskyed dang ldan pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod rnams legs par gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ bla ma sman pa dam chos sman dang ni/ /rang la nad pa'i 'du shes nyer bzhag ste/ /nan tan brtson pas sman nyid bsten tshul dang*/ /zhi bde nad las grol ba'i 'bras thob bzhin/ /bsten tshul gzhan rnams tshul des dpag byas la/ /dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi yis bsten par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ gang gsan bya'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ rgyal ba tshad med pa'i thugs rje mnga' ba rnams kyis gdul bya thar lam la 'dren par bya ba'i slad du/ chos kyi rnam grangs zab cing rgya che ba dag bka' bstsal la/ de dag thams cad kyang bsdu na rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du ba yin la/ de dag gnyis kyang 'bras bu sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su nges par gcig mod kyang*/ khyung dang bye'us gshog rtsal 'gran na myur khyad che ba ltar/ gsang sngags khyad chos du ma'i sgo nas/ khyad par du 'phags shing lam myur ba yin te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs shing*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bus khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsang sngags de nyid kyi 'jug sgo ni smin byed kyi dbang kho na ste/ dbang tshul bzhin du ma thob par ye shes lha'i bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor sogs bgyi ba'i skal ba dang nges par mi ldan la/ der ma zad gsang sngags kyi rgyud tshig zab mo klog pa dang phrin las gyi tshig shar du gyer ba'ang mi dbang ste/

dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ gang zhig rig sngags dbang bskur cho ga med/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang*/ /gang dag bya ba sems dang mi ldan par/ /de yis gsang sngags bklag na phung bar 'gyur/ ces gsungs pa bzhin/ thob pa'i phan yon ni bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sogs/ gsang sngags kyi zab lam rnams nyams su len pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing*/ sgrub pa la bar chod nyung ba dang*/ dngos grub ring min du 'thob pa sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa te/ klong gsal las/ dbang thob rigs kyi bu de nyid/ /tshe 'dir 'dod pa kun 'grub cing*/ /phyi ma mngon par rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ de lta bu'i dbang de nyid lha dang dkyil 'khor ji lta bu la bsten nas bskur ba'i tshul ni/ gsang sngags phyi nang dang rgyud sde gong 'og sogs mtha' klas par bzhugs pa las/ 'dir rang re bod yul du sngags gsar rnying gnyis su byung ba las/ gsar ma las khyad par drug gis 'phags par gyur pa snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ rnying ma de nyid la'ang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang ste brgyud pa'i bka' srol gsum du mchis pa las/ da lam zab mo gter ma'i ring lugs su gtogs pa yin/ gter ma de la'ang*/ gter ston dang gter kha'i rnam grangs ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs pa las/ 'di'i tshul kyang gzhung las/ e ma gsang ba chos bzhi las: ma cig jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi: ma 'ongs sprul par lung bstan pa: ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma dang : snye lam shel bza' sgrol gcig ma: bre 'tsham zhang lcam bo chung ma: zangs ri'i jo mo mkhar sgom ma: sna nam a phyi chos sgrol ma: kho mo bdag gi sprul pa 'byung : da lta'i gnubs ban dz+nyā na ba: yang mthar grogs bgyid yid la gcags: ma 'ongs rgyal ba don 'grub zhes: de la rim brgyud yang mtha' ru: gsang ba'i gcod mchog 'di 'byin pa: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa 'byung :

de dus zab chos 'di 'phrad shog: rgya 'di las kyi mkha' 'gros srungs: dur khrod tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma'i/ sku gsung thugs kyi sras mchog rgyal ba don 'grub zung gi ye shes sprul pa'i zlos gar/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis/ rab byung 12 pa'i me sprel lor/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong ngam/ bod yul mkha' 'gro tshogs khang chen mo grags pa nas ngo mtshar mig 'phrul lta bu rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa du ma dang bcas/ gdan drangs pa'i zab chos yum bka' gsang ba ye shes zhes ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i sprul gzhi yum chen rdo rje phag mo ste/ de'ang rdo rje theg pa'i lam dngos grub sgrub pa'i lha'i gtso bo ni rnal 'byor ma nyid yin te/ de'ang don la lha yab yum la bzang ngan med kyang*/ 'dag bya dag byed kyi dbang du byas na shes rab rtsa ba yin zhing*/ thabs yan lag yin pa dang*/ bde ba chen po yang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa'i sgrub dgos pa dang*/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral yang*/ pho nya mo rnams bdag gi rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa'i phyir/ mchog 'dod pa rnams kyi lhag pa'i lha'i gtso bo rdo rje phag mo dang*/ ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis dbyer med du sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dang bcas pa/ khyad par du zab lam snyan brgyud gcod kyi man ngag sogs zab cing rgya che ba bzhugs pa las/ da lam mkha' 'gro rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang bdag nyid kyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams deng 'dir/ bka' gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba yang gsang bla med shes rab ma rgyud/

don gyi theg pa rin po cher 'jug par las su rung phyir/ snang srid snod bcud bdag lus dang longs spyod ltos par bcas pa yongs su 'bul snyam pas zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug / de nas dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i don du phyag gi snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai maḥ dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid ma: ma cig jo mo mtsho rgyal mar: gus pas lus kyis phyag 'tshal lo: gdung bas ngag gis gsol ba 'debs: mos pa'i sems kyis skyabs su mchi: 'bral ba med par thugs rjes gzigs: 'bral med snying gi pad+mor bzhugs: bdag dang 'dir tshogs skal ldan la: ye shes mchog gi dbang bskur stsol/ lan gsum/ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor dang tha mi dad par/ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: bde chen rab dga' ye shes g.yo ba'i mchog: grol lam pho nya bde stong bskyed pa'i phyir: nyon mongs rab dben chags med zung 'jug can: mchog gi dpal mo'i sku la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ dga' ba rab g.yo mchog gi dga' ba ster: dga' bral lhan skyes dga' ba'i gzi 'od 'byin: dga' ma dbyangs can dpa' mo bsgrub pa'i phyir: dga' chen khyod bdag bsten par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar/ yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/ bla ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'dir gshegs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /bla med gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dge tshogs kun tu bzang po'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi spyan sngar/ phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ /bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas khyed rang rnams rnal 'byor ma'i grong du zhugs te/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma til gyi gong bu kha phye ba lta bu mthong bar gyur par mos la thal mo gnas gsum du reg ste 'di'i rjes zlos kyang mdzod/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ oṃ na ma mi hūm̐/ oṃ na mo na ma ye hūm̐ lan bzhi'i phyag bya/ khyod nyid rnal 'byor grong zhugs nas: rnal 'byor ma yi ye shes ni: gang yin khyod la sbyin byed na: de bdag rdo rje slob dpon gyi: dam tshig gang yin khyod kyis srungs: badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ gis dam tshig rdo rje snying gar reg / ji ltar bsgom pa las mi 'da' bar thugs kyi dam tshig yid kyis bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/

nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig / dam chu lce thog tu myong*/ de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par gcun te dam tshig pa'i lha sku 'di bzhin gsal thob cig oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ hoḥ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun thugs rje khros ma mthing nag khro zhing rab tu rngam pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ spyi gtsug tu phag zhal nag pos ngur sgra 'byin pa/ phyag g.yas pas zangs gri nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ mchan du rtse gsum gru mor brten cing rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyi spras shing*/ gcer mo bha ga dang nu ma rab tu rgyas pa/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar stabs ling nger yai shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs pa'i/ sku'i dbus su rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gsal ba'i lte bar g.yung drung dmar po grwa bzhi la ha ri ni sa lte bar baṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung*/ sum mdor ram̐ las me/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas rlung g.yos shing me sbar/ lte ba'i g.yung drung g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa ltar/ sib sib thim pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar ba'i mos pa mdzod/ man ngag las byung ba bzhin du ye shes 'bebs sbyor gyi rdzas sreg cing rol mo myur dal spel ma'i bskyar bas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bh+yoḥ mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs:

mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab dag pa'i zhing mchog nas: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: baṃ ri thod pa'i sku mkhar nas: rdo rje phag mo gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: nags tshal 'khrugs pa'i drwa ba nas: nyi zla dngos grub gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: u tsa la yi gnas mchog nas: khros ma nag mo gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: gtum drag tshal gyi dur khrod nas: bde chen dkar mo gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod nas: ser mo don grub gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: pad+ma 'khyil ba'i dur khrod nas: dmar mo sgra sgrogs gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: kī la kī la'i dur khrod nas: sna tshogs mthar phyin gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig:

dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas: rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: gtum drag tshang tshing dur khrod nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: kun grol tshal gyi pho brang nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing mchog nas: rig 'dzin rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: sprul pa rang rang gnas mchog nas: ma sring mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: 'phro 'du sa mtshams dur khrod nas: las byed nyid sprul gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur cig: dam tshig nyams pa gsos su gsol: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis rlobs: om̐ badz+ra yo gi ni ā yur+dz+nyā na su khaṃ pa shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ om̐ badz+ra wā ra hī kro ti ka li baṃ ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsā la ya sa ma ya hūm̐/

zhes pas ye shes pa dbab cing rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod pas de nyid brtan par bya'o/ /me tog 'dor ba ni/ sngar sprad pa'i me tog de nyid tshe rabs nas 'brel ba yod pa'i lha la bab par shog snyam pa'i mos pa dang*/ tshigs 'di'i rjes zlos bcas/ me tog dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dor bar zhu/ rnal 'byor ma yi dkyil 'khor du: rigs kyi me tog 'di dor bas: bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog: oṃ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐: me tog gang du babs pa'i lha de'i rigs su nges par byas nas me tog spyi bor bcings par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems ma stobs chen khyod kyis ni: bdag ni rab tu bzung bar mdzod: ces me tog spyi bor bzhag mdzod/ gser thur gyis mig dbye tshul dang bcas te/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer gser gyi thur ma ltar 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal ba'i mos shig tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ rnal 'byor ma'i phyi dang nang dang snying po'i dkyil 'khor rnams mthong bar gyur/ gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs la 'khod par mos la/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: rnal 'byor ma yi dkyil 'khor du: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dbang : de ring bdag la stsal du gsol: lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dpa' bo dang*/ dpa' mo rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu gar dang mchod pas mchod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing rnal 'byor gyi dbang mos/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur/
