bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa dbyings phyug rdo rje'i mkha': bdud rtsi gsang ba ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sku yi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ badz+ra wā ra hī kro ti ka li baṃ ha ri ni sa kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i kha rgyan gyi yal 'dab kyis bum chu spyi bor blug /de nas lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa'i nges shes brtan pa dang*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dngos su mos pa bskyed la/ de'i thugs rje'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi rgyud bskul ba'i shugs kyis/ snod bcud thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par bzhengs pa'i klong las/ sku'i rang bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo grangs med 'phros pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pas zhe sdang gi rtog pa sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas nas/ zhi ba'i las kun thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dpral bar bzhag cing*/ hūm̐: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: zhe sdang rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtsos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur sa: zhi ba'i las kun yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gsung gi rang bzhin pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo grangs med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas 'dod chags kyi rtog pa sbyangs/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ dbang gi las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: sor rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'dod chags rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtsos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang sdud phrin las yongs rdzogs shog:

oṃ pad+ma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gtso mo khros ma nag mo thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga grangs med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pas gti mug gi rtog pa sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mchog gi las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces snying khar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: gti mug rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtsos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yang dag ye shes mngon rdzogs shog: oṃ bud+dha ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi yon tan gyi rang bzhin mkha' 'gro ma ser mo grangs med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar thim pas nga rgyal gyi rtog pa sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rgyas pa'i las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces lte bar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: nga rgyal rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtsos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rgyas pa'i phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ rat+na ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi phrin las kyi rang bzhin mkha' 'gro ma ljang mo grangs med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gsang bar thim pas phrag dog gi rtog pa sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ drag po'i las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gsang bar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: phrag dog rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtsos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: drag po'i mngon spyod yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shar gyi sgo ma thogs la/ dkyil 'khor shar phyogs nas byams pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje shugs 'gro ma dkar sngon grangs med pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi dpung g.yas tshigs kyi 'khor lo la thim pas/

rtag par lta ba gnas su dag nas/ tshogs lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dpung g.yas su bzhag la/ hūm̐: byams pa tshad med ngo bo nyid: rtag par lta ba gnas dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: tshogs lam yongs su rdzogs par shog: oṃ ha badz+ra aṅku sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: lho'i sgo ma thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs nas snying rje'i rang bzhin rin chen shugs 'gro ma ser dmar grangs med pa 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpung g.yon tshigs kyi 'khor lo la thim pas/ chad par lta ba gnas su dag nas/ sbyor lam shes rab kyi rtsal rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dpung g.yon du bzhag la/ hūm̐: snying rje tshad med ngo bo nyid: chad par lta ba gnas dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sbyor lam theg chen yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ ri rat+na pa sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: nub kyi sgo ma thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas dga' ba'i rang bzhin pad+ma shugs 'gro ma dmar ljang grangs med 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi pus g.yas kyi 'khor lo la thim pas/ dngos por lta ba gnas su dag nas/ mthong lam phyir mi ldog pa'i bden pa mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pus mo g.yas su bzhag la/ hūm̐: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo nyid: dngos por lta ba gnas dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: theg chen mthong lam yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ ni pad+ma s+pho ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: byang gi sgo ma thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs nas btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin karma shugs 'gro ma ljang dkar grangs med 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi pus g.yon tshigs kyi 'khor lo la thim pas/ bdag tu lta ba gnas su dag nas/ sgom lam mthar phyin cing bstan srid zin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pus mo g.yon du bzhag la/ hūm̐: btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid: bdag tu lta ba gnas dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sgom lam mthar phyin yongs rdzogs shog:

oṃ sa karma ghaṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ phrin las bzhi'i bden pa tshad du phyin/ gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i rdzu 'phrul sku'i phyag rgya rdzogs pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbu gtsug rigs lnga'i zhing khams nas/ bde gshegs sku lnga rigs 'dus gu ru pad+ma thod phreng la/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing*/ byin rlabs gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas/ rigs thams kyi bdag nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso mo chen mor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rigs bdag spyi bor dbang bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin kun dngos mchog: nyon mongs dug lnga zhi mdzad pa/ /rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng gis/ /skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas/ lus tha mal du 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ mchog gi dngos grub la mnga' brnyes shing*/ 'bras bu sprul sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /des phyi mtshan ma sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus smin par byas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa lnga ldan sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ ces rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dang*/ kha ṭ+waṃ' ga yab kyi rnam par gnas gyur ba dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rjes su chags pa'i mes bde ba'i ngo bor 'od du zhu ba/ rdo rje slob dpon he ru ka yab yum gyi gsang ba'i gnas nas byung ba'i/

byang sems dang lhan cig thod pa'i nang du bskyil ba la/ ngo bo bde ba chen po thabs shes shu kra dang si la/ rnam pa ā li kā li yi ge'i phreng ba rang gi lce a yig las byung bas/ zla ba'i steng du gnas pa byang sems su zhu bas/ stong ra rtsa gsum 'khor lo lngar khyab mnyam du gang bas/ rtsa thig rlung gsum las rung du smin te gsang ba'i dbang thob par gyur/ hoḥ 'das pa'i rdo rje can sogs pas: ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur: de bzhin byang chub sems bzang pos: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa sarba karma hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces thod pa'i bdud rtsi myang zhing*/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag smin par byas/ rdzogs rim rtsa thig rlung gsum gsang sngags zab mor bsnyen pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje'i bden don bcu gnyis longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ ces rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las 'od zer 'phros te lte ba'i a shad la phog /tsaṇ+ḍa lī nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyen du 'bar ba'i rtse mo thabs bde ba chen po'i ham̐ yig la phog /bdud rtsi ba mo lta bur 'dzag pas rim pa bzhin spyi mgrin snying kha lte ba rnams su/ dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral/ zag med lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste lugs 'byung gi bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar byas/ slar yang lus kyi gnad dang rlung bcings pas/ byang chub sems kyi mas brtan dang yas bab kyis drangs pas lugs 'byung ldog gi dga' ba rnams nyams su myong ste/ thig rlung sems gsum gtsug tor du brtan par byas pas 'dzag pa dang bral ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur par mos la/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba gsum gyi ngang : maṇ+ḍal ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas:

thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sin+dhu ra lte bar byug / de ltar sin+dhu ra rdo rje ye shes chos sku'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems smin par byas/ pho nya zhu bde bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i gseng lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje dga' ba bcu drug rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ ces rtogs pa bskyed/ dbang dus su skyes pa'i zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i bde ba chen po/ ji ltar nyi ma dang mar me nor bu'i 'od ltar/ dag cing gsal ba'i ye shes dri ma med pa'i snying po kun tu rtog pa'i rlung gis mi bskyod pa de ni rnal 'byor ma'i/ ye shes kyi ngo bo 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas te/ de nyams su len pa la khyed rang rnams kyis lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas/ lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nger zhog cig / ces mnyam par bzhag tu gzhug / de ltar bzhag pas sems zhes bya ba gzugs dbyibs kha dog dngos po mtshan ma can du ma grub pas/ rtag pa'i mtha' las grol ba chos sku blo 'das ye nas stong pa/ de'i mdangs ma 'gags pa 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad shar ba'i gzhir gyur pas na/ chad pa'i mtha' las grol ba/ rang bzhin gsal la mi dmigs pa rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral bas/ ka dag tu rdzogs pa'i rig pa bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i ngang la mi g.yo bar mdzad 'tshal/ zhes man shel thogs la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid: ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dz+nyā na hrī da hūm̐:

zhes snying khar bzhag la/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ de kho na nyid rab tu spros med a ti rig rtsal gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum gyi sdig ltung shes bya'i dri ma dang bcas pa sbyangs/ lam ka dag dang lhun grub bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gnyis pa brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ dbyings rigs dbyer med kyi lta ba/ skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'ims len/ khams gsum zil gnon gyi dgongs pa/ bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab rnams kyi rtsal sbyong zhing*/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas phyi nang gi dur khrod nyul nas rang byung ye shes btsan thabs su spar bas/ gzugs can gzugs med kyi 'gro ba'i don byed nus pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa la/ tha mal gyi chas gos spangs te mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa'i phyir rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ chas rdzas rnams gnas so sor bgos par mos mdzod/ rus pa'i rgyan drug ang rag sgom thag dom ra rnams thogs la/

mkha' 'gro kun gyi legs byin pa'i/ /rgyan dang brda skad de bzhin nyid/ /dbang sdud bden med ston pa'i sgras/ /dpa' bo chen por dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /pha rol phyin drug mtshan ma'i rgyan/ /'di nyid thogs la bdud rnams chod/ /rgyan dang phyag rgyas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma hā ḍāk+ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes rus pa'i rgyan drug bskon/ de nas dbyings rig bsre ba ni/ khyed rang rnams deng phyin chad thog bcas yul gyi snang ba la bden zhen dang bral bas mi phod pa brdzi zhing*/ 'drer 'dzin chags sdang dang skyo 'jigs kyi/ rtog pa gang shar gyi rjes su mi 'brang bar thabs shes zung 'brel gyi yi ge phaṭ ces brjod cing*/ phyi snang ba la dngos por zhen pa'i bdud kyi 'khri ba btsan thabs su bcad/ rig gdangs dbyings su bsres te phung po gzan du bskyur/ dbyings rig dbyer med snang stong 'dzin med kyi ngang skyong ba la rgyun du 'bad 'tshal zhing*/ skabs 'dir khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa byang chub sems/ tha mal shes pa'i rang ngo dran bsam 'phro 'du'i rtog pa med pa'i ngang las ma bcos ma bslad par bzhag /rtog pa 'gyu na gang shar la cer gyis bltas pas rjes med rang grol 'gags med kyi 'char sgo/ skye med zang thal gyi rtsal snang sgyu ma lta bu gsal stong 'dzin med kyi don shes par mdzod cig phaṭḥ lan gsum brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi nang phung po'i 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod par byed pa yin la/ de'ang ma cig gis/ bem rig phral la dbyings rig bsre/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang gi rnam par shes pa thig le dmar gsal bya ma sar gyi sgo nga tsam du gyur/ phaṭ/ yar 'phar snying gar/ phaṭ/ mgrin par/ phaṭ/ ces brjod pa dang spyi bo nas thon te skar mda' 'gyu ba bzhin gyen du song*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun gsang ba ye shes gri thod 'dzin ma'i sku ru lam gyis song bar gyur/

phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ de nas bem lus ljon shing gi rtsa ba chad pa bzhin gan rkyal du 'gyel ba la/ rang nyid khros ma'i gri khug gis thod pa ling gis bkog /sku gsum gyi rang bzhin mi mgo'i sgyed pu ri rab tsam gsum gyi steng du bkod nas/ slar bam ro gri khug gi rtse mos blangs te thod par 'phang bas stong gsum gyi khyon tsam gyur/ 'og gi a thung las me 'bar/ thod pa dros/ bdud rtsi khol bas rlangs pa haṃ yig la phog /de'i steng du sku gsum gyi yi ge dang haṃ yig zhu ba las/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa rnams gcig tu 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mchod sbyin 'dod yon mi zad pa'i gter du gyur par mos mdzod/ de nas bem rig phral te bem tshogs bsre la sgyu lus tshogs su 'bul ba ni/ phaṭ/ bem po sha khrag bdud rtsi'i ngo bo ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan stong gsum kun khengs gyur: phaṭḥ phaṭḥ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod sbyin gyi yul du gyur pa rnams la phul zhing byin pas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis dag /bdag 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod cing*/ bdag med yum gyi don rtogs nas don gnyis lhun grub phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ phaṭḥ rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum phrag rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: gter bdag gzhi bdag ma lus rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: rigs drug snying rje'i yul gyur rnams/ bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: khyad par gnyan sa dur khrod 'dir/ gnas pa'i dregs pa che phra dang : 'byung po'i ming nas ma smos sogs: khyab par rgyu ba ma lus rnams: baṃ chen tshogs la dgyes par rol:

phud bdag rnams kyis phud bzhes shig: tshogs bdag rnams kyis tshogs bzhes shig: lhag sdud rnams kyis lhag sdus shig: sha 'dod rnams kyis sha zo la: khrag 'dod rnams kyis khrag 'thungs shig: rus 'dod rnams kyis rus 'cho la: skra nyag tsam yang med par mdzod: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ da ni khyed rang rnams brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa lam du slong zhing*/ gnyis snang bdag 'dzin gyi bdud chom ste/ gnyis med ye shes kyi ngang las ma g.yos par bya ba'i phyir/ brtul zhugs kyi chas dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig / thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnams lag tu bzhag /sha lnga bdud rtsi sogs la rol du gzhug la/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis: tha mal zhen pa legs ldog ste: rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor los bsgyur: phyag rgya lnga yi rgyan dang bcas: thabs kyi gzugs kyi cang te'u: shes rab de ni rang byung sgra: rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje bcas: gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang : yul chen sum cu rtsa gnyis su: mkha' 'gro rnams dang skal mnyam par: pad snod bdud rtsi'i bza' btung dang : skye bdun bam chen gsang ba'i rdzas: 'khor lo'i 'du bar rnam spyod pas: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi: 'dzin rtog thams cad rab spangs la: nang gi de nyid dang ldan pas: brtul zhugs spyod pas rgyu bar gyis: bsad dang gsod dang rengs pa dang : dbang bsgyur nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis: rang gi rtogs pa slar spar zhing : skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa dang : 'byung po gdug pa can rnams sgrol: gzhan yang phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i: dpa' mo'i brtul zhugs 'di la ni: mi bya cung zad yod min gyis: mi 'jigs pa yi spyod pa spyad: de nas dngos grub kyi bam ro sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs bza' btung gi dam tshig rnams sbyin la/ oṃ ma hā ḍāk+ki nī wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bam tshogs gtub cing rol tu gzhug /de ltar phung po'i gces 'dzin btang zhing sgyu lus tshogs mchod du phul ba la brten nas/

tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis dag /bdag med gnas lugs kyi lta ba khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos mdzod cig /'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /don dam stong nyid snying rje'i don/ /don 'di bsgom zhing bdud rnams chod/ /chos nyid don gyis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma hā ḍāk+ki nī tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ 'di ltar phyi'i rkyen la ma ltos par rang gi rig pa rang 'tsho mi thub par/ dga' sdug skrag sngangs sogs thog med yul du re dogs kyi rtog pa sna tshogs su 'gyu ba'i mkhan po/ nang 'dzin pa sems nyid bdud du 'khrul ba'i gzhi rtsa bcad nas/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug skye med spros bral gyi rang bzhin gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ hoḥ rang rig gi ngo bo ka dag 'di: rje btsun gyi rgyal po pad+ma 'byung : zung 'jug gi rang bzhin dbyangs can ma: thabs shes kun ye nas 'du 'bral med: snod bcud kun gnyis su mi lta zhing : phan byed kyi lha dang gnod byed bgegs: rjes shes kyi dran pa so mar zhog: zhe sdang 'di rtsa bral me long la: chu zla ltar sgyu ma shes par gyis: nga rgyal gyi khengs pa mnyam pa nyid: gnas lugs la bdag gzhan ris med spyod: gti mug kun mtshan bral 'od gsal la: kun gzhi la 'khor 'das ga la yod: 'dod chags kun so sor don rtogs nas: chags bya dang chags byed med par spyod: phrag dog ces mtshan 'dzin ji ltar grub: gnas gdon 'dis 'gro kun bya ba grub: phyi yul gyi tshogs drug lha 'dre rnams: rang sems kyi cho 'phrul yin par shes: sngon dbang gi las la grub pa yi: rnam rtog gi lha 'dre a 'thas rnams: rtsa bral gyi shes pa gtan la phob: tshe rabs su 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshogs: da lan du yang dag don rtogs nas: bzang 'dzin gyi lha la mi re zhing : ngan 'dzin gyi bdud la mi dogs par: dri med kyi rig pa gtan la phob:

srid rtse nas mnar med yan chod kyi: dbyings rig gi sbubs su 'khod pa rnams: nges don gyi gcod yul don rtogs nas: drang don gyi dmigs gtad mi 'tshal bar: snod gzugs kun gcig dril thim nas kyang : skye med kyi rig pa a dkar de: zung 'jug gi yab yum mkha' brgyud nas: stong nyid kyi rtsol med lam zhugs te: zang thal du kun bzang mkha' ru thim: 'khrul med kyi mngon sangs rgyas par shog: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ ces don dam gcod yul gyi dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag tu gzhug /ḍā ma ru dang dril bu thogs la/ thabs shes kha sbyor zung 'jug 'gags pa med pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i ḍā ma ru/ phyag g.yas su gtad pas snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las lhun gyis 'grub pa'i brdar bzung zhing 'khrol bar mdzod/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i sgra/ /sgra 'di sgrog cing bdud rnams chod/ /cang te'u sgra yis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma hā ḍāk+ki nī gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes pas cang te'u dkrol du gzhug cing khams gsum dbang sdud kyi dgongs pa bskyang*/ 'di ltar sna tshogs su snang ba'i dngos po bden par zhen cing*/ bzang rtog la chags sems/ gces 'dzin dga' brod dang*/ yul snang lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul gyis bslu ba'i bdud/ yul dang yul can gnyis med 'dzin bral rig pa rang so thub pa'i dbang du sdud cing zil gyis gnon pa'i nyams len du khyer mdzod/ rkang gling thogs la/ skye med kyi brda ston pa'i gling bu 'di bus la gnyis snang gi chos thams cad gnyis med gdod nas ma skyes/ ye mnyam rang grol dus mnyam du shes pa'i brtul zhugs kyi rgyas 'debs lam du lhongs par gyis shig 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /snang srid bden med ston pa'i skad/ /skad 'di bsgyur zhing bdud rnams chod/ /mi rkang gling bus dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma hā ḍāk+ki nī karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

zhes pas rkang gling 'bud du gzhug /snang srid bden med rtogs pa'i nyams bskyang*/ 'di ltar chos thams cad gdod nas skye 'gags dang bral ba'i don ma shes pas/ bdag gzhan spang blang bde sdug gi snang char zhen pa'i re dogs snyems byed/ gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bdud kyi gzhi rtsa skye med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi gang shar 'dzin med rang grol du bden med sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i ngo bor lam du khyer mdzod cig / brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang ngo*/ de nas mtha' rten du byin rlabs bka' bsgo ba ni/ gcod ḍām dril bu rkang gling g.yang gzhi sogs kyis brab cing*/ phaṭḥ na moḥ chos sku yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes: bde chen las kyi dbang mo: ḍāk+ki nyi zla dngos grub: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: gu ru shrī singha: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: pha brgyud pad+ma 'byung gnas: ma brgyud ye shes mtsho rgyal: sras brgyud sangs rgyas ye shes: ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma/ sras mchog rgyal ba don 'grub/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje/ lung zin ār+ya dh+wa dza/ sogs gcod yul brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ chos sku mthing 'od 'bar ma: longs sku rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: sprul sku seng gdong drag mo: rdo rje bde chen dkar mo: rin chen ser mo don 'grub: pad+ma dmar mo sgra sgrogs: karma sna tshogs mthar phyin: bud+dha khros ma nag mo: gter srung dbang gi ḍāk+ki la sogs pa: grub thob gcod yul brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: rgyu ma rig pa gti mug: lam 'dod chags kyi 'khri ba: 'bras bu zhe sdang gi khong khro: rkyen tshe rabs kyi lan chags: nad gdon bgegs srin dang 'byung po'i cho 'phrul: 'byung 'khrug rlung mkhris dang bad kan 'dus pa bzhi: gdon pho gdon mo 'dre gza' klu rgyal po la sogs pa rnams gcod yul gdams pa zab mo 'di la brten nas:

da lta nyid du zhi bar mdzod cig: myur ba nyid du zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol: thogs bcas bdud las rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs shig: thogs med bdud la bsre nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: rkyen thog tu ro snyom nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: snang ba bdud gcod nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: re dogs spang blang zad nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: snang ba sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs shig: pho gdon gyis chos sku thob par byin gyis rlobs shig: mo gdon gyis longs sku thob par byin gyis rlobs shig: spyi gdon gyis sprul sku thob par byin gyis rlobs shig: lha 'dre'i 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: gnyan sa ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs shig: dgra gnyen gyi phyogs ris bral bar byin gyis rlobs shig: tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig: 'ja' lus chos skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig: gcod yul bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig: lus la sku yis byin gyis rlobs shig: ngag la gsung gis byin gyis rlobs shig: yid la thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs shig: mchog thun gyi 'bras bu 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de dag gis dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub bo/ / de nas dam tshig 'bog pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma yi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: phyi dang nang gsang de nyid kyi ni dam tshig rnams: khyod kyis deng nas 'tsho ba'i srog bzhin rnam bzung la: rnal 'byor ma yi go 'phang mchog la blo chen gzhan yang sbyor bar gyis: zhes bsgo bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar? de nas dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa ltos med du bla ma la phul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol/ dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams? sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ gsam̐ng bam̐ sngags bdag ye shes ḍām̐k+kim̐ yi/ /thugs kyi ti ka yim̐d bzhim̐n nom̐r bu mchom̐g /rnal 'byor smim̐n byem̐d gsaṃng sngaṃgs khyad chos rmad/ /bstaṃn pa 'dziṃn skyong spel ba'i btsas su bkral/ de dag ni zhe gcig pa mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes thugs rje khros ma lha lnga'i dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ zhe gnyis pa zab yangs nam mkha'i chos sde las/ mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru kho bos bgyis pa zur gsal ltar bskur// //

༈ zhe gsum pa dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo'i las mtha' las byung ba'i sme brtsegs kyi byab khrus rgyud don rnam dag gter chen nyid kyi thugs sras rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i chog khrigs bzhin 'dir bya bar 'thad pas de bzhin du bya'o// // ༈ gsam̐ng bam̐ lhan skyes yem̐ shem̐s skyed mdzad pa/ /rdo rje mkha' spyod rnal 'byor ḍam̐k+kim̐ mam̐'i/ /sgrub thabs bde chen gsang lam la brten nas/ /smim̐n byem̐d cho ga bgyis tshul 'dir bsdeb bya/ zhe bzhi pa mkha' spyod gsang ba ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas 'ja' lus chos sku sgrub thabs bde chen gsang lam gyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po yar mar tshes bcu sogs dus khyad par can la stegs bur ba yi rnam lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams chang dang sbyar nas byug /de'i steng du rdul tshon gyis chos 'byung dmar po gnyis bsnol bya/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyi rim sgo rdzogs dur khrod dang me ris bskor ba'i lte bar bam̐ yig bris pa'i steng du/ thod pa dum gcig bdud rtsis gang ba'i khar me long la sin+dhu ra'i chos 'byung lte bar bam̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba'i zur gsum du g.yung drung 'khyil ba re re bris pas 'gog /de'i steng du mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor tsaklis brgyan pa'i steng nas dar dmar po'i gdugs phub/ g.yas su rnam rgyal bum par lnga phrag gi rdzas dang gtsang ma'i chu yis sum gnyis bkang ba chas ldan dang*/ mthar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta/ rang mdun rdor dril thod rnga sogs dang*/ gzhan yang tshogs rdzas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bcas 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la stan bde bar rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs par 'dug ste/ gzhung gi las byang bstod pa'i mthar bskyal/ dzap khang dbye bas bdag mdun dus gcig tu gsal btab la/

rang gi snying gar zla steng bam̐ yig dmar/ /de mthar sngags phreng pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /g.yon du 'khor la 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ /rgyal ba kun mchod skye 'gro'i las sgrib sbyangs/ /bde gshegs mthu dpal bcud kyi dwangs ma dang*/ /skye 'gro'i tshe bsod dregs sde'i nus mthu kun/ /'od kyi rnam par drangs te thugs kar thim/ /sngags phreng rang sgra dang bcas bar med 'khor/ dmigs pa dang bcas rtsa sngags ci rigs bzla/ de mthar thun bsdu ba sogs gzhung las shes/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ slar yang bdag bskyed zhal nas sngags phreng 'phros/ /mdun bskyed zhal zhugs thugs kar bam̐ yig mthar/ /drag tu g.yon 'khor rang gi thugs kar thim/ /'gal me'i phreng ba lta bur bar med 'khor/ / zhes pas mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya/ yang ni bum bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros/ /bum lha'i thugs kar bam̐ mthar sngags g.yon 'khor/ /sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa kheng*/ bzlas pa ci rigs byas rjes bum pa gshegs/ bum lha 'od zhu chu dang dbyer med gyur/ tshogs mchod dang skong bshags sogs gzhung ltar bya/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs shing bum chu dang thod pa'i bdud rtsi lcer myang*/ gsum pa slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa la/ gral du 'khod cing khrus byas shing bgegs bskrad de/ 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo'i dbang bskur zhu snyam pa'i mos pa brtan pas ma yengs par gsan par zhu/ de la gsan bya'i chos ni rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ de'ang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa la 'jug cing tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs smin byed gyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lam gnyis las/

'dir skabs su bab pa smin byed dbang gi rim pa las/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs kun/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad par bya/ /de la smin byed dbang bskur yang*/ /bla ma'i brgyud pa ma nyams shing*/ /cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur par/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /sku bzhi'i rten 'brel 'grigs mkhyen pa'i/ /bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blang*/ /zhes dang*/ sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes/ /cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas/ /snying rjes slob ma rab 'dzin pa/ /dbang bskur pa yi slob dpon mchog /ces bskur byed bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul/ /rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan/ /sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba/ /mthun zhing grangs dang ldan par bzung*/ /zhes bskur gnas slob ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /de la'ang rgyud sde mtha' yas par bzhugs pa'i nang nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la snga 'gyur rnying ma dang*/ phyi 'gyur gsar mar grags pa gnyis las/ 'di ni snga 'gyur rnying ma'i lugs so/ /de la'ang bka' gter gnyis las gter ma yin te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam las dngos grub sgrub pa'i nye lam ni rdo rje phag mo nyid yin la/ de'ang don du lha yab yum la bzang ngan med kyang 'dag bya dag byed kyi dbang du byas na shes rab rtsa ba yin zhing thabs yan lag yin pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'ang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pas bsgrub dgos pa dang*/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral yang pho nya mo rnams bdag gi slob dpon du 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa rnams kyi lhag pa'i lha'i gtso bo ni rdo rje phag mo nyid yin la/ de la'ang bka' srol ji snyed las/ khyad par du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus su dmigs nas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang lo pan rje blon rnams la snyan brgyud du gdams pa/

mtsho rgyal nyid kyi gter byang las/ tshe gcig 'ja' lus lam la gshegs pa yi: zab lam mtsho rgyal bdag la gdams pa 'di: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i man ngag ste: kun gyi nang nas yang bcud khyad par 'phags: kho mo bdag gi snying khrag dum bu nyid: brda ru ma btab ring phan tsit+tar sbas: ci phyir zhe na ma 'ongs skal ldan ni: nye ba'i thugs sras lo tsā'i dwangs ma nyid: sangs rgyas ye shes rgyal tshab bu la gdams: mi brjed ri mor brda yi yi ger gzugs: gsang rgya brda yi sgrom bu'i dbus su bskyil: mchims phu 'di yi ke'u tshang du sbos: sngags bdag las kyi ma mor gnyer byang gtod: ma 'ongs nyi shu'i yang mtha' la nye dus: sa rtags dus dang lung bstan shar ba'i tshe: skyes bu khyed nyid ma nges tshul bzung nas: sgrib med mkha' la dus bdag 'gyu ba bzhin: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling zhes yongs grags nas: rgya bod khams kun gdul bya'i zhing gyur te: 'brel tshad don ldan 'gro mang thal sbyar 'dus: smon lam dbang gis brda der mngon nas su: yang zab snying thig 'di nyid 'don par gyis: zhes lung bstan pa ltar gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sprul pa rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas/ bsam yas mchims phu nas spyan drangs pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub pa 'ja' lus chos sku mngon sum du ston pa'i nye lam chen mo ste/ gzhung las/ 'di nyid shin tu gsang rgya gnyan pa'i phyir: gcig nas gcig tu snyan las brgyud pa gces: snod gtsang ma yin dam med skal ngan la: dpe thos gdams pa tsam yang bstan mi rung : zhes sogs phan yon rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i zab lam chig brgyud kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ chos sku yum chen mo/ longs sku mthing 'od 'bar ma/ sprul sku rdo rje phag mo/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa/

mkhas grub rat+na singha/ dkon mchog bstan rgyal nas/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams/ gdams ngag gi drod ma yal/ mi bar khyis ma chod/ brgyud pa nye la dngos grub myur ba'i gdams pa zab mo zhu bar byed pa la bla ma nyid rdo rje phag mo dang dbyer med pa la maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ mdun mkhar bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la skyabs su 'gro zhing sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i duḥkha las skyob pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas skyabs yul 'gro ba'i mgon: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bdag gi dge 'dis ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: 'ja' lus go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs gsum/ de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub ste dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig / slob ma rnams la las bum gyi chus bran/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsangs? swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i steng du bam̐ yig dmar ser las khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ sku pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma rgyas pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis chags pa'i gar stabs can/ khro 'dzum sma ra dang smin ma me ltar 'bar ba thod skam dang rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa'i gseb tu phag zhal mthing nag phem sgra ngur ba/ dar dmar po'i cod pan dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang dril bu'i g.yer khas sgra sgrog pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba se ral khar 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs gdu bu 'phyang ba/ g.yas pas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bhan+dha dang kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten cing gcer mo nu ma dang bha ga rgyas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs pa/

phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang cha lugs gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'i gtso 'khor kun gyi gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing dang gnas yul dur khrod brgyad sogs rang rang gi gnas nas kha char babs pa ltar byon nas/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par gyur/ thod rnga dang rol mo bya/ byi la nag po'i brun/ bdud rtsi lnga/ lce dang rkang lag gi nywa bzhi'i sha/ ba glang gi spu'am rang gi skra rnams gu gul dang sbyar ba'i dud pa bdug cing*/ ma mi min ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dbus sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: nub pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: byang las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: mtshams 'jig rten rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma gnas 'dir byon la byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i sprin phung thibs se thib: byin rlabs char rgyun na ra ra: mos gus 'bras bu chi li li: thabs kyi rgyan cha khro lo lo: shes rab nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru: brda 'gros gar stabs khrigs se khrig: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: mos pa'i bu la 'ja' lus stsol: oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni a yur+dz+nyā na hri da ya sid+dhi a be sha ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nyid mi nyams shing brtan par bya ba'i phyir du tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: rdo rje spyi bor bzhag: dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐ baṃ: dri med pad+ma rak+ta'i bcud: 'di 'thung zag med dga' bzhi 'char: dam med rnams kyi snying khrag skem: de bas dam srung sa ma ya: de nas dbang dngos zhu ba'i don du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs gsang ba'i dbyings phyug yum: dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i ma: yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor mas: 'ja' lus chos sku'i dbang mchog stsol:

lan gsum/ bum pa thogs la/ dang po sku bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ bum pa 'di nyid phyi ltar rang byung ye shes lnga ldan gyi gzhal yas khang*/ nang ltar gsang ba ye shes lha lnga'i ngo bo ste/ dbang bskur bas spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol nas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bum pa rang byung ye shes gzhal yas khang : bum bcud gsang ba ḍāk+ki sde lnga ste: deng 'dir skal ldan slob mar dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni a yur+dz+nyā na hri da ya sid+dhi kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ bum pa mgor bzhag la bum chu sbyin/ des bum pa'i dbang thob lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so/ / bhan+dha thogs la/ gnyis pa gsung gsang ba'i dbang la bhan+dha 'di nyid phyi ltar na gsang ba ḍāk+ki yum gyi tshogs khang gi gzhal yas khang*/ nang ltar na bcud 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma ste/ dbang bskur bas mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol nas 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen snang srid 'byung ba'i snod: bcud ni gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki lngas: deng 'dir skal ldan slob mar dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gag med gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni a yur+dz+nyā na hri da ya sid+dhi wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ bhan+dha mgrin par bzhag la bdud rtsi sbyin/ des grags stong bde ba chen po thob pas ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang bar byas so/ / me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor thogs la/ gsum pa thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la gsal stong 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid phyi ltar na spros bral dri med rjen pa chos nyid mngon sum gyi rnam par snang la ngos bzung dang bral ba/ nang ltar na ka dag zang thal ris med du 'gyu ba rang byung rang shar rang grol te de ltar ngo sprad cing dbang bskur bas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol nas 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hūm̐: snang zhing gsal la stong zhing 'gag pa med: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan slob mar dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni ā yur+dz+nyā na hri da ya sid+dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ me long snying gar bzhag la/ des thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ 'bras bu bde ba chen po chos kyi sku 'grub par byas so/ / gtor ma thogs la/ bzhi pa gtor mas dbang bskur ba la phyi ltar gtor snod bhan+dha gzhal yas khang chen po/ nang ltar sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ gsang ba ltar mkha' 'gro rigs lnga dang gnyis su med pa ste/ dbang bskur bas 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa mdud grol nas 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: gtor snod bhan+dha rang byung chos kyi dbyings: gtor ma 'dod yon rnam dag ye shes lnga: mkha' 'gro sku lnga bde chen 'du 'bral med: rnam dag bdud rtsi lnga ldan rang byung rdzas: gnyis med dbyings su dam tshig gnyen por bsre: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba dang : sprul pa mang po las la 'gyed pa'i phyir: dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni ā yur+dz+nyā na hri da ya sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

gtor ma gnas lngar bzhag / des dbang bzhi pa thob pas 'bras bu de kho na nyid a ti bla med bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so/ / rgyas par bka' bsgo bya/ bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ des ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba ye shes kyi dbang bzhi khyad par can thob pa'i gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lan gsum/ dbang bskur zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzungs nas su/ /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /rjes chog gzhung ltar bya'o/ /gsam̐ng bam̐ mkham̐' spyodam̐ sgrubam̐ pa'i thabam̐s/ /bde chen ye shes lam gyi mchog /gsaṃng sngaṃgs ma rgyud 'dus pa'i dbang*/ /bstanaṃ bzhin 'dziṃn na don ldan nges/ de dag ni zhe bzhi pa mkha' spyod gsang ba ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas 'ja' lus chos sku sgrub thabs bde chen gsang lam gyi dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ zhe lnga pa bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi dbang in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong bklag pas rnam grol zhes skyid grong pa rig 'dzin hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul gyi chog khrigs bzhin mthar chags su bskur/ ༈ zhe drug pa byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun bklag chog tu bkod pa byad kyi sprin nag gzhom pa'i rdo rje'i 'thor rlung kho bo'i bsgrigs chog ltar bya/

༈ smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen las/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung dam can chos skyong gi skor la/ snying rje'i dbang phyug gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul las/ /lem̐gs shar dpal ldam̐n ye shes mgom̐n pom̐ zhes/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i gtso bo nag po che'i/ /phrin las dbam̐ng bskur bklag chom̐g 'di na bsdeb/ zhe bdun pa bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ legs ldan mgon po'i dbang bskur bsdus pa bklag chog tu bkod pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor dang*/ dbang bzhi brtsegs mar bkod pa'i g.yas g.yon gang bder/ spyan ras gzigs/ sku 'bag /phyag mtshan/ gdong bzhi pa/ ma ning*/ phyag drug pa/ bram gzugs/ khro mo bzhi/ sngags phreng*/ me long dang shel rdo/ dur khrod chas brgyad/ rdo rje/ phur pa/ gzungs ma/ man shel/ bla rdo srog 'khor/ gtor 'bul/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang sngon gtor sogs 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gzhung las/ las byang gzhung bsrang tshogs bcas grub pa'i rjes: dngos gzhi dbang la 'jug par byed pa ni: slob mar khrus bstsal mdun du gral la 'god: bgegs bskrad bgyis nas sngon 'gro'i chab kyang gtong : zhes gsungs pas go bar nus la/ thog mar khrus bstsal pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi?

gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug / steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ ༈ lo rgyus kyi 'khyogs mtshams ni/ de nas lo rgyus cung zad snyan du gsol na/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ sgrub sde bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi cha lag dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mgon po'i sgrub thabs dang*/ phrin las mngon spyod kyi las tshogs rab 'byams su bzhugs pa las/ 'di ni ye shes kyi mgon po zhes bya ba ma bcos gdod nas rang byung he ru ka'i rigs don la thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid yin yang*/ rnam pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sprul pa gang la gang 'dul de la der ston gyi cho 'phrul/

rgyal ba'i bstan srung yongs kyi rgyal po dpal ye shes kyi mgon po zhes/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang mdo rgyud thams cad las ches cher bsngags shing*/ rig 'dzin grub pa yongs kyi phrin las kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i dpal ldan mgon po'i dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de'ang bdag nyid kyi bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas sngon 'gro skyabs sems sdom bzung rnams chabs cig tu sgrub pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma lha dang dbyer med pa 'phags mchog thugs rje'i rnam rol dpal mgon srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ dgongs klong zab gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i chos nyid du mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ phyag 'tshal ba saugs bsags sbyang so so'i 'dun pa dang*/ phyi ltar so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang ltar gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom gsum cig car du nod cing bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: phar phyin drug la slob sdom bzung : ma bsgral bsgral zhing ma sgrol sgrol: dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god: ces lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung*/

skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas khyod rang rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos shig /de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par dbang bskur gyi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bla med gsang sngags che ba'i mchog: dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag nyid: deng nas mgon po'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag yang dag 'jug par stsol: ces pa'i lan du slob dpon gyi ngag la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ kyaiḥ khyed rnams las sad skal bar ldan: bla med dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra dkon: snod ldan lags na dbang bskur 'tshal: dam tshig 'bog phyir rdo rje mna' chu sbyin pa la slob dpon gyis dung zhal gzar bu phyag tu thogs nas/ hūm̐: 'di ni gsang ba'i dam tshig chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: ma bsrung rdo rje dmyal bar ltung : de bas dam tshig dran par gyis: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par bcun te dam tshig pa'i lha sku 'di bzhin gsal thob cig: oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ hoḥ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas par mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis e mthing nag 'bar ba'i rang bzhin: me ri kha dog lnga ldan gyi dbus su: pad+ma nyi zla ro'i gdan la khyed rang rnams che mchog ye shes kyi mgon po: sku mdog nag po shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can: sgeg cing sbom la gsus pa che ba: khro zhing seṅge'i g.yang gzhi gsol ba: g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang ral gri: g.yon gnyis kyis thod khrag dang rtse gsum bsnams pa: g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa:

de'i pang du yum mchog lha mo dpal 'bar mas: gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud pa: yab yum me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: spyi bor rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs yab yum la 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bzhi: dpral bar gdong bzhi pa: mgrin par phyag drug pa: snying khar hūm̐ yig sngags phreng : lte bar ma ning nag po: gsang bar dur khrod bdag po bram ze'i gzugs can: yan lag bzhir rigs kyi yum bzhi: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i: spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog cing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: 'og min chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong chen po nas: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs te slob ma la thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: ye shes mgon po gshegs su gsol: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol: legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol: mgon chen sde lnga gshegs su gsol: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya: sa pa ri wā ra he dza dza dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: spyi bor rdo rje bzhag / de dag gis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub ste dngos gzhi dbang bskur zhu ba'i ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ ye shes mgon po nag po yi: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol: ces zhus pa'i lan gdab pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/

hoḥ bla med ye shes ston pa'i phyir: dbang dang rab tu gnas par bya: dngos gzhi la bum gsang shes rab tshig gi dbang dang mtha' rten chos skyong bka' gtad bcas lnga yod pas/ dang po la'ang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang lnga/ dang po phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum dbang*/ nang nus pa 'jug par lha sngags rig pa'i dbang dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po bum dbang gi slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du ye shes mgon po gtso 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag gtor zhing dbang bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la blugs pa'i bya ba mthar phyin par mos shig / de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub bum pa ru: bla med mgon po'i lha tshogs bzhugs: bum chu bskyed rim gsal stong ngang : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa 'phros nas slob ma'i spyi bor thim pas snang ba thams cad gsal stong lha'i dkyil 'khor du 'char ba'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag par gyur/ de nas spyan ras gzigs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba thogs nas/ hūm̐: rigs bdag 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: yum chen gsang ba mkha' 'gro lngas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bla med rigs bdag dbang thob shog: oṃ lo ki shwa rī muṃ ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas sku 'bag thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med ngang nyid las: rol rtsal legs ldan nag po ches: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yongs rdzogs phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ karma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing ngo sprod: dai nas phyag mtshan thogs te: hūm̐: gri thod tsit+ta ral gri 'bar: bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'i dbang thob shog:

oṃ badz+ra ka ra ra tri dhā ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas gdong bzhi pa thogs nas: hūm̐: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi pa: 'phags mchog sku yi rnam par sprul: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la shān+tiṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas ma ning thogs la: hūm̐: ma ning nag po bla med mgon: 'phags mchog yon tan rnam par sprul: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas mgon po phyag drug pa thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa: 'phags mchog gsung gi rnam par sprul: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: khams gsum dbang sdud dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la wa shaṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas mgon po bram ze thogs la: hūm̐: dur khrod bdag po bram ze'i gzugs: 'phags mchog phrin las rnam par sprul: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ dz+wa la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas khro mo bzhi thogs nas:

hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen dbyings phyug bzhi: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i brda gar can: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: tshad med dga' bzhi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ kro ti tsa tur su khaṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus tha mal du 'dzin pa dag /snang stong sku rdo rje bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnyis pa gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi lung sbyin pa la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ sngags phreng gnyis pa chad de zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi steng sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ ā wa lo ki te ḍāk+ki pañca hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā kā la nā tha pañca kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ bh+yoḥ om̐ ma hā kā la ya k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ ma tri tsa tri hūm̐ bh+yoḥ om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ga na gu h+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā kā la mu kha tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā kā la k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ ṭa ka ra ṣa ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā kā la u ta a tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma tri ḍāk+ki kro ti tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ sngags phreng bgrang la sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug / sgrar grags thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang bzhin du 'char ba'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag par mos shig /de ltar gsung sngags kyi dbang bskur bas ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa dag /grags stong gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa thugs kyi dbang bskur ba la/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i chos thams cad gdod ma nas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ rang byung 'od gsal chos kyi skur lhun gyis grub par shes pas bsal bzhag med pa rig pa'i rang ngo la mnyam par zhog mdzod/

cung zad mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug /de nas me long ngam shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung dkyil 'khor bla na med: gsal ba ye shes mgon po'i thugs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rdzogs rim 'od gsal dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar thugs kyi dbang bskur bas yid tha mal du 'dzin pa dag /rig stong 'od gsal gyi ting 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /bzhi pa yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba thugs rje thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gtor ma thogs te: hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rdzas: rmad byung bha liṃ rgyan dang ldan: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rdzas mchog yon tan dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra gu ya hrī dha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas/ rtog sgrib nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag /gzhan don re ba yid bzhin du skong ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /lnga pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ khyed rang rnams la che rtags kyi phyag rgya yongs su rdzogs pa gtad pa la brten nas/ dgra bgegs nyon mongs bdud dpung rnams tshar gcod cing gnas su stob pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: prog zhu cod pan khrag zhag tshom: seng glang zhing lpags thod pa'i phreng : rus rgyan sbrul chun stag sham gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na shrī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rdo rje phur pa g.yas g.yon du gtad cing : de nas thabs kyi 'dul bar dka' ba rnams 'dul ba'i ched du mngon spyod kyi phyag rgya 'di nyid lag tu gtad pas/ gdul bya log 'dren bdud kyi dpung rnams shugs kyis sgrol ba'i mthu stobs dang nus rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hūm̐: thabs shes rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zungs: sbyor sgrol sreg mnan bzlog cing 'phang : las mtha' sdud pa'i khro phur mchog: g.yas g.yon lag tu 'dzin par gyis: oṃ badz+ra kī la ya mā ra ya dha ha na ba me dhā ra sa ma ya hoḥ de dag gi mtha' rten du bskyed rim snang stong brda'i dbang bskur zhing ngo sprod pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: bskyed rim sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin: snang la 'dzin med stong pa'i dbyings: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dkyil 'khor bum pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra ga lak+ṣa tsakra a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ bskyed rim stong pa gang shar 'dzin med snang la bdag bzung dang bral ba me long gi 'gying logs lta bu'i bskyed rim bum pa'i dbang thob pa yin no/ /de dag gis bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yab yum mnyam sbyor byang chub sems kyi ngo bo thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi lce la bzhag pas/ rtsa khams thams cad bde bas tshims/ gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig / thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: 'gags med rtsal snang bhan+dha ru: dam tshig gsang ba'i bdud rtsis bkang : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'gags med gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de dag gis gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sgrar grags sngags su dag /'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka las lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī dmar mo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can lang tsho rdzogs pa zhig byung ba/

khyed rang rnams la gtad pas zung 'jug dgyes rgur rol nas dga' bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig / gzungs ma thogs la: hūm̐: ma 'gags zang thal grags stong ngang : zung 'jug bde stong gsang ba'i dbang : dga' bzhi grol lam 'byin 'jug gnad: pho nya sngags kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na rā ga dhā ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de dag gis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ slob ma'i snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog pa dbyings su dag nas rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces man shel thogs la/ hūm̐: ka dag ye shes rang byung che: gsal stong ma 'gag chos kyi dbyings: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rdzogs rim 'od gsal dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na ma hā a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hoḥ gsal zhing stong pa chos sku/ rang bzhin ma 'gag longs sku/ thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku/ sna tshogs rang byung gi ngo bo nyid rig pa'i rang rtsal yin pas/ 'gyu ba phra rags thams cad gang shar bzo med du zhog mdzod/ des tshig gi dbang thob cing shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /lam dus su ka dag dang lhun grub bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /de nas mtha' rten bka' gtad ni/ gtor snod dur khrod drag po'i gzhal yas khang du gtor ma nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po yab yum bka' sdod dregs pa sde brgyad dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa dngos su gsal ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyis mos gus drag tu bskyed pas spyi bor byon/ slob dpon gyi bka' bsgos pa'i tshe/

khyed rang rnams kyi byang chub sgrub pa'i bar gcod nad gdon dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad cing*/ mthun rkyen legs tshogs rab tu spel ba sogs phrin las rnam bzhi thogs pa med par sgrub pa zhal gyis bzhes par mos shig / gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams la byin rlabs bya/ hūm̐: dur khrod rngam chen me rlung 'tshubs pa'i klong : thod mkhar dmar nag pho brang so so'i dbus: bstan pa'i bka' srung las mdzad mi bsrun pa: legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi phyag drug pa: ma ning dang ni gdong bzhi bram gzugs can: las mgon seng gdong srog bdag bya rog gdong : gri gug beng chen dmar nag trag shad dang : gur mgon a gho ra dang stag zhon pa: ber nag can dang seng zhon mdung thung can: khyad par gza' brgyad ki kang rā hu la: e ka dzā ṭi dud sol re ma ti: tshe ring mched lnga a phyi chos sgron dang : srog bdag ma mo dam can rdo rje legs: btsan rgod khrag 'thung shan pa mdung dmar can: drag po dge bsnyen klu dang bdud kyi rje: ging chen pho mo sha za bye ba 'bum: rgyal chen pe dkar la sogs gter srung dang : sde dpon sum cu dregs byed yang 'khor la: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang : sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag la bu bzhin skyongs: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: skye 'gro 'jig rten pho mo'i snying bsgul la: zas nor longs spyod gnas 'dir char bzhin phob: snyan grags mnga' thang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang : bdag la sdang zhing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: de nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ ho/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang khyad par du/ nges don gyi snying po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phrin las kyi nyin byed ji srid kyi bar du mi nub pa'i gnyer kha blangs shing*/

bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam pa'i chos skyong yongs kyi rgyal po/ dpal ldan ye shes mgon po/ yum mchog 'dod khams dbang phyug /sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod mngag gzhug dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba zhi khro/ sprul sku mchog gi rig 'dzin rnam pa brgyad/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes/ chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa/ rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag 'gro 'dul/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje nas rtsa ba'i bla ma sūr+ya rasmi'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las mi 'da' bar dam tshig gi rim par rjes su dgongs la/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ mdzad phrin spel/ bstan pa rin po cher rim 'gro dang bkur sti bcas te bla nas bla ru spel cig /sems can gyi phan bde spel/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/ snod bcud kyi legs tshogs skyed/ gdug can gyi gnya' nas non/ dam can gyi sdongs grogs gyis/ dam med kyi dbang po snubs/ thar 'dod yongs kyi re ba sgrubs shig khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid dam/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di khyed la gtad kyis lus dang grib ma bzhin du srungs shig /ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du phyi'i dgra nang gi bgegs/ gsang ba'i bar du gcod pa thams cad las srungs shig /mdun nas bsus shig /rgyab nas skyor cig /'gal rkyen dang g.yol cig /mthun rkyen dang sprod cig /gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul ma nus na gang dang 'tshams pa'i phrin las drag pos tshar chod cig /sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs chom/ bar chad kyi rkyen zlog /bsam pa sgrubs/ re ba skongs/ tshe srings/

dpal skyed/ rgyags mthud/ phyi'i tshe bsod/ nang gi nyams rtogs/ gsang ba'i ye shes dang yon tan ma lus pa gong nas gong du spel nas/ dam pa'i phrin las blar 'phel bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /bsam pa ngan pa rgyud la mi skye bar mdzad du gsol/ byas tshad gzhan don/ bsam tshad bla ma/ gang brtsam chos dang mthun par mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du'ang rin chen byang chub kyi sems rin po che ma skyes pa skyes/ skyes pa mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ thabs la mkhas pa'i phrin las kyi sgo/ lus la gzi brjid/ ngag la nus pa/ sems la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thob nas/ snang ba dbang du bsdus/ phas rgol zil gyis gnon/ dgra gdon thal bar brlag pa sogs phrin las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor/ chos bzhin yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor cig /chos skyong mthu ma chung*/ dam can rtsal ma zhan/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub bde blag tu stsol cig / bla rdo srog 'khor thogs nas: hūm̐: dpal chen ye shes mgon po yi: 'di ni bla rdo srog yig ste: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sgrub cing bsten pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la ya dā hṛ dha ya sha la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs di ri ri sgrogs bzhin par/ me tog gi char dbab pa'i dge legs kyi snang bas phyogs dus kun tu yongs su khyab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las rang byung drag po'i sku: shin tu mi bzad dpal ldan nag po che: bla med rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa skyongs: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i bkra shis shog: dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par thob nas dbang srog dam tshig la gnas pa gal che ste gzhung las/ hoḥ deng phyin chad chos skyong mgon po nag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rnams mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung dgos te:

sku'i dam tshig tu lus rgyan thams cad nag por bya zhing : gnas nag dur khrod dang shing gcig gi drung du sgrub par brtson: bya nag: khyi nag: gcan spyang nag po: dud 'gro nag po sogs la mi 'tshe: rgyun du rta nag dang g.yag nag: brtan dar nag po 'chang : rten thugs dang mkhar khang nag por bya zhing : kha bad thod rtsal gyis brgyan: gsung gi dam tshig tu: sngags bzlas drag sngags nag po bgrang phreng rak+sha nag po'i phreng ba: thun nag gi rdzas: gsang grogs nag mo bya: thugs kyi dam tshig tu: bla rdo nag po dang bla 'khor dar nag srog yig gri snying 'chang zhing : gzhi nag po mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rgyun du gnas par bya: yon tan gyi dam tshig tu: 'bru nag gtor mchod bskang rdzas nag po las sngags la brtson zhing ma chag par bya: phrin las kyi dam tshig tu: rbad bsad nag po'i 'khor lo bskor zhing bzlog nag hom nag dgug mnan sogs bya: de ltar khyed rang rnams rgyun du mgon po'i dam tshig dang ma bral na: bu bzhin du skyong zhing lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'khor te: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnyan po srung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyad chen gyi rdzong btsan zhing bya ra 'grub par 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig gi rim pa la spang blang tshul bzhin du bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa che: dam pa'i bka' ni legs bstsal pa: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung :

lan gsum/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: lan gsum/ rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya'o/ /dpal ldan dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung gtso/ /yem̐ shem̐s 'jig rten kun la mnga' bsgyur ba'i/ /mgom̐n pom̐'i dbam̐ng chog gsaṃng sngaṃgs rnal 'byor lugs/ /bstanaṃ 'dziṃn skyes bur bskur gyis thun mong min/ de dag ni zhe bdun pa dpal ldan ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ dpal ldan las mgon zhim̐ng skyom̐ng gi /drem̐gs pam̐'i srom̐g thig dmag 'gyed rgyud/ /ru dar nag po'i srog gtad dbam̐ng*/ /gab bsdebs bkral la rjes gnang stsol/ zhe brgyad pa dpal mgon zhing skyong legs ldan rngam klong gi dbang bskur dregs pa'i srog thig dmar po bklag chog tu dgod pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum ste/ gzhung las/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum ste: rdzas bsags chas rnams bkram pa dang : dbang bskur lung 'bog me tog 'thor: bsngo smon bgyi sogs rnam gsum ste: zhes gsungs pas/ sbyor ba bca' bsham la/ yang de nyid las/ thog mar rdzas dgram sgrub pa ni: shin tu gtsang ba'i stegs bu'i khar: ras bris sam ni 'bru tshom bsham:

de dbus dpal mgon gtor ma ni: snying bshos pad+ma 'dab bzhis bskor: rtse mor rgyan bkra legs par gdags: sde brgyad grangs kyi ril bus bskor: mgon po'i tsa ka li yang gzugs: rgyud la dar nag gdugs kyang dbub: ji ltar mdzes shing dwangs par bya: g.yas su bum pa tshad ldan nang : rdzas sman dri bzang chu yis gtams: kha rgyan mgul chings tshang bar bya: g.yon du bla 'khor srog rten bzhag: mdun du sman raka mchod gzhung bsgrig: gzhan yang dbang chas sna tshogs dgram: mdzes pa'i 'phan dar tshogs kyang dgod: bag dro lhun chags ldan par bya: zhes gzhung don las gsal bar bstan pa ltar dang*/ bhan+dha/ rig tsaka /dkyil 'khor dang me long*/ ru mtshon dang gtor zor/ sde brgyad spyi gtor/ srog 'khor dang bla rten bcas dgos pa'i yo byad 'du bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la/ gzhung las/ mgon po'i las byang gzhung bzhin btang : bsnyen par bskyal te tshogs bgyis nas: zhes pas thog mar rtsa gsum gang rung gi las gzhung sngon du song nas bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas las byang sgrub pa'i phrin las khrag 'thung rab 'bar gyi gzhung bsrang bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgrubs la bsnyen pa'i mthar/ bum sgrub/ mchod bstod/ 'od zhu/ rig me dor ba/ gnang zhus sogs song nas chos srung spyi dang dgos srung nas tshogs drang ba'i bar gtong*/ bskur ba la gzhung las/ slob ma thams cad gral du 'khod: thog mar bka' bsgo mtshams gcod bya: maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing khrus kyang bya: lo rgyus gzhung bsrangs rgyu 'bras bshad: de nas dngos gzhir 'jug pa ni: gsol btab tha tshig bsgrag par bya: zhes pa ltar thog mar khrus bstsal pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur:

om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du rtsa gsum mgon po'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ ༈ lo rgyus kyi 'khyogs mtshams ni/ 'di ni dpal ldan ma hā kā la'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de'i lo rgyus cung zad snyan du gsol na/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod dmar nag rak+ta'i mtsho nas spyan drangs pa'i dpal ldan zhing skyong rngam klong gi sgrub thabs dang phrin las mngon spyod kyi las tshogs ji snyed bzhugs pa las/

skabs su bab pa ye shes mgon po seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa yin pas/ de'i lo rgyus mdo tsam smos na/ thun mong 'jig rten gyi snang tshul ltar na/ gzhung las/ sngon 'og min lcang lo can nas lha'i bu gzi brjid 'od 'byin tshe 'phos nas ri ma la ya'i mdun du: bram ze nye bar gnas pa las rab tu byung ba'i dge slong kun dga' gzhon nu zhes pa de nyid smad 'tshong ma kun 'dus ma zhes pa la nyer len 'brel bas ltung ba'i cha las tshe 'phos pas: pham sems kyi shugs kyis pha lha dang yum gnod sbyin mo gnyis mun rub tu bdud 'gyu ba'i tshe ma la ya bam ri'i rtser bshos pas bu seṅge'i mgo bo yod pa zhig tu rdzus skyes su gyur: de'i tshe gling de la dbang bsgyur zhing kun gyis glags mi rnyed pa 'jig rten phung 'tshengs legs nyes su 'bebs pa zhig tu mngon pas: dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos dam du bzhag nas rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug cing gsang mtshan gha ya dha ra zhes su gsol: ye shes dang las la grub pa'i phyir mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ma la si na ra ma zhes lus ma spangs par bstan pa'i bya ra 'grub par sbran: de'i tshe ye shes spros pa'i rgyud las: yab khyab bdag he ru kas ma rungs 'dul ba khro bo'i rgyal po dang : yum rdo rje dbyings kyi rnal 'byor kun 'dus mkha' 'gro: sras gzhon nu legs grub rdo rje rtsal: yum rdo rje rab rgyu ma zhes pa ye shes dang las kyi srung mar gyur: bar du rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gsang sngags bla med kyi theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug gnas yul thams cad kyi gnyer byang gtad de/ 'khor drug gi gling dang khyad par gyi gling bcu gnyis bcas kyi phrin las kun 'grub pa'i byed por mdzad nas: khyab bdag khrag 'thung he ru ka dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po yab yum dregs pa sde brgyad kyi 'khor bcas dang bstan pa'i bya ra sgrub pa po zhes bsngags par brjod de gter kha thams cad kyi srung mar bskos:

rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che skyong ba'i tha tshig phul: des na chos skyong thams cad kyi phrin las gcig 'dus ltar mngon spyod thog ltar 'bebs pa'i nus pa dang ldan: sgrub pa'i grogs rlung gi pho nya ltar bskul bde: sgrub pa po la 'khu ldog med: ye shes pa dang rol rtsal mnyam: pha rol gyi dgra la rtags 'byin pa gshin rje'i dmod pa dug mda'i nus pa dang 'gran yar bzod pa'i ngad 'byin: bka' skyong dkor nor gnyer ba'i chos skyong nag po rab 'bar du grags pa yin phyir kun las kyang 'gran zla dang bral ba'o: don du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gang 'dul gyi rnam par 'phrul ba yin te/ de'ang gzhung las/ 'di nyid ye shes mgon po'i phyir: chos skyong kun gyis 'gran zla bral: khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa yi: gang 'dul snying rje'i rtsal chen gyi: nyid zhi khro gar sprul pa'-i lha: sems can so so'i snang ngo ru: bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe'i tshul: dpa' bo seṅge'i gdong du grags: bzhugs yul nges pa ma mchis kyang : brda'i bye brag mtshon pa'i phyir: srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing : 'jig rten dregs pa'i cha lugs 'chang : gnas ni khyab 'jug seṅge brag: sprul pas gang gnyan rtsa gnyis dang : mtsho chen drug cu rtsa gnyis khyab: dur khrod brgyad la rngam par rgyu: ma mo bcu drug rtag tu rol: rab rgyu'i srang kha nyer brgyad nyul: pho brang dgu yi bdag por skyong : rtsa ba gsum gyi gnyer gtad 'dzin: tshang tshing 'khrigs dang ha ha rgod: rngam sgra bsil ba tshal chen dang : sgyu ma'i sku nyid gar dgu ston: bstan pa'i bya ra dbyings nas 'debs: nag po stong gi gtso bo mdzad: ma rungs dpung tshogs rab tu mthar: rdul mtshon rlung gi 'khor lo'i dpal: dgra bgegs srog rtsa'i sbubs su bsnun: bka' skyong nor bsnyags chas la gnyer: las la mtha' sdud kun la rgyu: 'da' bzhi thig le'i babs rgyun srung :

mu stegs stong yang dmod tsam brlag: sgrub la dam tshig snying ltar brtse: de bas bka' skyong mchog gyur nyid: zhes gsungs pa bzhin dpal bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa'i gang 'dul ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul tshad med snying rje'i rol rtsal las/ gang 'dul der ston gyi rnam rol zhi chags khro bo'i tshul dang*/ khyad par du 'jig rten las kyi mgon po'i rnam par 'phrul zhing gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri tra sogs gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi: yul sum cu so gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi bdag po/ 'jig rten dregs byed thams cad la dbang du byed pa'i rgyal por gyur pa tsam ma tshad rang bzhin longs sku'i zhing*/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams kyi gnyer srung yang 'di nyid yin no/ /de lta bu'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po zhing skyong rngam klong gi dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de'ang bdag nyid kyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ che mchog dpa' bo he ru kaḥ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol: skal ldan dad mos yang dag pas: mgon pos las kun deng gnang stsol: ces pa'i lan du slob dpon gyi ngag las gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ khyed rnams nges par snod ldan nam: 'di ni khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor te: gnyan cing skal med gshed du reg: de bas khas longs dbang mchog sbyin: de nas sngon 'gro skyabs sems sdom bzung rnams chabs cig tu sgrub pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod: mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bla ma dang 'khor lo sdom pa dbyer med kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i ngang mdangs thugs rje'i rnam rol/ dpal mgon srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dgongs klong zab gsal mchog tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal ba saugs bsags sbyang so so'i 'dun pa dang*/

phyi ltar so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang ltar gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom gsum cig car du nod de bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: phar phyin drug la slob sdom bzung : ma bsgral bsgral zhing ma sgrol sgrol: dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god: ces lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung*/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos shig /de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ bdag cag yang dag skal bar ldan: sngon nas smon lam las kyis 'brel: deng 'dir gsol 'debs gdung ba yis: bskul te dam tshig srog ltar 'dzin: dam tshig 'bog phyir rdo rje mna' chu sbyin pa la nang mchod bdud rtsi thogs nas/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam srung mchog gi dngos grub thob: dam med dmyal ba'i sa bon smin: de nas dam tshig chu 'di 'thung : de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi sgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par gcun te dam tshig pa'i lha sku 'di bzhin gsal thob cig:

oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ hoḥ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas par mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis e mthing nag me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su pad nyi ro'i gdan la: rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dran rdzogs su bskyed pa'i dpal chen ma hā kā la seṅge'i gdong pa can: sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa'i cha lugs can dur khrod gyi rgyan gyis mdzes pa phyag g.yas pas ru dar dang g.yon pas gtor chen bsnams pa: sgeg cing dpa' la zhabs gnyis dor thabs su bgrad de yum seng gdong ma dmar mo'i sku la 'khril nas bskal pa'i me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su gsal ba'o: de'i mdun du sprul pa'i bam̐ gnyis phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs kyis bskor ba'o: de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas: rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang dur khrod drag po'i gnas nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chen po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te slob ma la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya badz+ra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ a we sha ya a āḥ de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā:

spyi bor rdo rje bzhag / dngos gzhi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bla ma mgon po dbyings nas gshegs: mos pa'i skal ldan lus la zhugs: phyag 'tshal yid kyis dwang bas mchod: dbang bzhi'i mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dngos gzhi la sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga dang mtha' rten bka' gtad bcas drug yod pa las/ dang po sku bum pa'i dbang gi slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ bum pa dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang du bcud bla ma mgon po dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: bum pa rang byung gzhal yas khang : bcud ni bla ma mgon po dngos: dbyer med de bzhin dbang bskur bas: sprul bsgyur 'gyed pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍāk+ki nī si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku'i dbang thob/ lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku'i dbang dang byin rlabs thob par mos mdzod/ gnyis pa gsung gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba la/ phyi bhan+dha gzhal yas khang gi nang du bcud bla ma mgon po yab yum gnyis med du zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas bde stong zag pa med par nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bhan+dha lhun grub stong pa'i dbyings: bdud rtsi bla ma mgon po dngos: dbyer med de bzhin dbang bskur bas: spro bsdu gsang sngags dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍāk+ki nī si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des gsung gi dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /bzlas brjod la dbang*/ gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob par mos mdzod/ gsum pa thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/
