slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje'i rig ma zhig spros nas khyed rang rnams la gtad par mos mdzod/ gzungs ma thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen dbyings phyug gsang ba'i yum: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: 'khor lo'i phyag rgya rab bzung nas: 'bebs ldog rjes shes gsal rdzogs shog: oṃ ḍāk+ki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma gu h+ya mu ḍa a we sha ya rā ga dha ra sarba dz+nyā na ye satwaṃ: des thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /yid ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob par mos mdzod/ bzhi pa yon tan tshig gi dbang bskur zab mo'i ched du sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun la bzhugs par zhu/ dkyil 'khor dang me long thogs la: hūm̐: snang stong ye shes 'od kyi klong : rang zhal bla ma mgon po dngos: dbyer med de bzhin dbang bskur bas: rdzogs rim thugs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des rig rtsal don gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ mtshan med kyi ting 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ de kho na nyid kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob par mos mdzod/ lnga pa phrin las rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / de nas gtor ma thogs te: hūm̐: rmad byung bla med rdzas chen po: bcud mchog bla ma mgon po dang : dbyer med de bzhin dbang bskur bas: sgom sgrub spel ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rdo rje phur pa g.yas g.yon du gtad cing*/ de nas phrin las rnam bzhi gang 'dul der ston du mtshon pa'i phyag rgya 'di nyid lag tu gtad pas las bzhi'i phrin las la kha lo sgyur ba'i dbang thob par mos shig

/hūm̐: dpal chen thabs shes rgya rtags ni: bla ma mgon po'i phyag rgya'i chas: byin gyis brlabs te gtad pa yis: las bzhi'i phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar phrin las 'gro 'dul gyi dbang bskur bas/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag /gzhan don re ba yid bzhin du skong ba la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyad par gyi phrin las thabs kyis 'dul bar dka' ba'i mi srun gdug pa can rnams drag po'i stobs kyis tshar gcod pa'i dbang thob par mos la/ ru mtshon dang gtor zor thogs la: hūm̐: ru mtshon rgol ba 'joms pa'i rdzas: gtor zor dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon: de ring skal ldan lag tu gtad: dmod pa yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍāk+ki nī si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ karma bhan+dha ra t+yā ga sarba ya tshin+tu swā hā: de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa yin no/ /de nas mtha' rten bka' gtad ni/ gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams la byin rlabs bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang sman raka gis bran: hoḥ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan dam pa dang ldan pa: dri dam pa dang ldan pa: ro dam pa dang ldan pa: bcud kun 'dus la dgyes shing phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung : rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha: rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po: gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che'i bya ra dang mel tshe mkhan: legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin cing dam tshig nyams pa thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las byed pa: bsam sbyor log par 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi srog gcod: mna' tho chad la mi brtsi ba'i gshed ma:

gtsug lag khang gi dkor bdag: nag po stong gi rgyal po: ma mo 'bum gyi gtso mo: sha za bye ba'i las byed: gtsug lag khang gi chos 'khor gnyan po 'di nyid skyong ba'i srung ma chen po: yab khyab bdag khrag 'thung he ru ka chen po: yum ma gcig rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma: sras legs ldan 'bar ba gzhon nu seṅge'i gdong pa can: khyad par du ye shes dang las la chas pa'i tshe: ma la ya bam ra'i mdun du rgyal ba'i dbang po dge slong kun dga' gzhon nu chen po: yum mchog mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ma: sras mchog thog rgod rdo rje: sras mo gling bzhi dbang sgyur: e ka dzā ṭi ma la sogs te: sngon nas rgyal ba'i dam tshig la gnas pa chen po: sku'i mtshan mchog kun dga' gzhon nu: gsung gi mtshan mchog gha ya dha ra: thugs kyi mtshan mchog legs ldan nag po: yon tan gyi mtshan mchog dur bdag dpal 'bar: phrin las kyi mtshan mchog bdud mgon seng gdong chen po he ru kaḥ gnas dang yul gyi bdag po chos skyong drag rtsal can khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ yum mchog ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma las la grub pa'i cha lugs can: ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma seṅge'i gdong can dri za'i sras mo 'dren bzang dbyangs can ma: bdud kyi sras mo re ma ti: srin po'i sras mo khri sde ma: lha'i sras mo u ma dhe wa: gnod sbyin gyi sras mo ku ru kul+le: klu'i sras mo dung skyong ma: btsan gyi sras mo khrag ral ma: gshin rje'i sras mo dmag rgyal ma: ma hā de wa'i sras mo srid rgyal ma: rgyal po'i sras mo gzi legs nor skyong ma: gza' yi sras mo ha shang sbal mgo ma: dam can gyi sras mo rab brtan gser mig ma: dmu rje dgra lha'i sras mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: las kyi ma mo'i sras mo sngags srung spyang zhon ma: 'jig rten srid pa grub nas bstan pa srung ba'i sras mo a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma ste:

ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ngo bo gcig pa'i gtso mo khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: yab yum las byed kyi sprul pa bam ro dmar nag spre'u gdong can gnyis la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa mchog gi bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs: khyad par du'ang rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra'i gdung gsob snga 'gyur rgyal bstan 'dzin pa spyi dang bye brag tu gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rje yab sras kyi ring lugs phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bstan pa der 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe'i zhabs pad brtan cing thugs kyi bzhed don mtha' dag gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ bye brag tu dgon sde mtshan nas smos la 'di nyid kyi dge 'dun 'dus sde yon sbyor slob 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams bsrung zhing skyobs te sde snod lung rigs kyi rgyud sde chen po bzhir thos bsam dang*/ lam bslab pa gsum la nyams len bsgom sgrub sogs 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin te/ bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i 'gal rkyen gyi bar chad sol: mthun rkyen bsam pa ci smos pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cig: phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dza dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍāk+ki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hriṃ dza: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hriṃ dza: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: gtor snod dur khrod drag po'i gzhal yas khang du gtor ma nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po lcam dral lha tshogs dang bcas pa dngos su gsal ba la/

khyed rang rnams kyis mos gus drag tu bskyed pas sngon gyi thugs la dgongs te spyi bor byon zhing dbyer med du byin gyis rlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas zhing skyong gtso gtor dang srog 'khor bla rten gtad la/ hūm̐: dam tshig gsang ba mchog gi rten: bla ma mgon po mnyes pa'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: bstan srung bsgrub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma ya: sa dhe na bhi na a ya ka ra ye swā hā: de ltar dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsgrub pa'i bar gcod nad gdon dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad cing*/ mthun rkyen legs tshogs rab tu spel ba sogs phrin las rnam bzhi thogs pa med par bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par mos shig / de nas sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog gtad pa ni/ sde brgyad gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlab/ hoḥ khyad par du bka' sdod dregs pa las la chas shing rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa shan pa spu gri thogs pa'i sde tshogs kyi mtshan nas smos shing mchod sbyin 'bul ba ni: hoḥ sku'i sprul pa lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba chen po: gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag btsan gyi sde tshogs gyi sde dpon gnod sbyin bswe khrab can: thugs kyi sprul pa sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ral gcig ma: yon tan gyi sprul pa klu'i dge bsnyen nā ga rak+sha: phrin las kyi sprul pa bdud rje mgon po bkrag med: gnyis med kyi sprul pa ki kang gza' rgod chen po rā hu la: dmag dpon dgra 'dul du sprul pa dgra lha bdag skyob che btsan: gtsug lag dkor skyong du sprul pa dam can rdo rje legs pa ste: sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i las byed chen po khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ gzhan yang nag po stong : sha za 'bum: ma mo bye ba: gnod sbyin khri:

sha za sa ya la sogs pa sprul pa yang sprul gyi dmag tshogs khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul zhing bsngo'o: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ zhing skyong dam can 'khor bcas la: bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba'i mthus: pha rol log pa'i dgra bgegs kyis: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : gsang sngags chos la smad pa dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa'i dgra: sdang zhing gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun: dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis: myur du bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ pha rol dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: gser skyems mchod cing slar sde brgyad spyi gtor slob ma'i lag tu gtad de/ hūm̐: lha btsan ma mo dge bsnyen dang : bdud gza' dgra lha dam can tshogs: de ring slob bur bka' gtad sbyin: las mdzad gter srung dbang thob shog: oṃ dhe wa tsa tri shu la e ka tsa ti nā ga rak+sha du pra ma rā hu la dhe wa rad+dhi ma hā badz+ra sa du tri sarba dharma pā la karma dha ra swā hā: de nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ ho/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang khyad par du nges don snying po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phrin las kyi nyin byed ji srid kyi bar du mi nub pa'i gnyer kha blangs shing*/ bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam pa'i chos skyong yongs kyi rgyal po/ yab khyab bdag khrag 'thung he ru ka chen po: yum ma gcig rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma: sras legs ldan 'bar ba gzhon nu seṅge'i gdong pa can: khyad par du ye shes dang las la chas pa'i tshe: ma la ya bam ri'i mdun du rgyal ba'i dbang po dge slong kun dga' gzhon nu chen po: yum mchog mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ma: sras mchog thog rgod rdo rje: sras mo gling bzhi dbang sgyur: e ka dzā ṭi ma la sogs te:

sngon nas rgyal ba'i dam tshig la gnas pa chen po: sku'i mtshan mchog kun dga' gzhon nu: gsung gi mtshan mchog gha ya dha ra: thugs kyi mtshan mchog legs ldan nag po: yon tan gyi mtshan mchog dur bdag dpal 'bar: phrin las kyi mtshan mchog bdud mgon seng gdong chen po he ru kaḥ ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma seṅge'i gdong can/ dri za'i sras mo 'dren bzang dbyangs can ma: bdud kyi sras mo re ma ti: srin po'i sras mo khri sde ma: lha'i sras mo u ma dhe wa: gnod sbyin gyi sras mo ku ru kul+le: klu'i sras mo dung skyong ma: btsan gyi sras mo khrag ral ma: gshin rje'i sras mo dmag rgyal ma: ma hā de wa'i sras mo srid rgyal ma: rgyal po'i sras mo gzi legs nor skyong ma: gza' yi sras mo ha shang sbal mgo ma: dam can gyi sras mo rab brtan gser mig ma: dmu rje dgra lha'i sras mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: las kyi ma mo'i sras mo sngags srung spyang zhon ma: 'jig rten srid pa grub nas bstan pa srung ba'i sras mo a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma ste: ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ngo bo gcig pa'i gtso mo rnams dang*/ las byed kyi sprul pa bam ro dmar nag spre'u gdong can gnyis dang*/ khyad par du bka' sdod dregs pa las la chas shing rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa sku'i sprul pa lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba chen po: gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag btsan gyi sde tshogs gyi sde dpon gnod sbyin bswe khrab can: thugs kyi sprul pa sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ral gcig ma: yon tan gyi sprul pa klu'i dge bsnyen nā ga rak+sha: phrin las kyi sprul pa bdud rje mgon po bkrag med: gnyis med kyi sprul pa ki kang gza' rgod chen po rā hu la: dmag dpon dgra 'dul du sprul pa dgra lha bdag skyob che btsan: gtsug lag dkor skyong du sprul pa dam can rdo rje legs pa ste:

sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i las byed chen po khyed rnams dang*/ gzhan yang nag po stong : sha za 'bum: ma mo bye ba: gnod sbyin khri: sha za sa ya la sogs pa sprul pa yang sprul gyi dmag tshogs khyed rnams kyis/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba zhi khro/ sprul sku mchog gi rig 'dzin rnam pa brgyad/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes/ chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa/ rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag 'gro 'dul/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje nas rtsa ba'i bla ma sūr+ya rasmi'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar dam tshig gi rim par rjes su dgongs la/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ mdzad phrin spel/ bstan pa rin po che rim 'gro dang bkur sti bcas te bla nas bla ru spel cig /sems can gyi phan bde spel/ 'jigs rten gyi rgud pa sol/ snod bcud kyi legs tshogs skyed/ gdug can gyi gnya' nas non/ dam can gyi sdong grogs gyis/ dam med kyi dbang po snubs/ thar 'dod yongs kyi re ba sgrubs shig khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid dam/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams khyed la gtad kyis lus dang grib ma bzhin srungs shig /ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du phyi'i dgra /nang gi bgegs/ gsang ba'i bar du gcod pa thams cad las srungs shig /mdun nas bsus shig /rgyab nas skyor cig /'gal rkyen dang g.yol cig /mthun rkyen dang sprod cig /gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul ma nus na gang dang mtshams pa'i phrin las drag pos tshar chod cig /sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs chom/ bar chad kyi rkyen zlog /bsam pa sgrubs/ re ba skongs/ tshe srings dpal skyed/

rgyags mthud/ phyi'i tshe bsod/ nang gi nyams rtogs/ gsang ba'i ye shes dang yon tan ma lus pa gong nas gong du spel nas/ dam pa'i phrin las blar 'phel bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /bsam pa ngan pa rgyud la mi skye bar mdzad du gsol/ byas tshad gzhan don/ bsam tshad bla ma/ gang brtsam chos dang mthun par mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du'ang rin chen byang chub kyi sems rin po che ma skyes pa skyed/ skyes pa mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ thabs la mkhas pa'i phrin las kyi sgo/ lus la gzi brjid/ ngag la nus pa/ sems la ting 'dzin khyad par can thob nas/ snang ba dbang du bsdus/ phas rgol zil gyis gnon/ dgra gdon thal bar brlag pa sogs phrin las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor/ chos bzhin yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor shig /chos skyong mthu ma chung*/ dam can rtsal ma zhan/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub bde blag tu stsol cig /de ltar khyed rnams la chos skyong dregs pa'i srog gtad cing tha tshig tu sbrel ba yin pas da nas bzung chos skyong gi gsol mchod ma chag par gyis shig /lha mi dam tshig gcig tu mthun na 'phral phug dge zhing ji ltar gsol ba'i don 'grub par 'gyur la/ tha tshig dang 'gal na de ltar ma yin pas so sos khas blangs pa'i dam tshig gi gnad rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka'? deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol:

lan gsum/ de ltar chos skyong dregs pa'i srog gtad 'di nyid chos brgyud 'dzin nges pa las gar thod thod du gnang na khe nyen che bas/ de bzhin slob dpon dang slob ma so so'i nges pa gal che'o/ /mthar bsngo ba dang smon lam sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /brgyud gsum̐m bla ma'i spyan sngar srog phul nas/ /sde gsum̐m bstan pa skyong bar khas blangs pa'i/ khams gsum̐m dregs pa'i sde dpon 'khor bcas kyis/ /dus gsum̐m ma g.yel bstan pa'i mel tshe sgrubs/ /las mgon zhim̐ng skyom̐ng dam can srung ma'i rgyud/ /g.yul zlog dregam̐s pam̐'i srom̐g gtam̐d thun mong min/ /gsaṃng sngaṃgs bstanaṃ pa srung ba'i rdzong chen ste/ /de nyid 'dziṃn skyong spel la nye bar mkho/ de dag ni zhe brgyad pa dpal mgon zhing skyong legs ldan rngam klong gi dbang dang dregs pa'i srog gtad kyi le tshan bcas rdzogs so// // ༈ tshem̐ mthar ma phyin 'di phy-i'i don sgrubam̐ dka'/ /de phyir dus min 'chim̐ bzlog tshe sgrub gces/ /bdam̐g 'dzin 'chi bdud zim̐l gnom̐n gdengs thob na/ /skye 'chir dbam̐ng bsgyur rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub/ zhe dgu pa tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ spros bcas dbang chen ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i smin byed dbang khrigs bltas chog tu bkod pa la sta dngos gnyis las/ dang po sta gon la/ shin tu spros bcas ni sgrub chen dang sbrags pa ste/ sgrub khog ltar slob ma sta gon gyi skabs su sta gon bya la/ bsnyen grangs thems rjes bum gsang sogs dbang chen dkyus ltar bskur ba'i phyag srol bzhin deng sang lag len byed srol cher med la 'dir dbang rkyang gi khong du sgrub khog nang du bshad pa'i sta gon dang sgrub dbang rnams kyis 'thus par mdzad pa gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes bzhin 'chad par byed pa la/

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la'ang sa chog dang sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ spyir sgrub gnas rnying pa'am ras bris lta bur ma byas kyang chog mod/ mdo tsam spro bar mos na/ dkyil 'khor gang la bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus su tshom bu/ mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum gnyis nyer spyod lngas bskor/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun g.yon nas brtsam nas bzed/ yungs thun/ g.yab dar ḍā ru/ rdor dril/ gdab phur/ nang mchod rnams dgod/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar tshom bu bkod la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ skyabs sems lan gsum gsum/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi sgom pa bcas song nas/ hūm̐: e las rang byung gzhal yas khang : gnam lcags las grub mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus chos 'byung baṃ gyi steng : rang nyid pad+ma he ru kaḥ h+ya ghṛ wa dmar nag gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb: sma ra dbu skra me 'od 'khrugs: rta skad hūm̐ sgra phyogs bcur sgrog: spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes bgegs dpung 'joms: g.yon pa'i phur bus tshe bdud sgrol: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham brjid: rdo rje phag mo yum dang sbyor: 'jigs byed chen po'i sku ru gsal: drag sngags hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du yis: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: rang byung ye shes lnga ru bsgral: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra baṃ kro ti bha ra hi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ brgya tsam bzla/ las bum mam/ dri'i dung zhal 'thor g.yab bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa mthing nag phur bu dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur:

rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci rigs bzlas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsams shing*/ de'i steng gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams nas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bka' brgyad dkar gtor ram spyi mthun ltar sa gzhi bslang ba ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngos/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ / ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ

sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas gdab pa ni don dam pa'i sbyong ba'o/ /gtor ma phul rjes tshom bu bsdus la phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag nas rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma he ru ka'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya rtsa sngags phreng skor ram/ nyer gcig sogs sbrags pas sa bzung*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi ma da na dang sbyar ba stegs bur 'thor la chag chag gdab bo/ /de nas sta gon dngos la gsum las/ dang po lha dang bum pa sta gon chabs cig tu bshad na/ mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi snang brnyan sogs dgram pa'i mdun stegs khebs ldan kyi steng*/ maṇ+ḍa lar dri'i thig le dbus dang*/ tshom bu lha grangs ltar bsnyen sgrub sngags kho na'i mthar sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes btags pa brjod bzhin du 'bru tshom gtso 'khor bye brag phyed par bkod pa'i rgyab phyogs su sman raka gtor ma/ mtha' bskor du phyi nang gi nyer spyod g.yas su bskor bar bshams te/ de nas bum pa rnams gu gul gyi dud pas bdug ste hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod la yungs dkar gyis brab/ bdud rtsi chos sman dang dri bzang bum rdzas so lnga rnams sbyar ba'i chu gtsang gis phyed ka kheng bar blugs/ rnam bum la mgul chings dmar nag dang*/ las bum la mgul chings ljang gu sgron/ kha rgyan gzung thag dang bcas pa 'du bya la tshom bu'i steng du rkang gsum thog dgod/ gzhan yang sta gon gyi rdzas dang dbang gi ca chas rnams kyang stegs thog tu dgram/ hūm̐: bhan+dha'i snod du dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i bkang : dung dmar snod du rak+ta chi li li: sogs las byang 'bring po yang gsang sgrub pa chog khrigs ltar mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bstod pa'i bar btang la bsnyen sgrub kyi bzlas pa khyug tsam byas la rnam bum dang las bum sgrub la mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/

spros med kyi skabs/ sgrub gzhi rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen por 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs dwangs ma'i mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar bkra lam gyis gsal btab la/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa'i mthar mchod bstod dang yan lag bdun pa'i tshogs bsags pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal? snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ spos dang thal mo sbyar la/ hoḥ ye nas gnyis med chos sku dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal 'bras bu so sor smin: de ldog phyir na rgyal ba'i dam mnos te: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: zhes pas nongs par bshags shing*/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba ni/ dril spos dang bcas/ hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dgongs: khyed rnams mchod dang slob ma la: phan phyir dkyil 'khor 'bri 'tshal na: thugs rjes dgongs te byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba lan gsum du gdab bo/ /gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma phyi rol du bos la khrus nas dbyung ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus dang maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

khyad par dbang chen khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bka' srung dregs pa gter bdag las kyi pho nya bye ba 'bum gyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las phyag mtshan sa bon 'phros: khor yug bar khyams srung ba'i gur khang ni: nang rnams gzhal yas 'ja' tshon lug rgyud gtibs: phyi rol mtshon cha me dpung khyab par 'khrigs: phra mo rlung yang 'gyu ba mi rigs par: sra mkhregs gnam lcags sprul pa'i gur khang bsgom: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ maṇ+ḍal tsaṇ+ḍa tsakra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ khaḍ+ga ka ra ti ka daṇ+ṭa muṃ ra ga ā yu dha ka la rak+ṣa raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ de nas slob dpon gyis zhwa chos dang bcas te/ lo rgyus 'chad pa la/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la slob par bya snyam pas thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/

de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar rang re rnams yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu lon pa'i dpe brgya stong gis char yang mi phod pa/ shin tu rnyed par dka' la rnyed na don chen po dang ldan pa dal 'byor bco brgyad ldan pa'i lus rten bzang po zhig rnyed zin kyang*/ de kho nas mi chog ste phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos shig bsgrub dgos/ de'ang 'phral du ma sgrub tshe lar snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'tsho rkyen ni dkon zhing*/ 'chi rkyen ni mang bas/ nam 'chi cha med 'chi rkyen nges med yin pa ma tshad tha na de ring dang sang nyin tsam la'ang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ 'chi ba'i tshe gnyen nye 'brel grogs dga' mdza' thob go sa nor longs spyod sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang ste/ las dkar nag 'ba' zhig gi rjes su 'brang bas bde sdug gi 'bras bu mi bslu bar myong dgos/ de'i tshe da lta dge ba ma sgrub par khyer rgyu ni med/ sdig pa mi 'dod kyang 'dor du ni mi btub/ de bas da lta nyid nas blang dor phyin ci ma log pa zhig sgrub pa gal che/ las nyon gzhan dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das shing*/ des na pha ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs rnam grol gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos rnam dag cig sgrub dgos so/ /de la 'dir rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la bka' babs shing thugs dam gyi lha mchog rtsod med du grags pa 'chi med tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'i bka' srol snga phyi du mar byon pa rnams kyi nang tshan/ mthu chen bud+dha dz+nyā na'i sku'i rnam 'phrul/ gter ston grub thob thams cad kyi spyi mes/ sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal lam gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes/ lho gnas mchog tsā ri ṭa zil chen gsang ba'i phug nas spyan drangs par mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/

de la'ang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/ de ring gi skabs su sta gon gyi chos rnams bsgrub par bya ba yin la/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro'i yo byad bsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar/ de ring gi skabs lhag gnas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas dbang don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyang ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bo'i bdag la bka' drin stsol/ khyed zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /dpa' bo rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /blo mchog ting 'dzin bskyed du gsol/ /

lan gsum/ ces dang*/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka' yi gnang ba thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can gyis: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can sdug bsngal las sgrol bar bya/ de'i ched du 'dir 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba na/ gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ slar yang tshogs zhing de'i spyan sngar yan lag bcu pa dang ldan pa tshogs bsags pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog: thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang*/ /bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ slob dpon gyis dam chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: de ring khyod la 'di dag sbyin: dam tshig nyams na gshin rje yi: lcags sdig nag pos snying khrag 'jib: bsrungs na 'ja' lus 'chi med kyis: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'grub: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: lan gsum 'thung la 'phro ma rgyab tu dor/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad bsrung phyir dpung skud sbyin pa ni: sngags 'dis gang mang byin rlabs bya: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na nṛ tsakra satwaṃ: de'ang dpung skud sbyin pa la pho'i dpung pa g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du bcings la phyag mtshan rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi 'gyu lam gcod/ srung skud ye shes rigs lnga mtshon par kha dog lnga ldan dang sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas gdab phyir rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor ba 'di nyid bcings pas phyi ltar rlung mkhris bad kan thams cad srung zhing nang ltar ma dag nyon mongs pa thams cad sbyangs/ gsang ba dag pa ye shes kyi rtsa sgo bye/ 'bras bu sku gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas pho g.yas mo g.yon dpung par 'dogs: hoḥ mi shigs 'khor lo rtags kyi rgya: ā yur tshe yi g.yung drung gis: mi shigs rdo rje'i mkha' ltar gdab: cis kyang mi shigs rak+sha hūm̐: zhes rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab/ de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bum chu byin gyis brlabs te slob bu rnams la khrus bya ba ni:

hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig gsang ba'i chu: ye shes khrus mchog bla med rdzas: skal ldan tshe rabs da lta'i bar: shes bya nyon mongs bag chags bkru: oṃ badz+ra bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas gdan ku sha gtad pa ni/ om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa sogs kyis bsang : swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs kyis sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las dhī dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i ku sha sngo ljang rma bya'i mgrin mdog ltar 'jam la reg na bde ba/ slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs shing gsal ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur: dhīḥhūm̐: bdun tsam bzlas rjes/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa de nyid mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas zhing 'dir phebs skabs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor ba'i sngon du chu bo nai rañja ni'i nye 'gram ma gha dha'i shing la sku rgyab gtad cing rtswa mchog ku sha'i gdan la skyil krung bcas nas/ dran pa mngon sum du bzhag ste byang chub mchog tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa bzhin/ deng 'dir smin grol gyi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum smin par bya ba la rten 'brel zab mo'i rmi lam du legs nyes brtag pa'i rtswa ring ba'i rtse mo mdun du bstan nas sngas pa dang*/ thung ba gdan byas te seṅge nyal stabs kyis gnyid log la mgo bo dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su gtad cing rmi lam gang shar ba de sba gsang med par smra bar bya'o/ /hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal sras rig 'dzin gyis: rtswa mchog la stan dngos grub thob: 'di dag gtad pas sngas su zhog: rtags tshad rmi lam brtag par gyis: de nas rten 'brel brtag pa ni: dkyil 'khor rigs lnga tshang ba zhig gi steng skyer pa'i shing la mgo bo me tog rtsa ba phur bu bgyis pa'i so shing smon lam dang bcas nas dor te: da ni khyed rang rnams tshe rabs sngon gyi lhag pa'i lha gang yin dang dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su rang gi tshe rabs kyi las 'phro yod pa'i phyogs su phog par shog snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas 'dor bar zhu/

hoḥ gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: dam tshig bla med brtan pa'i phyir: so shing 'di nyid dor bar bya: las bzhi phrin las rtags ltar sprod: oṃ hrī badz+ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: zhes bden tshig dang bcas pas dor ba/ dbus su babs na mchog gi dngos grub/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub du dbang*/ byang du drag po/ mtshams bzhir thun mong gi dngos grub phran tsheg re thob pa'i ltas yin/ gal te dal gyi phyi rol du lhungs na ngan pas lan gsum du bskyar/ ma phog na shin tu ngan pas dbang gi snod du mi rung ba'i ltas yin pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la bshags pa dang dge ba rlabs chen bya/ ma byas na chos bsgrub pa la bar chad 'byung bas/ lhag par tshogs brgya sāts+tsha dar lcog sbyin pa sogs rgya cher dgos so: de nas spyi bor cod pan brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan cod pan 'di dag ni: skal ldan skyes bu khyod kyi spyi bor brgyan: tshe rabs 'di nas ma 'ongs dus kun tu: dam tshig las kyi ming 'di legs par zungs: de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni/ thams cad kyis phyag rgya spyi bor thal mo sbyar la rdor sems sgom lung 'bog pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hūm̐: rang rig spyi bor nyi zla seng khri'i steng : bcom ldan rdor sems shel sgong dwangs ma'i mdog: rdor dril bsnol thabs snyems ma yum dang sbyor: rdo rje skyil krung longs spyod phrin las rdzogs: thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas g.yas g.yon bskor: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag lus ltem gyis gang : tshe rabs bag chags kun dag 'od lus bsgom: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas la skong bshags sogs la 'bad pas bar chad sel zhing dbang gi snod rung du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / rmi lam bzang po'i ltas dang ngan ltas gang byung re dogs kyi rjes su ma 'brang bar chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i lam 'khyer la slob pa gal che/

de dag gis tshe sgrub zab mo 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i thog mar smin byed sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub pa pa yin no/ /de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di? de dag gis sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par grub zin te dngos gzhi ni sang nyin 'byung ba lags so/ / sta gon gyi le tshan no/ ༈ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ spros bcas dbang chen ut+pa la'i smin byed dbang chog dngos gzhi la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sbyor ba ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ stegs bu dmar po'i steng*/ dkyil 'khor ras bris sam 'bru tshom lha grangs bkod pa'i khar rkang gsum thog /rnam rgyal bum pa kha rgyan mgul dmar pos brgyan pa de'i thog ka pā la bdud rtsi chos sman btab pa'i dza gad kyis dgang*/ de'i khar dar dmar brgyad ltebs bkab cing me long sin+dhu ras chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar mūm̐ḥ zur bzhir ha ri ni sa bris pa man shel zur drug bcas dgod/ mdun rgyab gang bder gong gtor la/ gdan gor mo sum brtsegs steng*/ zhi gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa/ phyogs bzhir tshe bum bzhi dang bum khar nor bu bzhag pa/ tshe bum mthar ril bu 'phreng gsum bskor ba/ rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga phyed pa'i rtser hrīḥyig dang nyi zla'i nor bus brgyan pa bsham/ gzhan yang tshe gtor/ sman raka gtor gsum chos srung gtor ma/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ sngon gtor/ nyer spyod sogs dang*/ dbang tsaka la/ thog mar bum tsaka dor ra/ cod pan/ tshe lha yab yum/ rigs bzhi tshe dpag med yab yum/ rig 'dzin yab yum drug /rig ma bcu drug /mgyogs ma bzhi/ sgo skyong*/ prog zhu/ cod pan/ stod g.yogs/ ga shal/ rus rgyan/ snyan rgyan sogs rin chen gdu bu rnams/ smad dkris/ sngags phreng*/ me long*/ rig 'dzin lnga'i phyag mtshan/ rig tsaka

man shel/ rdzas lnga/ sman lnga/ bcud kyi rdzas lnga/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad bcas dang*/ tshe ril tshe chang*/ mda' dar sogs yo byad tshang bar 'du bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs skyes rabs gsol 'debs song nas/ las gzhung gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung mchod bstod bar song nas dzap khang dbye zhing*/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum bsgrubs nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas kyi mthar rig pa'i me tog tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i gsol 'debs rnams bya la dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ rang lugs gsol kha spyi dang bye brag mgon po'i gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ sta gon sngon du song ba'i slob ma rnams phyi rol du 'khod par ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas sgo drung du bgegs gtor bsngo zhing shar sgo'i phyi rol du: ging dkar nag gis rdo thun brab cing bgegs bskrad pa la/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par dbang chen khro rgyal stobs 'dus lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bka' srung dregs pa gter bdag las kyi pho nya bye ba 'bum gyi bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs: zad med mchod sbyin 'di longs la: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs khros te: sku sprul khro bos nam mkha' gang : gsung sprul khro mos sa gzhi khyab: thugs sprul khro chung bar snang g.yogs: skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i mtshon char 'bebs: gzi brjid me dpung glog ltar 'khyug: drag sngags rdo rje'i thog ser 'bebs: bar mtshams khyab pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: thun rdzas tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum la: brdegs pas phye ma rdul phran bzhin: ming med brlag par gdon mi za: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las phyag mtshan sa bon 'phros: khor yug bar khyams srung ba'i gur khang ni: nang rnams gzhal yas 'ja' tshon lug rgyud gtibs: phyi rol mtshon cha me dpung khyab par 'khrigs: phra mo rlung yang 'gyu ba mi rigs par: sra mkhregs gnam lcags sprul pa'i gur khang bsgom: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ maṇ+ḍal tsaṇ+ḍa tsakra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa:

oṃ khaḍ+ga ka ra ti ka daṇ+ṭa muṃ ra ga ā yu dha ka la rak+ṣa raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bas srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ me chus mtshams bcad/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis zab lam ye shes lnga'i dkyil 'khor du 'khrid pa na/: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i phyi nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ mi shigs rdo rje'i thugs ldan pa: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i che mchog bdag: khrag 'thung dpa' bo dgongs su gsol: gzhan yang ye shes las grub pa: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka dang : gter bdag chos skyong dam can tshogs: sgo skyong srung ma dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan dam tshig can: las dang smon lam ldan byed de: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sgo nang du: 'jug cing dbang mchog bskur du gsol: bdag cag skal ldan e ma hoḥ

zhes lan gsum zhu: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir las can skal ldan ma gtogs pa skal med rnams kyis blta bar mi rung bas rigs dang skal pa 'dri ba 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ gsang 'dus 'chi med rdo rje yi: pho brang dbyings kyi bdag nyid ma: nga ni che mchog dbang gi rgyal: drag rtsal dkyil 'khor gsum dang ldan: las dang skal ldan khyod yin na: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nang 'jug rung : gang zhig sngags la mi mos shing : gnyis 'dzin log lta'i gnas ma yin: zhes dris pa'i lan du de lta bu'i slob ma snod kyi skyon dang ldan pa ma lags shing rigs dang skal bar ldan pa yin pas thugs brtse bas dgongs nas 'jug par gnang ba zhu bas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bdag ni rdo rje'i dam tshig tu: ngo mtshar gsang ba'i pho brang la: legs mos skal ldan rjes su zungs: dam tshig dpral ba'i mig ltar bsrung : zhes zhus pas phyogs kyi sgo ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phyes pa la nang du 'jug pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dzaḥ shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu ma: dkar mo tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig las kyi dbang mo ches: pho brang shar du 'jug pa'i tshe: tshe rabs yi dam lha dang sprod: hūm̐ḥ lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa ma: ser mo tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig las kyi dbang mo ches: pho brang lho ru 'jug pa'i tshe: tshe rabs yi dam lha dang sprod: baṃḥ nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog ma: dmar mo tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig las kyi dbang mo ches: pho brang nub tu 'jug pa'i tshe: tshe rabs yi dam lha la sprod: hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu ma: ljang mo tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig las kyi dbang mo ches: pho brang byang du 'jug pa'i tshe: tshe rabs yi dam lha la sprod: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi yol ba phyes nas phyag gsum 'tshal zhing :

dam tshig gi smon lam ni: e ma hoḥ yang gsang sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: 'chi med rig 'dzin rgyal sras la: deng bzung byang chub bar du skyabs: bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun grub nas: dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces phyag 'tshal zhing maṇ+ḍal bcas nas gral du 'khod: bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i drung du thal mo me tog dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'jug pa'i phyir gnang ba zhu bar 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ bla med dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i mchog: snang mtha' 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: zab gsang tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan slob ma smin mdzad phyir: gtso bos rjes bzung byin brlabs nas: 'jug cing dbang mchog bskur bar stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la mkhyen brtse ye shes chen pos bka' yi gnang ba sbyin par bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal/ khyed cag skal ldan las can la: dbang bskur smin grol 'jug par bya: khyed rnams legs gnang dga' ba sgoms: zhes gsungs pa'i lan du slob ma rnams kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ bla med yang gsang che ba'i mchog: snang mtha' 'chi med tshe yi dal: sra brtan thabs mchog 'jug pa'i lam: rig 'dzin tshe yi dal 'jug stsol: sngon chad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar dar dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i gdong g.yogs re bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha ma na wā ra hūm̐/ slad nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas phyag rten du u dum wā ra la sogs pa mchog gi me tog rnam pa lnga'i chun po yang zhing ma nyams pa re thogs par mos shig: om̐ puṣ+pe sid+dhi hūm̐: da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur zab mo gsan te 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin sgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa'ang*/

de'ang rgyud las: nyan pa po rnams dma' ba'i sa la 'dug: zhwa thod skra lo la sogs mdun du phab: mig gi dbang pos chos smra'i zhal la blta: rna ba'i dbang po ma yengs gsung la nyan: yid kyi dbang pos tshig bzung don la blta: zhes gsungs pa ltar gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ 'chi med tshe mchog sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang rang lugs su tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon dang*/ tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud/ tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab/ tshe sgrub pad+ma gsang thig ste tshe sgrub rnam bzhi zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang tshan 'di ni gar gyi dbang phyug pad+ma'i mgon po 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor du tshe dbang zab mo bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang dbang la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa las: da lam spros bcas dbang chen ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ mi zad rgyud kyi ti kaḥ sngon byung lung gi khyer so: man ngag gnad kyi them byang : byin rlabs chu bo ma chad pa'i lo rgyus dang bzhi las: mi zad rgyud kyi ti ka ni: sngon snang mtha' mkha' klong yangs pa'i dbus: brdal khyab ka dag chos sku'i klong du sna tshogs mi shigs pa'i khrir thog ma'i mgon po bzhugs so: de'i tshe thugs ka nas mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas: lho nub 'o ma can gyi mtshor sku 'khrungs: brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas dur khrod kun tu byon cing : mchog gi rig 'dzin mngon du gyur: khyad par brag phug mā ra ti ka ru bzhugs pa'i tshe: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon dang : rdo rje'i go khrab dngos su gnang ste lung bstan: rgya gar 'di'i lung pa byang phyogs su dag pa shrī bya ba gangs ri sku gsum du mtshon pa yod: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i gnas yin:

gzhan yang rgya gar gyi gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa 'di ru: gangs ri dang : mtsho mo: dur khrod: gtsug lag: ljon shing sogs bsgrub pa'i gnas khyad 'phags rnams dang : yang le shod sogs sku gsum gyi gnas dang : gzhan yang ti se la phyi tsā ri: gze rgyal rong btsan sogs gangs can gyi gnas khyad du 'phags pa yin pas: de dag rnams su ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sgrub gnas dang : zab gter rnams 'gro don dpag med 'byung ba'i rten 'brel zungs shig ces lung bstan: de nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang lha lcam grub pa'i rgyal mo man+da ra ba gnyis kyis lung bzhin: mā ra ti kar 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa mdzad pas: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob ste: mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dngos su zhal mjal zhing lung bstan par mdzad: gdams pa bzhi skor gyi rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa dngos su gnang : yab yum gyi spyi bor tshe yi bum pa bzhag: bskal pa chags nas 'khor ba ma stongs bar: yab yum gyi sku la bgres rgud med pa'i dbang bskur: skye 'chi med pa mchog gi rig 'dzin gyur: zhes gsungs shing tshe dpag med slob dpon yab yum la thim: yab yum gnyis kyang phyi ltar tshe dpag med: nang ltar rnga sgra'i rgyal po: gsang ba ltar dbang chen yab yum gyi sku dngos su gyur: gdams pa bzhi skor gyi man ngag rnams zab khyad mi 'dra ba du ma dang bcas: kha byang lung byang them byang man ngag gnad kyi lde'u mig dang bcas pa ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don du smon lam gyis rgyas btab nas: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod du bzhugs shing dag pa rig 'dzin rnams la gnyer du gtad: de rnams ni mi zad rgyud kyi ti ka ru grags so: sa ma ya: sngon byung lung gi khyer so ni: bod yul mun pa'i smag rum du: dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me 'degs pa'i ched du: 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i gdul byar gyur cing :

de'ang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs kyi sprul pa: bod kyi chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bod khams chos la 'god par dgongs nas: chos khrims rgyal khrims thang khrims gsum du mdzad cing : dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod phyir: bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs par: bka' 'bangs dang gros shing gzhi gting bas: bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams kyis sgrub tu ma ster bas: mkhan chen zhi ba mtsho gtsos pa'i mkhas chen sde gsum bod du byon pas rgyal por lung bstan par: rig 'dzin pad+ma kā ra bod yul du gdan drangs nas: rgyal po'i dgongs pa 'grub par gsungs: de nas rgyal pos slob dpon gdan drangs shing lha srin dam la btags: rjes 'brangs nyer lnga smin grol lam la bkod cing bod khams yongs la chos kyi nyi ma shar bar mdzad nas: dbu rtse'i bar khang du: bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe: rgyal pos rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te zhus pa: slob dpon chen po lags skye 'chi med pa tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa: slob dpon nyid lta bu 'byung ba'i rgyu gang lags: bdag la yang de lta bu'i gdams pa zhig gnang ba zhu zhes zhus pa dang : slob dpon gyi zhal nas nga nyid lta bu 'chi med rig 'dzin rnyed pa ni: khyad par dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mnga' gsol: 'jig rten dbang phyug gis lung bstan: mgon po tshe dpag med pas dbang bskur ba yin zhing : de lta bu ni rgyal po g.yeng ba che bas 'grub par dka' ste: 'on kyang mi yul du brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs par bya'o gsungs nas: brag dmar g.ya' ma lung gi gsang phug tu byon nas: 'chi med tshe'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes: phra men gyi bum pa rtsi bcud kyis bkang nas: zla ba gcig bsgrubs pas: mgon po tshe dpag med dngos su zhal bstan: de'i tshe slob dpon gyis rgyal po la tshe'i dbang bskur ba dang tshe chu 'dren ran par dus la bab pa gzigs nas:

mi ṭa kan+dhi ka ra dang : bā+e rin chen mchog gnyis bsam yas su btang : rgyal po'i spyan sngar slob dpon gyi gsung bzhin zhus pas: rgyal po yang thugs rab tu dgyes shing 'byon par chas: rta khal lnga bcu la gser dngul ja dar gos sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bkal te sngon la brdzang bar byas: rgyal po dang nang blon phyi nas 'byon par bgros: rta mchog ngang pa gser ldan la chibs sga bkra shis rgyan can sgron: rin po che dang dar sna lngas brgyan te: rgyal po chibs kyi khar phebs: blon po ye shes 'byung gis sna khrid de shar sgo rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mdun du phyin pa'i tshe: phyi blon bzhi dang lha 'dres sprul pa mi ru brdzu ba blon 'bangs 'ga' zhig gis khri srong lde'u btsan gyi chibs kha nas bzung ste 'di skad zhus so: rgyal po blo sna mang na rgyal srid sprang por 'chor ba'i skyon che: khar sang zla ba sngon ma'i tshes pa bcu gsum gyi nyin: rgya gar a tsa ra ngan pa tsi dug khur ba dpon g.yog gsum song zer ba kun gyi thos te: nged rnams la ca ga gzab par gyis zer mkhan mang zhig byung : mi 'ga' zhig shing thu zhing yod pa rnams kyis mthong nas: a tsa ras dug pha bong la byugs pas dum bu mang zhig tu gas pa mthong : dug yod pa'i rtags su brag la zon rigs dang yi ge yod par 'dug: nged blon po rnams kyi dpral ba'i mig: khog pa'i snying : srog gi khrag: 'dzam gling kun gyi mgo 'dra ba rgyal po khyed yin pa la: mtha' mi'i dge sbyong ngan pa mgo skor mkhan gyi khar brgyugs nas mig can gyis dug 'thung na: rgyal po'i tshe 'di'i sku srog la mi phangs kyang : rgyal khrims mgo nas zhig: blon po bar nas 'thor: mi sde rnams kyang kha bshad ngan pa las mi yong bar 'dug pas: cis kyang mi 'byon par zhu zer nas ngam stag ra klu gong gis chibs kha nas bzung ste ma btang : rgyal po yang nub mo'i mnal lam shin tu legs pa byung ba yin yang :

snang ba'i ri mo 'di yang bslu brid mkhas pa dang : blon po 'di rnams kyang phan sems kyi tshig 'dra ba mang zhig byung snyam ste: the tshom skyes te re zhig nang du log ste slar rim gyis brtag par gros te gzim chung bar khang du log: rgyal po'i thugs la yang 'di nyid mi srid dgongs kyang rgyal kha blon gyis bsgyur te ma byon: de'i tshe slob dpon mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mkhyen te: tshe bum dang bhan+dha bcas zhal kha phyes pas: g.ya' ma lung stod smad la khyab pa'i dri bzang dang : 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub cing me tog gi char babs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas dpag med byung zhing : mgon po tshe dpag med dang : lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i sku dngos su bstan te: 'jig rten 'di na tshe yi snod dkon pas: de bzhin tshe la dbang ba nyi zla tsam: gal srid skyes bu tshe yi snod ldan na: tshe chu 'di 'thung na lo stong phrag gcig thub: ces gsungs nas 'ja' ltar yal lo: de nas tshe la dbang ba slob dpon gyis tshe chu dang tshe ril rnams dum bu brgyad du bgos nas: tshe sgrub zab pa re re dang bcas nas: phyis ma 'ongs par bod 'bangs skyobs pa'i ched dang : rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i chos skal du dmigs nas: sgrom bu dang la cha'i bum pa: rdza'i dha ha: zangs kyi gwa'u: bswe'i li ta ka: rlung gi par bu sogs mi 'dra ba mang po'i nang du rgya rim pa bdun nam gsum gyis btab nas: rje 'bangs rnams dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar: bod kyi mgur lha shin tu gnyan pa re re la gnyer du gtad de: lha lcam gyis gu ru'i gsung bzhin mi 'gyur ba'i gnas brgyad la gter du sbas: khyad par tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon dang : de'i bar chad sel thabs khro rgyal stobs 'dus: rgyud lung man ngag them byang dang bcas pa: tsā ri zil chen gsang phug tu sngon gyi lung byang ltar gter du sbas: gter srung kun dga' gzhon nu dang :

gnod sbyin mdung dmar can la bcol lo: de dag ni lung gi khyer so ru grags pa yin no: sa ma ya: man ngag gnad kyi them byang ni: gzhi'i dbang la 'dus shing : de yang snod kyi gang zag brtag pa: dbang gi bskur thabs bstan pa: phan yon dang 'bras bu bstan pa gsum las: dang po gang zag brtag pa ni: rgyud las snying rje mos gus shes rab gsum tshang ba gang zag snod du rung ba dang : zhabs rdol kha sbub kha chod can gsum snod du mi rung bar gsungs shing : de yang snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul: mos gus med na yon tan skyon du mthong : shes rab med na chos kyi shan mi 'byed: ces dang : snying rje can gyis 'gro drug pha mar mthong : mos gus can la bla mar ma gyur med: shes rab can la 'khor 'das chos kyi gzhi: zhes gsungs pa ltar: snying rje can ni gzhi yi rang bzhin no: mos gus can ni lam gyi 'khrul pa bral: shes rab can la 'bras bu'i rang bzhin rdzogs: zhes gsungs pa ltar: snod rung gi gang zag brtag pa gal che'o: gzhan yang lung las: zhabs rdol can ni drad po rang mthong can: kha sbub can ni log lta smra bshad mkhan: kha chod can ni mu stegs gol ba'i lam: zhes dang : zhabs rdol bcud blugs rang bzhin nyes pa bsags: kha sbub can la bcud kyi snod ma yin: kha chod can la bcud kyi gzhi ma grub: gsungs pa bzhin snod min gyi gang zag la dbang bskur gyi snod mi rung ngo : de'i phyir las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams la bskur bar bya ste: de yang smin byed kyi rgyud las: sku yi dbang lnga spyi bo'i gtsug tu bskur: gsung gi dbang lnga mgrin pa'i gnas su bskur: thugs kyi dbang lnga snying kha'i gnas su bskur: yon tan dbang lnga lte ba'i gnas su bskur: phrin las dbang lnga yan lag lnga la bskur: lha dbang chen mo lha dang gnyis med bskur: chas dbang tshig mtshon brda don lus la brgyan: rdzas dbang thabs shes ma bral lag la gtad:

ces gsungs pa ltar: gnas lnga so so'i dbang don bsdoms: nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung ba yin te: de dag re re la yang dgos ched tshig don rdzas sngags smon lam phyag rgya lnga lnga tshang ba ni: bla med kyi dbang chen du gtogs shing : thabs mchog g.yas nas bskur ba bya ba'i rgyud: shes rab g.yon nas bskur ba spyod pa'i rgyud: gnyis med zung 'jug dbang bzhi bla med rgyud: phyi mchod rnam lnga bstan pa bya ba'i rgyud: nang mchod rnam lnga bstan pa spyod pa'i rgyud: sgrol mchod sman raka gtor gsum bla med rgyud: thig le 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba'i rgyud: pho brang pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor spyod pa'i rgyud: zla gam chos 'byung rtsibs mtshon bla med rgyud: ces gsungs pa ltar nyams su len skabs bdag don gzhan don gyi man ngag rnams gnad du khel bar bya'o: de yang dbang bskur thob pa'i phan yon: ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs gnyis las: bka' yi thang yig las: lo re bzhin tu dbang re thob pas na: lo brgya song nas dbang brgya thob pa yin: phyi ma dud 'gror skyes kyang dbang chen 'gyur: zhes gsungs pa yin te: de yang rang bzhin gyi dud 'gror yin yang gzhan don nus pa snying rje'i sems 'byung ba: smon lam gyi dbang dang ldan pa: glang bu cang shes dang legs skya lta bu'i lus su skye bar gsungs so: ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni: dbang bskur rtsa ba'i rgyud las: dbang ma bskur la gsang sngags chos snod min: dper na rdza so ma btang chu blugs 'dra: zhes dang : yang dbang bskur thob na chos kyi bdag po yin: de phyir gsang sngags dbang la 'jug par bya: dbang lnga thob na sku lnga'i sangs rgyas 'grub: ces pa ltar phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa ni: phan yon dang 'bras bu bstan pa'o: 'di kun man ngag gnad kyi them byang du grags pa yin no: sa ma ya: byin rlabs kyi chu bo ma chad pa'i lo rgyus ni: sngon brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su:

slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: dge slong nam mkha' snying po: lo chen bai ro tsa na dang grogs bzhis slob dpon chen po la: rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te zhus pa: kyaiḥ slob dpon chen po lags: da lta'i dus 'dir skal pa yar ldan kyang : ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus kyi tshe: da lta'i chos dang gdams ngag zab khyad rnams: 'gro don gar 'byung chos ka gang la byed: 'brel tshad don ldan 'byung ngam ji ltar lags: bdud sprul bstan pa'i ru tra ji ltar 'byung : bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i 'gro don ji ltar 'byung : rje 'bangs grogs rnams 'dul bya gang du 'byung : slob dpon nyid kyi sprul pa ci ltar 'byung : zhes zhus pas: slob dpon zhal nas 'di skad gsungs: bai ro tsa na ye shes grogs gsum nyon: tshe sgrub yang snying gcig dril zab gnad kyi: bdag gis snying byang dum bur bgos pa 'di: da lta spel ba'i dus min gter du sbos: dus mtha' sum cu kha dar nyi shu dus: mi rnams rang phung dug lnga spyod pa'i dus: sa gter mi thub gter ston mang 'byung zhing : sangs rgyas bstan pa dbus nub mtha' bzhi rtsod: dam chos gsang sngags dkyil 'khor chu la dor: so skye bdud sprul dbus gtsang khrag mtsho 'khyil: bying nang grum nas dbus su mi gad sdib: chos rgyal gdung rgyud mtha' bzhi'i 'dul zhing 'byung : steng 'khrug 'og 'khrug lha srin rnams kyang 'khrug: mtha' bzhi 'khrugs nas 'dre rgod yul la chags: mi rnams stod smad rgya hor dmag gis 'ded: rong chen bzhi la bros pa'i gab ri btsal: bod khams mi rnams lho mon rong du bros: nor rnams dgra yis za zhing hab sha gcod: zog po khrims ral dam nyams lung pa 'gengs: tshul bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam: sum cu kha ral nyi shu la nye bas: ma 'ongs de dus chos brgyud mtha' skyong ba:

da lta'i dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: skye ba 'khrul med mdo khams phyogs nas 'byung : rgyal khams rngam sgra nag po yul gyi ming : bya nag gshog rdeb gcan gzan ngar ba'i rong : rtsi shing mdung rtse gzengs pa lta bu'i tshal: yum bral gshed bzhi zhe sdang lo 'dzin pa: shes rab blo ldan zab gsang las sad pa'i: lus la brda rtags ri mo sha mtshan ni: drag po rtags rgya spyi gtsug me ris brgyan: rgyud smin dbang rdzogs so zho tshe bum ldan: stong nyid don ldan snying khar sme bas brgyan: tshig rnams pad+ma'i brda yig shes rab ldan: gsang bar hūm̐ mthing karma las 'brel gling : mi 'gyur rtags ldan sku lnga'i chos la dbang : ma nges brtul zhugs smyon pa lta bur spyod: phyogs med 'gro don rgyal khams rlung bzhin rgyu: gter sgro g.ya' lung brag gsum nas bzung ste: rong chen lnga yi zab gter rtags bdun dbang : bka' gsang shog dril bdun bcu don lnga 'di: dbang bzhir blang zhing phab nas yang gter sbos: gsang ba'i bka' rgya bka' srung drag por gtod: dam rdzas byin rlabs phab rgyun ma gtogs pa: 'du tir skyel zhing smon lam zab par thob: rten 'brel dus kyi smon lam ma gtogs par: lo bcu bar du gsang rgya dam par gyis: dus kyi sa rtags thams cad shar ba'i tshe: smon lam dus bab 'gro don dus der che: rdzogs brda chos kyi smin grol byang chub myur: de nas phrin las nga nyid drung du 'ong : sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pa'i lung byang de lta bu dang ldan pa: rig 'dzin chen po gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rje sogs gsang mtshan dgu dang ldan pa'i rig 'dzin de nyid kyis: shing pho rta'i lo nas dbu bzung ste: gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga gzhan yang gsang gter 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa gdan drangs pa'i nang gses/ gangs can sgrub gnas yongs kyi rgyal po gnas mchog tsā ri ṭa zil chen gsang ba'i phug brag tshe bum 'dra ba'i logs nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub chen po 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dbang bskur ba yin te:

de la'ang byin rlabs kyi bla ma brgyud pa ni: nye brgyud dang ring brgyud gnyis las: ring brgyud ni 'dir spyi lung chen po ltar: chos sku kun tu bzang po: longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa': gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje: rig 'dzin rdo rje chos mchog: rig 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin: rig 'dzin klu rgyal 'jog po: dza in+d+ra bho dhi: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo: slob dpon brgyad kyi rgyud lung gcig tu dril ba mkhas mchog 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: rig 'dzin shrī singha: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas: bal po bha su dha ra: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: nye brgyud gsang ba ltar na: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: longs sku 'jigs rten dbang phyug: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje: zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa'am hū?m̐ chen 'gro 'dul rtsal la bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing*/ des kyang rtsa nang gter chen dang*/ gter chen dri med gling pa/ des lcags zam mchog sprul bdun pa bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ des o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs nas/ yang*/ dkon mchog seṅge/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ phrin las rnam rgyal/ 'phags pa dge legs/ bstan 'dzin don 'grub/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ karma o rgyan/ gnam sprul bzod pa rab brtan nas/ bdag cag gi 'dren mchog dam pa 'khor lo'i mgon po nyi ma 'od zer sogs kyi bar rim par byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid kyi smin byed dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/

de'ang slob dpon dang slob ma'i byed las gnyis po so sor phye ba yin te/ bdag don du sgrub cing dbang bzhi len pa slob dpon gyi byed las dang*/ gzhan don du rjes su gnang ba slob ma'i byed las gnyis yin zhing*/ slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag gi snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ gsang ba mchog gsum dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan las can te: 'jug cing yang dag dbang bskur stsol: smin grol zab lam myur thob shog: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la mkhyen brtse ye shes chen pos bka' yi gnang ba sbyin par bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal: hoḥ e ma ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lam: 'chi med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: ya mtshan 'og min zhing dang mnyam: kun gyi yang zab dkyil 'khor mchog: rta rmig lcags kyis g.yogs nas kyang : 'jig rten btsal kyang rnyed mi 'gyur: des kyang khyed cag skal par ldan: de nas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can gyis:
sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi:

lan gsum/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can sdug bsngal las sgrol bar bya/ de'i ched du 'dir 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba na/ gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ slar yang tshogs zhing de'i spyan sngar yan lag bcu pa dang ldan pa tshogs bsags pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog: thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang*/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ slob dpon gyis dam chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: de ring khyod la 'di dag sbyin: dam tshig nyams na gshin rje yi: lcags sdig nag pos snying khrag 'jib: bsrungs na 'ja' lus 'chi med kyis: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'grub: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis bsang sbyangs la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces so: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas par mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pad+ma nyi zla 'od du 'bar ba'i steng du: 'chi med tshe'i bdag po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can zhal gsum dmar chags dkar bzhad mthing la dgyes 'dzum ste bag dro ldan pa: dbu la longs sku'i rgyan dang cod pan 'phur ba: phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo 'dzin cing : g.yon gsum pad+ma rgya gram tshe bum bsnams pa: dar tshon bklubs shing skyil krung gis bzhugs te: gsang ye dmar mo mda' dar dang bhan+dha 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud pa'o: phyogs bzhir tshe bdag rig 'dzin yab yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin bral bar sgoms shig: de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings dang*/ rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas o rgyan gu ru pad+ma tshe dpag med 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs/

sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad/ kha char dang bu yug 'tshub pa ltar dpag tu med pa spyan drangs khyed rang slob ma rnams la sib sib thim pas 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par mos shig de nas rol mo sna tshogs spos bcas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod klong yangs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: lhag pa'i lha mchog rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: 'chi med mgon po yab yum rol rtsal mchog: mgyogs ma la sogs dbang phyug tshe bdag rnams: byin chen dbab phyir thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: sku yi gzi brjid 'od 'phro chi li li: gsung gi sgra dbyangs snyan char kyu ru ru: thugs kyi dgongs brda ma 'gags sha ra ra: mdzes pa'i lha rdzas rgyan 'phyang spungs se spung : ma tshogs mkha' 'gro brda gar lings se ling : dpa' bo rig 'dzin gar thabs shigs se shig: tshe yi las byed pho nya khyugs se khyug: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho byin rlabs me re re: dam rdzas rgya mtsho bcud ldan kyi li li: skal ldan dad mos snang ba sangs se sang : dam ldan pho mo dga' spro ya la la: dbang chen pho brang zer thag sbrengs se sbreng : bgegs srin dam sri tshar gcod lams se lam: dbang bzhi chu bo rgyun 'bab na ra ra: skal ldan bu la byin 'bebs thibs se thib: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: 'chi med sgrub la rig 'dzin stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃḥ dza dzaḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya āḥ de ltar dam tshig sprul sku'i lha dang ye shes longs sku'i lha tshogs dbyings rig zab gsal gyi chos skur dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid brtan par bya phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hrī dha ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/ me tog 'dor ba'i tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'du bya ste/ sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid khyed rang dang tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i rigs kyi lha gang yin pa la phog par shog cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dor bar zhu/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang chen tshe yi dal: 'chi med 'ja' lus gur khang du: 'dun pa'i me tog 'di dor bas: dkyil 'khor lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe badz+ra ma nu ha pū dza hoḥ zhes me tog dor bas gang du babs pa'i rigs mthun gsang mtshan ming btags so: dbang rtags las kyi gsang mtshan btags pa skal pa shin tu che'o: 'chi med pad+ma'i snying po yin zhes smros shig: de nas slob ma rnams kyis mig dbye ba'i ched gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyeḥ bdag cag ma rig las ngan gyis: bag chags sgrib g.yogs 'thug pos bsgribs: khyed nyid ye shes spyan gyi bdag: bdag gi ma rig ling thog phyes: slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer gser gyi thur ma ltar 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal bar mos shig slob dpon gyis gser thur thogs la: hoḥ sa mkhan thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'chang : nga ni rig pa he ru kaḥ khyed kyi ma rig sgrib mun bsal: dag pa ye shes spyan ldan shog: badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas rim bzhin mig dar rnams bsal: rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po sngon chad bdag gi ma mthong ba'i mthong ba bstan pa dang don ngo sprod par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ bla ma sangs rgyas mchog tu rig: dam tshig rdo rje srog tu gces: bdag cag sngon gyi 'phro mtha' sad: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol:

zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ slob dpon gyis/ de ltar glo bur gyi sgrib pa bsal nas rnam dag ye shes kyi mig thob pas/ bla med yang dag ye shes rol pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hoḥ de ltar yin na las 'phro ldan: skal ldan bsod nams legs par bsags: smin pa'i dbang mchog bdag gis bskur: dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'di la ltos: de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor ngo sprad pa la phyag shing thogs nas: hoḥ skal ldan gyi skyes bu rnams legs par ltos: bla ma gsang ba'i pho brang chen po 'di nyid kyi: brda don dkrol zhing ngo sprad pas: dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dmar mdangs rgyas pa ni: snang mtha'i dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: kha dog legs shing bkra la mdzes pa ni: 'ja' lus rdo rje 'chi med ston pa'i brda: lnga ldan rtsig pa phra zhing rgyas pa ni: ye shes lnga ldan klong lnga zang thal mtshon pa'i brda: 'dod snam dmar po lha mo'i mchod sprin gtibs pa ni: phyogs dus rgyal kun mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i brda: pha gu gser zhing ser la dwangs pa ni: gzhal yas khang la 'dod rgu mtshon pa'i brda: mun nag drwa ba'i rgyan 'phyang mdzes pa ni: ma rig sgrib bsal shes rab lta mdzes brda: mda' yab dkar po pu shu bkram pa ni: rnam dag a ti phyogs ris bral ba'i brda: ka ba ka rgyan rang mdog mdzes rgyan 'di: tshad med bzhi ldan dran rdzogs gsal pa'i brda: ku gur nag la bsnums shing 'khyil ba 'di: bag chags a 'thas sgrib g.yogs bral ba'i brda: rta babs rnam bzhi 'byung lnga brtsegs thabs ni: ye shes gzhal yas longs sku'i rtsal snang brda: chos 'khor bang rim bcu gsum brtan pa ni: mi shigs rdo rje bcu gsum mtshon pa'i brda: ri dwags pho mos chos sgra nyan pa ni: nyan thos theg dman sa lam gong bgrod brda: pho brang rdzas brgyad rtags kun bsgrengs pa ni:

longs sku tshe bdag zil phreng 'byed pa'i brda: rdo rje'i rmang gzhi sra mkhregs ldan pa ni: ye shes dbyings la g.yo med brtan pa'i brda: pad phreng dur khrod rdo rwa mdzes pa ni: phrin las bzhi ldan 'gro ba 'dul ba'i brda: me ri lnga ldan phyogs su 'khrigs pa ni: tshe dus bdud kyi bar chad gzhom pa'i brda: nang du tshe lha yongs rdzogs bzhugs pa ni: sprul sku sna tshogs rang rtsal 'gyed pa'i brda: ma 'dres dbyings la 'ja' ltar shar ba ni: gang 'dul der ston 'gro ba 'dul ba'i brda: stong nyid rang sgra 'dzab dbyangs sgrogs pa ni: tshe yi rig 'dzin mi zad rgyun 'byung brda: gzhan yang phyogs bzhi bum pa bhan+dha dang : me long dkyil 'khor rgyal mtshan bzhi ldan ni: dbyings kyi pho brang sprul skur 'byung ba'i brda: ral gri phur pa me long mda' dar dang : tshon skud drwa ba stag sham rgyan 'phyang du mas brgyan pa ni: chos sku'i rtsal snang longs sku zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i brda'o: de ltar brda don rtags gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor/ nang rdo rje phung po lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzhan gdod nas bzhugs pa'i gnas yul gyi dkyil 'khor gsum/ rang rig bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rtsal dang rol pa nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du skad cig 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i rang zhal rang rig 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes de nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces de dag gis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub ste dngos gzhi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ bla ma rig 'dzin dbyings nas gshegs: skal ldan mos pa'i bu la bzhugs: sgo gsum phyag 'tshal dbang pos mchod: sdig bshags 'gro don chos 'khor bskor: dbang gis smin grol dngos grub stsol: zhes gsol ba btab pa la thog mar tshe 'gugs shing bcud bsdu ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma srid zhi'i tshe dpal thams cad rdo khab len gyis/ lcags phye blangs pa bzhin bsdus te bdag mdun gyi sgrub rdzas rnams dang slob ma'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings yangs pa'i dbus: rnam dag 'od gsal pho brang nas: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha: rigs lnga la sogs tshe 'dzin 'bum: deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: ā yur tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ ma ma hri nṛ su puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: spro na tshe 'gugs rgyas pa yang bya/ hūm̐: bum pa ye shes gzhal yas khang : zang thal phyi nang mtha' dbus bral: bum pa'i bdud rtsi 'chi med rdzas: ro bcud yon tan lnga dang ldan: bum pa'i kha rgyan dpag bsam ljon: dgos 'dod 'byung zhing dbyings la khyab: bum pa'i sgro mdangs sku lnga'i mchog: dug lnga ma rig ka nas dag: bum pa'i gzung thag 'od zer phreng : 'ja' gur lug rgyud sprin ltar gtibs: bum pa'i mgul chings lha rdzas gos: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: bum pa'i gdan ni g.yung drung 'khyil: mi shigs rdo rje'i dbyings dang ldan: phyag rgya bdun gyis btab pa 'di: skal ldan spyi bor dbang bskur bas: tshe srog brtan cing gnas gyur cig: chos kyi dbyings su tshe 'dzugs so: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na dharma khaṃ ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: da dngos gzhi la bum gsang shes rab tshig gi dbang bcas bzhi yod pa las/

dang po la'ang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang lnga'i dang po la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum dbang*/ nang nus pa 'jug pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang gsum yod pa las/ dang po bum dbang gi slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du 'chi med mgon po tshe dpag med yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pa/ 'khor lo lnga 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa yang gsang tshe yi mkha': bdud rtsi 'chi med ngo bo'i lha: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang nyon mongs pa lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa de la/ sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing*/ bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs du ma dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal paur mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/

byas la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyed dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog dor zhing maṇ+ḍal phul: gnyis pa nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams tshe lha'i rang bzhin du gsal la slob dpon yang pad+ma tshe dpag med dngos su mos pa bskyed la gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min sku gsum zhing khams rab 'byams nas/ 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs spyan drangs bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam pa grangs med 'phros te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe lha yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung dbyings rig longs spyod rdzogs: gsang ye shes rab gnyis med 'khril: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rdo rje tshe dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje tshe dpag med: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan ma sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rat+na tshe dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan rat+na tshe dpag med: gsang ba mā kī yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rin chen tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ rat+na ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas pad+ma tshe dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan pad+ma tshe dpag med: gos dkar lha mo yum dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: pad+ma tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:
