de nas karma tshe dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: bcom ldan karma tshe dpag med: yum mchog dam tshig sgrol ma sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: karma tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ karma ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar tshe lha rigs lnga'i dbang bskur bas dug lnga'i sgrib pa byang*/ bdud bzhi dang dug lnga las gyur pa'i nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal te phung po lnga rigs lnga'i tshe dpag med du sangs rgyas/ khams lnga mkha' 'gro lngar gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rig 'dzin yab yum drug thogs la: hūm̐: rnam smin sar gnas tshe dbang sogs: gsang ba'i yum mchog drug dang sbyor: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: oṃ bhi dho dha ra ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar rig 'dzin yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa drug sbyangs/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug mngon du byas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas rigs drug pa'i bdag nyid thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rig ma bcu drug thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ye rig ma bcu drug tshogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldan gar stabs bsgyur: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'ja' lus tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe mu dra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rig ma bcu drug gi dbang bskur bas rdo rje lus kyi ljon shing rgyas/ dga' ba bcu drug gi yal 'dab mngon/ thig le stong pa bcu drug gi 'bras bu ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas mgyogs ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: 'chi med bcud 'dzin pho nya mo: dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'gro bzhis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mgyogs ma bzhi'i dbang bskur bas tshad med bzhi ye shes rgyud la skyes shing phrin las rnam bzhi thogs pa med pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig

/ de nas sgo skyong bzhi thogs la/ hūm̐: ye shes 'khor lo brdal khyab kyi: sgo skyong yab yum he ru kas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bdud bzhi tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma kro ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sgo skyong bzhis dbang bskur bas ye shes bzhi rgyud la skyes/ bdud bzhi tshar gcod pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /de ltar lha tshogs rnams gnas so sor thim pas sku'i rnam 'gyur gang dang gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i rnam rol 'gag med snang stong chu zla'i gar bzhin spyod pa'i mthu thob pa yin no/ /de nas phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa ye nas sgyu 'phrul tshe lha'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ phyi nang chas rtags yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ba la brten nas gzi byin 'gran zla dang bral ba'i dpal thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dang po prog zhu thogs la/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags phyir: rin chen 'bar ba'i prog zhu 'di: de ring skal ldan spyi bor brgyan: lta ba ye grol dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra rat+na to sid+dhi ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas cod pan thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga lhun grub dbang rtags phyir: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor brgyan: sgom pa rgya yan dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa dha ri a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas stod g.yogs thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med grol bzhi'i dbang rtags phyir: sna tshogs spel ba'i stod g.yogs 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi dpung par brgyan: spyod pa 'dzin med dbang thob shog: oṃ bhi dza ya ar+bha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas ga shal thogs la: hūm̐: bde stong zag med dbang bstan phyir: drwa ba 'phrul gyi ga shal 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi steng du brgyan: gnyis med zung 'jug dbang thob shog: om̐ rū pa kaṇ+ṭhi ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rus rgyan thogs te: hūm̐: phar phyin drug gi dbang rtags te: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha 'di:

skal ldan khyod kyi chas su brgyan: grol ba bzhi yi dbang thob shog: oṃ go ro tsa ya ma li ti a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas snyan rgyan sogs rin chen gdub bu rnams thogs la: hūm̐: rten 'brel sna tshogs dbang rtags phyir: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan cha 'dis: skal ldan khyod kyi gzugs la brgyan: sa lam rab rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ bhi shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: smad dkris thogs la: hūm̐: 'khor 'das zil gnon dbang rtags phyir: bde chen klub pa'i ang rag 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi smad du dkri: 'bras bu ka dag dbang thob shog: oṃ a tra bha su pra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdzas dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas khyed rang rnams la snod bcud 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma rdzas mchog rin chen lnga'i dbang bskur bas khams lnga nyams pa sor chud pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdzas lnga thogs la: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams na: chu yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bu yi spyi bor bstim: chu shel ha la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na kā ya ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: me yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bu yi mgrin par bstim: me shel a la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na wāk+ka ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: sems kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: nam mkha'i klong nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bu yi snying khar bstim: baiḍūr nṛ la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na tsit+ta ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: sha yi khams nas tshe nyams na: sa yi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bu yi lte bar bstim: puṇ+ṭa pa la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na gu na ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi:

dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: rlung gi khams nas bcud bsdus la: skal ldan bu yi gsang bar bstim: ke ru ha la tshe sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na gu h+ya ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: de nas sman lnga thogs la: de nas khyed rang rnams la sman lnga'i dbang bskur bas dug lnga'i rkyen gyis tshe bcud nyams pa gsos te bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad zhi ba'i gyur cig /hūm̐: ma rig dug lngas tshe nyams na: sman mchog lnga yi bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: ye shes lnga yi gter sba'o: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na pañca ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: de nas bcud kyi rdzas lnga thogs la: de nas khyed rang rnams la snying po lnga'i dbang bskur bas rtsa rlung thig le'i stobs nyams pa sor chud de bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rtsa thig rlung lnga'i tshe nyams na: rdzas mchog lnga yi bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub la khyad par bstim: bde stong drod kyi tshe sba'o: oṃ su khaṃ swa bhā dz+wa la ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ hrīḥdamar gsal gyi mthar dbyangs dang sngags phreng g.yas skor du rang sgra 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du sngags phreng bar ma chad par 'phros te 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥ oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dz+nyā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥdha ya su khaṃ sid+dhi dzaḥ

bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis gzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hrīḥyig la thim pas gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing brjod med grags stong gsung rdo rje mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lor dbang bsgyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i slad du sngags phreng thogs te: hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor bzung ba'i phyir: phrin las bzlas brjod sngags kyi phreng : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yongs rdzogs las mtha' thob par shog: oṃ gu h+ya karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar gsung sngags kyi dbang bskur bas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying por longs spyod cing dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ de nas tshe chang thogs la: de nas tshe chang 'di nyid ngo bo 'chi med mgon po stangs dpyal gyi byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngag tu blud pa tsam gyis bde stong 'gyur ba med pa'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: dam tshig ye shes mkha' 'gro yis: rang byung gsang ba'i rdzas la brten: 'ja' lus grub pa'i bdud rtsi nyid: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta aṇ+ṭa sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon 'chi med tshe mtha' yas pa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas/ gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag stai rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes rang byung don gyi tshe dpag med mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

me long thogs te: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: skye 'gag bral ba 'chi med lha: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yang dag rdzogs rim dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag / de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / de nas tshe'i ril bu dang 'brang rgyas thogs la: de nas tshe ril 'di nyid 'khor 'das snang srid yongs kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor bcud du dril ba'i rdzas mchog tu dmigs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i lam du bstim pa tsam gyis rdo rje'i srog la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: sngon byon drang srong rig 'dzin gyis: bla med mchog gi rdzas la brten: 'chi med tshe yi ril bu 'di: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bzang po'i dbang bskur bas 'gro ba'i re 'dod 'bad med yid bzhin du skong ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tshe'i gtor ma thogs te: hūm̐: 'chi med rdzas mchog rmad du byung : yon tan kun 'byung ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phyi nang sgrub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ gu na sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas rgud pa mtha' dag zhi nas bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/

lnga pa phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ba yin te/ lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon pa'i phyag mtshan dang 'chi med tshe'i rdzas dbang bcas bskur bas phrin las yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'dun pa mdzod/ de nas rig 'dzin lnga'i phyag mtshan thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen dngul gyi a dar+sha: me long ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med par tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dz+nyā na ru bh+ya a dar+sha tiṣ+ṭha nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: pad+ma tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen byi ru'i bum pa 'di: sor rtogs ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med par tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ka ma la ā yur+dz+nyā na rā ga lak+ṣa nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: bud+dha tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen mu tig cod pan 'di: chos dbyings ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dz+nyā na mu ti ka ku mu ku ṭa tiṣ+ṭha nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: rat+na tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen gser gyi 'khor lo 'di: mnyam nyid ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ rat+na ā yur+dz+nyā na swa na tsakra nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: hūm̐: karma tshe dpag ngo bo nyid: rin chen g.yu yi rdo rje 'di: bya grub ye shes tshe yi rten: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe 'dzugs so: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ karma ā yur+dz+nyā na bā+ai ro tsa badz+ra nṛ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ phyi nang snod bcud rtog tshogs dang bcas pa 'chi med tshe lha'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas/ tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las la mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /de nas gnyis pa gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba la bhan+dha zla gam bde chen dbang gi pho brang du mos pa'i dbus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i bde chen gyi sgras phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs tshe lha rab 'byams spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mkha' gsang nas yab kyi byang sems dri ma med pa mdangs can dang*/ yum gyi byang sems mtshal zhun lta bu lhan cig tu babs pa bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'khyil ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kyi dbyibs su gyur pa 'di nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing myangs pa la brten nas lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs shing dwangs ma'i srog rten la thim pas bde stong zag pa med par nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bhan+dha dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha': bdud rtsi dam tshig shes rab dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gnyis med gsang dbang thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /rdzogs rim gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa gzungs ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs ka nas tshe yum tsaṇ+ḍa lī bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung ba/ khyed rang rnams la gtad pas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dga' bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i 'dun pa mdzod/ ces rig ma thogs la/ hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren bzung : dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ pra mo ti ri mi dharma hoḥ zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar 'du shes sum ldan gyis rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos mdzod/ de ltar yum mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku 'thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams sgo gsum rang babs su klod la gang shar gyi ngo bor bzo ma bcos par/ shig ge 'bol le zhog mdzod/ man shel thogs la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings:

rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid: ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dz+nyā na hrī da hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag la/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ rab tu spros med a ti rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob/ shes bya'i sgrib pa ches phra ba sbyangs/ ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ tshe 'gugs shing bcud bsdu ba ni/ mda' dar thogs la: de nas slob dpon tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs pa ka nas rigs bzhi tshe'i mgyogs ma rang mdog phyag mtshan mda' dar thogs pa nam mkha' gang bar 'phros te/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs lha dang drang srong bskal par gnas pa'i tshe bcud brtan g.yos bkrag mdangs gzi brjid tshe bsod dpal yon ma lus pa/ khab len rdo yis lcags phye blang ba bzhin bsdus te slob ma dang tshe rdzas la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bde chen mkha' spyod du: snang mtha' mgon po gsang ba ye shes gnyis: zab dbyings 'od gsal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og gsang chen ma la 'bar ba'i gnas: rta mchog dbang chen rdo rje phag mo gnyis: khro rgyal stobs 'dus rtsa gsum zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og mā ra ti ka'i gnas mchog tu: pad+ma 'byung gnas man+da ra ba gnyis: yang gsang tshe yi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub:

de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu: sangs rgyas ye shes dhe wa dha ra gnyis: zab gsang bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: bgres rgud med pa rig 'dzin 'ja' lus grub: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: de 'og tsā ri zil chen gsang ba'i gnas: gnam lcags rdo rje gsang ba'i rig ma gnyis: 'chi bdag zil gnon dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: 'chi med rig 'dzin rdo rje'i srog bsgrubs pas: rlung sems rten 'brel 'khrul 'khor gnad du phebs: de yi byin rlabs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: hūm̐: sngon dus tshe yi khungs yang bzang : bar du bka' gtad smon lam zab: da lta rten 'brel gnad kyang 'grigs: phyis 'byung mtshams sbyor 'phro mtha' btsan: de phyir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags spel: chos dang brgyud 'dzin srid kyang skyongs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs mas: phyag na lcags kyu mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma dkar mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs mas: phyag na zhags pa mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma ser mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs mas: phyag na lcags sgrog mda' dar 'dzin: mgyogs ma dmar mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs mas: phyag na dril bu mda' dar 'dzin:

mgyogs ma ljang mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs mas: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: mgyogs ma sngon mo bye ba 'bum: 'byung lnga gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la bstim: skye 'chi bgres rgud med par stsol: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ mda' dar gnas lngar reg cing*/ ye shes lnga'i phyag rgya mtshon pa'i mda' dar gnas gsum du bzhag cing rgyas btab pas/ nam yang skye shi 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba rtag brtan gzhom med sku lnga'i tshe dbang brnyes par mos shig /hūm̐: dang po chos dbyings nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa rig 'dzin drug gi rgya: bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun rgya: brgyad pa nye ba'i sras brgyad rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya: yab yum bcu yi rgyas btab pas: nam yang mi 'gyur brtan pa yi: yang dag ye shes gter sba'o: om̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: tshe dbang du gyur cig /dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig /tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig /tshe srog rdo rje'i brag ri bas sra zhing brtan pa la mnga' mnyes par gyur cig / de nas mtha' rten byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang ni/ gtso gtor thogs la/ da gtor ma 'di nyid mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dngos su gsal ba'i steng gi cha la brgyud gsum bla ma'i tshogs dang*/ bar gyi cha la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad/

byon nas mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar khyed rang rnams la dbyer med du thim pas byin rlabs thams cad da lta nyid du thob par sgoms: oṃ: sku yi lha dbang lus la bskur: āḥ gsung gi sngags dbang ngag la bskur: hūm̐: thugs kyi chos dbang sems la bskur: hrīḥ yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhrī badz+ra ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe dbang du gyur cig /dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig /tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig /tshe srog rdo rje'i brag ri bas sra zhing brtan pa la mnga' mnyes par gyur cig / de nas rgyal srid sna bdun thogs la: de ltar tshe sgrub zab mo 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi smin byed dbang bskur gyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gis brgyan pa legs par grub ste/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i don du shin tu bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: tshe chos snyan grags spel ba 'di: 'khor lo rin chen rgyas gdab bo: longs spyod dpal 'byor char bzhin 'bebs: nor bu rin chen rgyas gdab bo: srid dang mnga' thang char bzhin 'bebs: btsun mo rin chen rgyas gdab bo: khams gsum dbang bsdus bran du bkol: blon po rin chen rgyas gdab bo: brjid chags bang khang phyugs kyi rdzas: glang po rin chen rgyas gdab bo: rtsal chen phrin las myur mgyogs ldan: rta mchog rin chen rgyas gdab bo: bdud bzhi bar gcod log 'dren gzhom: dmag dpon rin chen rgyas gdab bo: rgol ba tshar gcod dpa' rtsal ldan: phyag rgya bdun gyis rgyas gdab bo: brtan cing rab tu gnas gyur cig: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na dza ye puṇ+ye sa bha su pra tiṣ+ṭha bh+rūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: mi nub rgyal mtshan rin po ches:

skal ldan lus la bkra shis shog: tshangs dbyangs chos dung rin po ches: skal ldan ngag la bkra shis shog: byang sems dpal be'u rin po ches: skal ldan yid la bkra shis shog: gser gyi 'khor lo rin po ches: skal ldan zung 'jug bkra shis shog: dgos 'byung nor bu rin po ches: skal ldan bsam 'phel bkra shis shog: kun khyab gdugs mchog rin po ches: skal ldan mkha' khyab bkra shis shog: thabs shes gser nya rin po ches: skal ldan don gyi bkra shis shog: skyon bral pad+ma rin po ches: skal ldan rten 'brel bkra shis shog: bkra shis rtags brgyad don dang dgus: theg pa rim dgu'i bkra shis shog: oṃ maṅga laṃ wa na a su pra tiṣ+ṭha ya bha wan+tu swā hā: de nas dkyil 'khor pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bden tshig gi smon lam dang shis tshigs brjod pas dge legs kyi snang ba chen pos phyogs kun tu khyab cing brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: ma chags pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing*/ /'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin grub pa'i sku/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyi dbang chen u pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba thob pa yin pas: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang mi 'bral zhing bsnyen sgrub 'bad rtsol dang 'chad rtsom sogs kyi phyi nang gi go rim byed du rung ba yin no: dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ gtso bos ci ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: lan gsum/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: lan gsum/ rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ 'chim̐ bdam̐g zim̐l gnom̐n tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'jug par dbam̐ng ba'i lde mig ut+pala'i/ /phreng 'di gsaṃng ba sngagaṃs kyi mdzod 'chang zhing*/ /bstanaṃ pa'i gdung gsob 'dziṃn la mchog tu rmad/ de dag ni zhe dgu pa tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ spros bcas dbang chen ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i smin byed gyi dbang khrigs bltas chog tu bkod pa ste 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ tshem̐ dang sgrubam̐ pa mtha' ru phyin pa'i thabs/ /dus min 'chim̐ bdam̐g bdud bzhi zim̐l gnom̐n phyir/ /dbam̐ng bskur 'brim̐ng po'i chog khrigs 'jam̐' tshom̐n phrem̐ng*/ /dwang bam̐'i blo yis spel la rjes gnang stsol/ lnga bcu pa tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon gyi dbang 'bring 'ja' tshon phreng ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdun stegs kyi thog tu dkyil 'khor ram 'bru tshom bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings tshang ba'i nang du bum rdzas nyer lnga chu dang sbyar te sum gnyis dgang*/ rigs lnga bhan+dha shel phreng tsakli tshe gtor sogs gzhung bzhin bshams/ de nas lha tsaka kyi skor la bum tsaka

/tshe lha rigs lnga/ mgyogs ma bzhi/ mdun du sman raka gtor tshogs gzhan mtha' bskor du nyer spyod dang sngon gtor bcas 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang skyes rabs gsol 'debs song nas/ las gzhung gsol 'debs las byang gsang sgrub chog khrigs ltar skyabs sems nas bzung*/ bdag bskyed bstod pa'i mjug tu dzap khang dbye bsnyen pa grub rjes tshe 'gugs dang*/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum sgrub/ rjes su dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod 'od zhu nas rig pa'i me tog tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i gsol gdab rnams bya la dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ mthar rang lugs gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba la slob ma mdun du bos te thog mar khrus bstsal pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/

lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug / steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du thog mar 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la slob par bya snyam pas thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi lo rgyus mdo tsam smos na/ slob dpon pad+ma yab yum sngar brag phug mā ra ti kar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon dang rdo rje'i go khrab dngos su gnang nas/

rgya gar 'di'i byang phyogs su tsā ri dag pa shrī'i gnas mchog zil chen gsang phug bya ba yod de/ der sgrubs shig ces lung bstan pa bzhin slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ lha lcam man+da ra ba gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te zil chen gsang ba'i gnas su sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ brag las dngos su tshe chu rdol/ tshe bum rang byung mi tshad gnyis long ba tsam du gyur/ tshogs 'khor gyi skabs mkha' spyod zhing nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos su byon/ khyad par gangs gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi zhing skyong rnams dbang du bsdus shing dam la bzhag /de'i tsher tshe sgrub brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad cing*/ khyad par du zab pa'i mthar thug tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon 'di nyid tshe ril dang tshe chu bcas lha lcam gyis gu ru'i gsungs bzhin dam rdzas dang shog dril/ la cha'i gwa'ur dril/ gu rus rab tu gnas par mdzad de tsā ri zil chen gsang phug brag tu tshe bum rang byon gyi g.yon du rgya rim pa lnga dang bcas nas sbas/ gter srung zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu la bcol/ rta mgrin khro rgyal stobs 'dus/ g.yon gyi shug pa'i gong du sbas ste/ sgrub pa'i gnas rta mgrin rong gi dbu rtser brag chos 'byung 'dra bar lung bstan/ gter srung rgyal po mdung dmar can la gnyer gtad cing chos bdag bu la 'phrod pa'i smon lam btab bo/ /de ltar gu ru pad+ma kā ra dang gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes zung gi rnam 'phrul/ gter chen gnam lcags rdo rje'am rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos gangs can bod kyi gnas chen yongs kyi rgyal po dpal gyi tsā ri ṭa'i brag tshe bum rang byon las sku tshab dam rdzas a ma ril bu lhan du spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon zhes/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin 'chi med pad+ma yab yum la mgon po tshe dpag med kyi dngos su gnang zhing dbang bskur/ lung bstan pa/ sprul gzhi tshe dpag med dang dbyer ma mchis pa tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i thugs dam gyi lha mchog rtsod med du grags pa/

'chi med tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi bdag: gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug tu gsol: zhes zhus pas lan gdab pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ hoḥ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i pho brang 'di: dam med rnams la bstan mi bya: zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ nged rnams sngon sbyangs las can ste: lam mchog 'dir mos dam la gnas: srog la bab kyang mi 'da' 'tshal: de nas dam chu sbyin: 'o na rdo rje bka' gtsig las mi 'da' ba'i slad du dam blang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig bla med chu: bsrungs na 'chi med rig 'dzin thob: nyams na dmyal ba'i sa bon nyid: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : de ltar khe nyen gyi gnad shes par gyis la dam chu 'di bzhes 'tshal/ oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma tshe dpag med pa la phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phyi so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang byang sems kyi sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bsags sbyang gi gnad 'dus 'di'i don la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can gyis: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la skyabs su mchi:

'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog: thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams song ste/ dbang gi gzhi brtan par bya ba'i slad du ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun la sems gnad gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du: rang nyid 'chi med tshe'i bdag po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can zhal gsum dmar chags dkar bzhad mthing la dgyes 'dzum ste bag dro ldan pa: dbu la longs sku'i rgyan dang cod pan 'phur ba: phyag drug g.yas gsum gyis rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo 'dzin cing : g.yon gsum gyis pad+ma rgya gram tshe bum bsnams pa: dar tshon bklubs shing skyil krung gis bzhugs te: gsang ye dmar mos mda' dar dang bhan+dha 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud pa'o: phyogs bzhir tshe bdag rig 'dzin yab yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin dang bral bar gsal ba'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing nas 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par gyur/ oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai: bla ma tshe dpag med pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: dbang bskur rjes su gnang mdzad nas: dam tshig chen po la gnas pa'i: skal ldan smin par mdzad du gsol: de nas tshe bskul ba la/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros te phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma srid zhi'i tshe dpal thams cad/ rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa bzhin bsdus te bdag mdun sgrub rdzas rnams dang slob ma'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings yangs pa'i dbus: rnam dag 'od gsal pho brang nas: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha: rigs lnga la sogs tshe 'dzin 'bum: deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: ā yur tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ ma ma hri nṛ su puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin par mos: lha klu mi yi bcud bsdus nas: skal ldan slob ma'i lus la bstim: tshe yi rig 'dzin myur thob mdzod: de nas phyi bum pa rin po che'i pho brang du bla ma tshe dpag med pa mngon sum du gsal ba'i sku las 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa khyed rnams la dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi nad gdon dag /mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku thob par mos mdzod/ de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: bum pa yang gsang tshe yi mkha': bdud rtsi 'chi med ngo bo'i lhas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: slar mdun bskyed gtso 'khor las rang 'dra gnyis pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams la gnyis med du thim par mos mdzod/ de nas rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan tshe yi lha: 'chi med yab yum gnyis su med:

skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yongs rdzogs tshe yi dbang thob shog: om̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na pañca a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas sgo ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: 'chi med bcud 'dzin pho nya mo: dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'gro bzhis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bhan+dha rang byung bde ba chen po'i snod du tshe lha yab yum gyi ngo bo byang sems bdud rtsi'i bcud du 'khyil ba lcer bzhag pas ngag sgrib dag /grags stong gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang thob par mos mdzod/ de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: bhan+dha dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha': bdud rtsi dam tshig shes rab dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gnyis med gsang dbang thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba zhig nar gyis byung ste slob ma'i zhal nas rgyud cing thugs kar thim pas mos pas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥ oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yur+dz+nyā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥdha ya su khaṃ sid+dhi dzaḥ de nyid brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ de nas sngags phreng thogs te: hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor bzung ba'i phyir: phrin las bzlas brjod sngags kyi phreng : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yongs rdzogs las mtha' thob par shog: oṃ gu h+ya karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes kyi thugs de kho na nyid mtshon pa'i me long gi dbang bskur bas/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs mi g.yo ba chos sku thob par mos mdzod/ de nas me long thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: skye 'gag bral ba 'chi med lhas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yang dag rdzogs rim dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas tshe'i bum pa bzang po'i dbang bskur bas/

yon tan mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo la dbang bsgyur bar mos mdzod/ de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: 'chi med rdzas mchog rmad du byung : yon tan kun 'byung ngo bo nyid: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phyi nang sgrub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ gu na sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe ril 'di nyid 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud dril ba'i rdzas mchog mgrin par gtad pas/ snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas rdo rje'i srog la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tshe'i ril bu dang 'brang rgyas thogs la: hūm̐: sngon byon drang srong rig 'dzin gyis: bla med mchog gi rdzas la brten: 'chi med tshe yi ril bu 'di: de ring skal ldan bu la sbyin: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe chang 'chi med mgon po stangs dpyal gyi byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can phul ba tsam gyis bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ dwangs ma'i srog rten la thim pas tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dam tshig ye shes mkha' 'gro yis: rang byung gsang ba'i rdzas la brten: 'ja' lus grub pa'i bdud rtsi nyid: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta aṇ+ṭa sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ye shes lnga'i phyag rgyar mtshon pa'i mda' dar gnas gsum du bzhag cing rgyas btab pas nam yang skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba/ rtag brtan gzhom med sku lnga'i tshe dbang brnyes par mos shig / mda' dar gyi rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: ting 'dzin mi shigs rdo rje yi: skal ldan gnas lngar rgya yis gdab: tshe srog g.yung drung brtan par tshugs: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub par shog: om̐ badz+ra maṇ+ṭa ra tri dz+nyā na pañca tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: de nas dbang bskur gyi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig spyi dang bye brag la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ

gtso bos ci ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: lan gsum/ dbang bskur thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ ༈ skabs 'gar tshe dbang grangs gsog sogs long khom dang bstun/ tshe dbang bsdus par 'dod na/ gsang sgrub gzhung bsrang*/ bsnyen sgrub bum pa gnyis sgrub la mchod bstod 'od zhu bdag dbang blang ba sogs dbang 'bring ltar dang*/ sngon 'gro khrus nas dbyung ba bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom pa sogs sngags tsam gyis bya/ lo rgyus bsdus tsam brjod/ skyabs sems 'bring po las blang*/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma tshe dpag med mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas bsags sbyang gi gnad 'dus 'di'i don la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can gyis: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog:

thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams song ste/ de nas dbang gi gzhi brtan par bya ba'i slad du ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun la sems gnad gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta

sa bsang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la khyed rang rnams tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gsum phyag drug rtsa phyag gis rdo rje dang bhan+dha/ lhag mas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bsnams shing yum mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin pa dang 'khyud pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can yab yum snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis bskul bas/ tshe lha rig 'dzin drang srong rnams spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na gu h+ya ḍāk+ki hrīḥ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ mda' dar g.yab cing tshe bskul ba ni/ de nas tshe 'gugs shing bcud bsdu ba ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros te phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma srid zhi'i tshe dpal thams cad/ rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa bzhin bsdus te bdag mdun sgrub rdzas rnams dang slob ma'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings yangs pa'i dbus: rnam dag 'od gsal pho brang nas: 'chi med mgon po tshe yi lha: rigs lnga la sogs tshe 'dzin 'bum: deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: ā yur tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: oṃ ma ma hrī nṛ su puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas tshe bum spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐: bum pa ye shes gzhal yas khang : zang thal phyi nang mtha' dbus bral: bum pa'i bdud rtsi 'chi med rdzas: ro bcud yon tan lnga dang ldan: bum pa'i kha rgyan dpag bsam ljon: dgos 'dod 'byung zhing dbyings la khyab: bum pa'i sgro mdangs sku lnga'i mchog: dug lnga ma rig ka nas dag: bum pa'i gzung thag 'od zer phreng : 'ja' gur lug rgyud sprin ltar gtibs: bum pa'i mgul chings lha rdzas gos: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: bum pa'i gdan ni g.yung drung 'khyil:

mi shigs rdo rje'i dbyings dang ldan: phyag rgya bdun gyis btab pa 'di: skal ldan spyi bor dbang bskur bas: tshe srog brtan cing gnas gyur cig: chos kyi dbyings su tshe 'dzugs so: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na dharma khaṃ ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu mdzod cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig /'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ de nas 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud gcig tu dril ba'i tshe ril 'di gtad pas/ mi shigs pa'i thig le dang 'dres te rdo rje'i srog la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe'i ril bu thogs la: hūm̐: phung po lnga yi tshe nyams na: 'bru mchog lnga yi bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: longs spyod dpal gyi dbang thob shog: oṃ gha na la ā yur+dz+nyā na ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu mdzod cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig /'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ de nas tshe chang byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can phul ba tsam gyis bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ dwangs ma'i srog rten la thim pas tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dbang po lnga yi tshe nyams na: dkar mngar ro mchog bcud bsdus la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: zag med bcud kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ a mṛ ta ā yur+dz+nyā na ni dhi gu pa ta ye swā hā: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu mdzod cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig /'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ mda' dar gyi rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: ting 'dzin mi shigs rdo rje yis: skal ldan gnas lngar rgya yis gdab:

tshe srog g.yung drung brtan par tshugs: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub par shog: om̐ badz+ra maṇ+ṭa ra tri dz+nyā na pañca tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu mdzod cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig /'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ 'chim̐ med mgon po tshe bdam̐g snang mtha' yas/ /snang srid zim̐l gnom̐n tshe dbam̐ng rig 'dzin lhar/ /brten nas gsaṃng sngaṃgs smin grol bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bstanaṃ 'gro'i tshe srog mthud la 'dziṃn spel gces/ de dag ni lnga bcu pa tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon las/ dbang 'bring bsdus kyi le tshan no// // ༈ mtha' rten tshem̐ dang don gnyis bsgrubam̐ pa'i phyir/ /tshe srog mi 'gyur lcam̐gs kyim̐ rgyam̐ mdudam̐ la/ /dbam̐ng sgyur mi shigs ting 'dzin gnam̐m lcam̐gs kyi/ /rdom̐ rjem̐'i gom̐ chas rgyas btab khram̐b gos bklub/ nga gcig pa mtha' rten bkra shis par byed pa 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba la/ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi tshe dbang zab mo gnam lcags go khrab khrigs chags su dgod pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdun stegs kyi thog tu dkyil 'khor ram 'bru tshom bkod pa'i dbus su rnam bum mgul chings dmar po/ mdun du tshe chang*/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du mda' dar/ rgyab tu tshe gtor dang rgyas 'debs kyi rgya gram/ de nas lha tsaka gis skor la tshe dpag med/ tshe lha rigs lnga'i sku/ mkha' 'gro rigs lnga/ mgyogs ma bzhi/ dkyil 'khor/ mdun du sman raka gtor tshogs gzhan mtha' bskor du nyer spyod dang sngon gtor bcas 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang skyes rabs gsol 'debs sogs song nas/

las gzhung gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed bsnyen pa grub pa dang rtsa sgrub ltar mdun bskyed bya/ de nas tshe 'gugs thugs rje'i pho nya grub nas rta mgrin gsang sgrub spro na bla 'gugs dang bcas song rjes rnam bum dang las bum sgrub/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod 'od zhu nas rig pa'i me tog tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i gsol gdab rnams bya la dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ mthar mdung dmar can sogs rang lugs gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba la slob ma mdun du bos nas thog mar khrus bstsal pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la tshe dbang zab mo bsgrub par mi dbang bar byed pa'i/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin kyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/

rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug / steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /de'ang thun mong theg pa'i lam la zhugs na bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par rtsol sgrub kyi yun 'gor bas/ de'i bar du ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dos drag pos mnar bar 'dug pas/ da res tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bras bu rdo rje theg par zhugs par bya'o/ /de'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sngon du ma song na mi rung ste/ rgyud gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /nyan la sogs par brtson pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la slob par bya snyam pas thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug mi 'dzin pa lnga dang bcas pa spangs nas legs par gsan dgos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ zhes gsungs pa thugs nges dang*/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes/ chos nyams su len pa ni/ sman bsten na nad nye bar sel ba'i 'du shes te yang dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dngos su mos gus dad pa dang ldan pas sgo gsum legs par bsdams te gzhan du ma yengs pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar rang re rnams kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu lon pa'i dpe brgya stong gis char yang mi phod pa/ shin tu rnyed par dka' la rnyed na don chen po dang ldan pa dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus rten bzang po zhig rnyed zin kyang*/ de kho nas mi chog ste phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos shig bsgrub dgos/ de'ang 'phral du ma sgrub tshe lar snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'tsho rkyen ni dkon zhing*/ 'chi rkyen ni mang bas/ nam 'chi cha med 'chi rkyen nges med yin pa ma tshad tha na de ring dang sang nyin tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ 'chi ba'i tshe gnyen nye 'brel/ grogs dga' mdza'/ thob go sa/ nor longs spyod sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang ste/ las dkar nag 'ba' zhig rjes su 'brang bas bde sdug gi 'bras bu mi bslu bar myong dgos/ de'i tshe da lta dge ba ma sgrub par khyer rgyu ni med/ sdig pa mi 'dod kyang 'dor du ni mi btub/ de bas da lta nyid nas blang dor phyin ci ma log pa zhig sgrub pa gal che/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das shing*/ des na pha ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs rnam grol gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos rnam dag cig sgrub dgos so/ /de la 'dir rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la bka' babs shing*/

thugs dam gyi lha mchog rtsod med du grags pa 'chi med tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'i bka' srol snga phyi du mar byon pa rnams kyi nang tshan/ mthu chen bud+dha dz+nyā na'i sku'i rnam 'phrul/ gter ston grub thob thams cad kyi spyi mes/ sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal lam gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes gze ma yo gangs kyi nye 'gram mkha' 'gro snying phug nas/ sa phag lor gdan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi tshe dbang zab mo gnam lcags go khrab ces bya ba bskur ba yin te: sngon 'og min snang mtha' rdo rje'i mkha' la 'khor 'das rig pa'i mgon po tshe dpag med ces bya ba: phyi ltar snang mtha'i ngo bo: nang ltar che mchog tshe bdag: gsang ba ltar na rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas rnams dgongs pa bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i klong las grol ba yin no: de'ang rgyud las: 'og min gnas nas legs sprul te: snang mtha'i zer las pad 'byung pa: dpal ldan de ni pad+ma skyes: zhes pa ltar: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: brag phug mā ra ti ka ru: tshe sgrub brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad cing : dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba'i snying byang brgyad mdzad cing bod yul g.ya' ma lung du tshe bsgrubs shing 'chi med kyi rig 'dzin dngos su rnyed pa'i tshe: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la tshe chu 'dren te tshe lo brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel bab ste: mi ṭa kan+dhi dha ra dang : bā+ai rin chen mchog gnyis bsam yas su phyin: rgyal po'i spyan sngar slob dpon gyis gsungs bzhin zhus: rgyal po'ang thugs rab tu mnyes te 'byon par chas: rta khal lnga bcu la gser dngul ja dar gos sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bkal te sngon du brdzangs te: rgyal po dang nang blon rnams phyi la 'byon par gros byas: rta mchog ngang pa gser ldan la: chibs sga bkra shis rgyan can sgron cing rin po che'i dar sna lngas brgyan te:

rgyal po chibs kyi khar phebs: blon po ye shes 'byung gis sna khrid de chas: phyi blon rnams la skyo sangs yin zhes smras: btsun mo bza' ba dmar rgyan gyis the tshom nas: ngam stag ra klu gong la 'di skad ces smras: nged kyi rgyal po mgo chung blo mang 'di: ring par 'gro ba'i rgyags ches mang bkal te: nang blon blun po mang zhig khrid byas nas: skyo sangs yin zhes phra ma'i tshig kyang smras: rgyal srid stong nas chos la 'gro srid pas: go shes blon po rnams kyis bshol la thob: kha sang mtha' mi dge sbyong ngan pa de: mi tra btang nas rgyal po'i snyan bslus sam: yang na rgyal khams phung ba'i chos bstan 'dra: yang na nga bzhag snying grogs btsal shas che: ji ltar byas kyang blo la bde ba med: rkang mgyogs gnyis la bslab kha zhib mor dris: ci 'thad sa der rgyal po mi 'byon 'thad: ces smras pas: blon po rnams kyis mi tra rnams la dris pa: kha sang khyed rnams chos rgyal drung du byung : yin min 'chol ba'i kha bshad mang zhig zhus: deng sang rgyal po'i thugs blo ma zin par: thag ring 'gro ba'i lam chas mang bkal te: mnga' thang bskyur nas mi bzhugs grabs 'dug pas: mtha' mi 'khyams pos blo yogs smras 'dug gam: yang na khyed tshos rdzas ngan drangs lags sam: ci ltar byas kyang mgo bskor tshab chen 'dug: khyed tshos rdzun du ma smra zhib por smros: ngan bshad blo sna mang na rang srog phung : de bas khyed rnams khrims du mi 'gal gyis: zhes mi tra rkang mgyogs rnams la de skad smras pas: mi tra rnams kyis lan smras pa: e ma rgya gar sku 'khrungs rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : bod yul mun pa'i smag rum gtibs pa la: dam chos gsal ba'i sgron me 'degs su byon: da lta g.ya' ma lung gi dben khrod bzhugs: 'chi med rig 'dzin dngos su grub nas kyang : tshe chu dbang po'i ril bu stong phrag dag: chos rgyal khri srong sku tshe 'phrang sgrol ched:

tshe chu 'dren phyir nged rnams spyan drangs btang : brgya dang bcu gcig bod bzhugs rten 'brel gsungs: khyed tshos ngan blo bsnol tshig kha ma mang : phan pa'i blo la bdud kyis bar chad mang : de bzhin blon po rnams kyang yid mi 'chol: zhes gsungs nas mi tra rkang mgyogs rnams sngon du bros thabs su song : de nas ngam stag ra klu gong dang : btsun mo bza' ba dmar rgyan ke ru thang nag bon byang gi 'gong po rta dmar gyi sprul pa bon po nag chung dang : gnyer pa gser 'phang nag po sogs kyis khri srong lde'u btsan gyi chibs kha nas bzung ste 'di skad zhus: rgyal po blo sna mang na rgyal srid sprang por shor ba'i skyon che: kha sang zla ba sngon ma'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin: rgya gar nas a tsa ra ngan pa tsi dug khur ba dpon g.yog gsum song zer ba kun gyis thos: nged rnams la ca ga gzab par gyis shig zer ba mang zhig byung : mi mang 'ga' zhig shing thu bzhin yod pa rnams kyis mthong nas: a tsa ras dug pha bong la byugs pas dum bu 'ga' zhig tu gas pa mthong : dug yod pa'i rtags su zon rigs dang yi ge yod pa 'dug: nged blon po rnams kyi dpral ba'i mig: khog pa'i snying : srog gi khrag: 'dzam gling kun gyi mgo 'dra ba rgyal po khyed yin la: mtha' mi'i dge sbyong ngan pa mgo bskor mkhan gyi khar brgyugs nas mig can gyis dug 'thung na: rgyal po'i tshe 'dir sku srog la mi phangs kyang rgyal khrims gong nas zhig: blon po bar nas 'thor: mi sde rnams kyis kha bshad ngan pa las mi 'ong bar 'dug pas: cis kyang mi 'byon par zhu zer nas ngam stag ra klu gong gis chibs kha nas bzung ste ma btang : rgyal po yang rmi lam shin tu legs par byung ba yin yang snang ba'i ri mos 'di bslu brid mkhas pa dang : blon po 'di rnams kyang phan sems kyi tshig 'dra ba mang zhig byung snyam ste: the tshom skyes nas re zhig nang du log nas slar rim gyis brtag par gros te gzim chung bar mar log ste sngon la brdzangs pa'i chas rnams phyi bshol btang :

rgyal po yang thugs blo ma bde nas nyin mtshan du mar bsam gzhig mang du byas: de'i tshe slob dpon mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas mkhyen te: tshe chu dang tshe ril bzhag pa'i bum pa dang bhan+dha kha phyes pas g.ya' ma lung stod smad la khyab pa'i dri bzang dang sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ri thams cad 'bir zhing*/ sa yang g.yo ba 'ja' 'od kyi gur dpag tshad tsam yod pa'i dkyil nas lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī sku mdangs dang ldan pa dngos su byon nas: lung bstan pa sogs bkra shis dang ya mtshan khyad du 'phags pa mang du byung : de nas slob dpon gyis tshe chu dang tshe ril rnams dum bu brgyad bgos nas: tshe sgrub zab pa re re dang bcas te phyis ma 'ongs par bod 'bangs skyob pa'i ched dang : rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i chos skal du dmigs nas: sgrom dang : la cha'i bum pa: rdza'i dha ha: zangs kyi gwa'u: bswe'i li ta kaḥ rlung gi par bu sogs mi 'dra ba mang po'i nang du rim pa gsum mam bdun gyis rgya btab nas: rje 'bangs rnams la 'phrad pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar nas: bod kyi mgur lha shin tu gnyan pa re re la gnyer du gtad de: lha lcam gyis gu ru'i gsungs bzhin mi 'gyur pa'i gnas brgyad la gter du sbas: khyad par rten 'brel che ba'i yul dang mtsho sogs gu rus lung bstan pa'i gnas ni rgya gar 'phags yul gangs: sham po rdo rje gangs: ti se gangs: la phyi gangs: tsā ri gangs: sham po gangs: has po gangs: pad+ma gangs: gze rgyal gangs: rong btsan gangs dang bcu'o: rgya gar o tra la'i mtsho zla ba nor bu: bal po ke ru li'i mtsho pad+ma can: lnga sde bye ma gling gi mtsho chen pad+ma bla mtsho: ti se'i ma pham g.yu mtsho: la phyi'i g.yu mtsho: tsā ri'i g.yu mtsho: ma kung lung g.yu mtsho: gze rgyal dung mtsho: rong btsan mtsho dmar sogs lung las grags pa dgu: de rnams rten 'brel la babs pa'i gangs ri gtan du sdod pa: mtsho mo gtan du 'khyil ba rnams la:

bskal pa bzang po'i 'byung ba lnga'am bcud ma nyams pa yod pa yin te: tshe sgrub dang dam rdzas rnams gter du sbos shig gsungs pas: sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la lha lcam rdzu 'phrul gyis lam la zhugs nas nyi ma rtse shar du byon te ri lung thams cad nyul zhing gnas chen rnams la gter kha rim par sbas: lha 'dre drag po che rnams la gnyer byang gtad: dus la bab tshe chos bdag bu la sprod: ces bka' bsgos: slar yang lha lcam slob dpon gyi drung du nyi ma phyed yul du log: rim gyis slob dpon 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku yin par thag chod shin tu 'gyod pa skyes te bshags pa mang du byas rgyan chas rnams slob dpon la phul zhing tshe dbang zhus pas: sngon du rten 'brel ma 'grigs shing the tshom pas brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs rgyu yin yang : bcu bdun las bsring ma thub: de bzhin du phyis 'byung gi rje 'bangs rnams kyi rten 'brel shin tu 'grigs dgos pa yin gsungs: rim bzhin rje 'bangs nyer lnga la kha byang dang lung byang dang gsang rgya sogs legs par gtad de: lha lcam gyis gu ru'i gsungs bzhin mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger btab ste gter du sbas: sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin da lam tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las tshe dbang gnam lcags go khrab kyi dngos gzhi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag gtso: bla ma tshe dpag med pa mgon: gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan gzhug tu gsol: zhes zhus pas lan gdab pa 'di la gsan par zhu/ hoḥ khyed rnams su yin 'dod don gang :

ji ltar snod dang ldan pa yis: dam tshig bka' las mi 'da' zhing : tshul bzhin sgrub pa byed spro'am: zhes dris pa'i lan du khyed rang slob ma rnams kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' zhing : tshul bzhin bsgrub par bdag spro bas: rdo rje tshe mchog bstsal du gsol: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la mkhyen brtse ye shes chen po'i bka' yis gnang ba thob par mos shig /

de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ho/ skye 'chi du khaḥmi dmigs bag yod blos: sgyu ma'i gar tsam mchog gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sgrub pa'i snang tshul de bzhin skyabs su mchi: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma hoḥ sku gsum klong yangs ye shes snying po'i thugs: gdod nas rang byung ka dag ji bzhin du: 'bad rtsol bral ba'i ngang nas sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ tshogs bsags par bya ba'i slad du yan lag bdun pa 'di'i don yid la bzung zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog: thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: ces lan gsum dang*/ de nas dam chu ngag tu sbyin/ hūm̐: dam tshig rang byung dung chen snod: khams lnga'i dbang po bdud rtsis gtams: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: dam srungs badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/

nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba la khyed rang rnams skal ba shin tu bzang ba yin pas: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas blo chos su 'gro ba: chos lam du 'gro ba: lam 'khrul pa byang ba: 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba'i smon lam bzang po dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas yid la dran zhing 'dun pa che bar gyis shig: khyad par du bdag gis tshe dbang zab mo bskur ba la brten nas khyed rang rnams kyis gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa dang : 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par sgoms shig: ces de nas bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: de nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi dbang gi gzhi brtan par bya ba'i slad du ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad skyil krung drang por bsrang*/ ngag gnad rlung kha sbyor du 'ching*/ sems kyi gnad gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa sogs? slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs par stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin chen po sku mdog dmar po byu ru'i lhun po la nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs kyis legs par spras pa ltar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan phyogs bcur gzigs pa: dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs rigs lngas brgyan cing dar rnam pa lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba sku stod la lha rdzas gos kyi ga shal dang : sku smad la bde chen klum pa'i ang rag dkris pa: phyag gnyis 'chi med bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa: de'i pang du lha lcam dmar mo mdzes chags ldan zhing yab la 'khril ba'i phyag gnyis kyis mda' dar dang tshe bum 'dzin cing :

rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa: yab yum 'od kyi gong bu chen po 'khrigs pa'i klong chen gzhal yas su tshe'i dbang phyug rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor ba'i spyi bor om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer sna lnga zhing khams kheng bar 'phros pas: tshe lha rig 'dzin drang srong rnams spyan drangs te slob ma rnams la thim par sgoms shig: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod klong yangs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: lhag pa'i lha mchog rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: pad 'byung yab yum rol rtsal ngo bo mchog: mgyogs ma la sogs dbang phyug tshe bdag rnams: byin chen dbab phyir thugs dam dbyings nas spyod: sku yi gzi brjid 'od phreng kyi li li: gsung gi sgra dbyangs snyan cha 'u ru ru: thugs kyi dgongs brda ma 'gags sha ra ra: mdzes pa'i lha rdzas rgyan 'phyangs spungs se spung : ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i brda gar lings se ling : dpa' bo dpa' mo'i gar thabs shigs se shig: tshe yi las byed pho nya khyugs se khyug: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs ye re re: dam rdzas rgya mtsho bcud ldan kyi li li: dad ldan pho mo dga' bro ya la la: dbang chen pho brang zer thag sbrengs se sbreng : bdud srin dam sri tshar gcod lams se lam: dbang bzhi chu bo'i rgyun 'bebs na ra ra: skal ldan bu la byin chen thibs se thib: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: 'chi med rig 'dzin sgrub la dngos grub stsol: om̐ ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na bh+rūm̐: a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ om̐ sa ma ya hrī dha ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra badz+ra zhes brtan par bya: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/

rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bla ma rig 'dzin dbyings nas gshegs: skal ldan mos pa'i bu la zhugs: sgo gsum phyag 'tshal dbang pos mchod: sdig bshags 'gro don chos 'khor bskor: dbang gi smin grol stsal du gsol: me tog dang bcas gsol ba gdab/ de nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga las/ thog mar bum pa ye shes lnga'i gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud rigs lnga tshe'i lha tshogs dngos su bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi nang gang bas sku rdo rje 'gyur ba med pa'i tshe dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tshe'i bum pa thogs nas: hūm̐: dbang chen rdo rje rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: sku yi dbang mchog thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bhan+dha bde ba chen po'i snod du rigs lnga'i tshe lha yab yum bde sbyor mdzad pa'i byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa ngag tu myang bas gsung rdo rje 'gag pa med pa'i tshe dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: dbang chen pad+ma rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi mgrin par bskur: gsung gi dbang mchog thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍā k+ki ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dkyil 'khor ye shes lnga'i ngo bo rol rtsal 'chi med rigs lnga tshe'i lha tshogs 'gyur med yongs grub chen por bzhugs pas sku las 'od zer lnga ldan du 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi yid kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa sangs/ thugs rdo rje 'pho 'gyur med pa 'chi med rtags pa dam pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/

dkyil 'khor thogs la: hūm̐: dbang chen bud+dha rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi snying gar bskur: thugs kyi dbang mchog thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes las zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ dwangs ma srog rten la thim pas yon tan mi zad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe gtor bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: dbang chen rat+na rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: yon tan dbang mchog thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: phyi ltar sna tshogs rdo rje gzhom bral tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor/ nang ltar ting 'dzin mi shigs rdo rje lta bu don dam rtag pa dam pa'i tshe grub nas las bzhi'i phrin las 'bad med du 'grub pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdo rje rgya gram thogs la: hūm̐: dbang chen karma rigs kyi bdag: 'chi med ngo bo tshe yi lha: skal ldan khyod kyi gsang bar bskur: phrin las dbang mchog thob par shog: mtha' rten rjes su gnang ba la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig byon khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so sos byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ rigs lnga'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: sku lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos: tshe lha rigs lnga'i dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob nas kyang : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: de nas mkha' 'gro rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: 'byung ba mnga' sgyur ḍāk+ki dngos: mkha' 'gro lnga yi dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob nas kyang : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: de nas mgyogs ma bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: tshad med bzhi ldan pho nya'i tshogs: mgyogs ma sgo skyong dbang bskur bas:

'chi med rig 'dzin thob nas kyang : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob ste 'gyur ba med pa sku'i dbang thob par mos shig /sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes mdzod/ ces bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /de nyid brtan pa'i ched du sngags phreng gyi dbang bskur bar mos shig / de nas bgrang phreng thogs la: hūm̐: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas sogs: bsgrub pa'i dam bca' bzung nas su: rgyun du bsnyen sgrub brtson par gyis: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yur+dz+nyā na badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ tshe ril 'di nyid 'khor 'das snang srid yongs kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor bcud du dril ba'i rdzas mchog tu dmigs te khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i lam du gtad pas snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas rdo rje'i srog la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tshe ril thogs la: hūm̐: 'khor 'das lha mi'i bcud bsdus la: 'chi med zas mchog ril bu 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: 'dod yon longs spyod dbang thob shog: tshe chang 'di nyid ngo bo 'chi med mgon po stangs dpyal gyi byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin yin pa khyed rang rnams kyi ngag tu blud pa tsam gyis bde stong 'gyur ba med pa'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dam tshig sna lnga'i rgyun lam nas: legs 'byung bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: de ring skal ldan khyod la blud: zag med bdud rtsi'i dbang thob shog: slar yang gtso bo'i thugs las spros pa'i lha mo mgyogs ma'i tshogs kyis tshe'i bcud bsdus shing bstims pa'i mos pa mdzod cig

/ de nas mda' dar thogs la: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin pa mos: lha klu mi yi bcud bsdus nas: skal ldan slob ma'i lus la bstim: tshe yi rig 'dzin myur thob mdzod: ye shes lnga'i phyag rgyar mtshon pa'i mda' dar gnas gsum du bzhag cing rgya yis btab pas nam yang skye shi 'pho 'gyur bral ba rtag brtan gzhom med sku lnga'i tshe dbang brnyes par mos shig / de nas rgya gram gyi rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab la: sra brtan 'gyur med rgya yis gdab: rim bsdus 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams: brtan par gyur cig badz+ra hoḥ tshe dbang du gyur cig /dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig /tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig /tshe srog rdo rje'i brag ri bas sra zhing brtan pa la mnga' mnyes par gyur cig / byin brlab bka' bsgo bar mos na tshe gtor spyi bor bzhag la/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: longs sku thugs rje chen po: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas: lha lcam man+da ra ba: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes: pad+ma gter bdag gling pa: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma: brgyud pa'i byin rlabs can rnams kyis skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di la 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i dbang bskur du gsol: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu mdzod cig: tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig: tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig: 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol: ces bskur ro/ de nas dkyil 'khor pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bden tshig gi smon lam dang shis brjod pas dge legs kyi snang ba chen pos phyogs kun tu khyab cing brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hūm̐: ma chags pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing*/ /'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin grub pa'i sku/ /mtsho skyes sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams kyi tshe dbang zab mo gnam lcags go khrab ces bya ba thob pa yin pas/ skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ gtso bos ci ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: lan gsum/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yi slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: lan gsum/ rang gzhan rnams kyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/

sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /de dag ni nga gcig pa tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ tshe dbang zab mo gnam lcags go khrab ces bya ba'i smin byed dbang chog khrigs chags su bkod pa ste lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi dbang gi le tshan no// // ༈ nga gnyis pa tshe dbang bsdus pa rdo rje'i go khrab ni/ gzhung las/ dbang bsdus rdo rje'i go khrab las: bum pa gtor ma yi dam tha mi dad pa'i ngo bor bsam zhing : sku gsang thugs kyi byin rlabs gcig tu bsdus pa yin: dbang rgyas pa bskur grub nas: zhes gsungs pa bzhin tshe dbang grangs gsog sogs long khom dang bstun/ skabs 'gar tshe dbang bsdus par 'dod na/ tshe gzhung rgyun khyer gang rung gzhung bsrang*/ tshe 'gugs bum pa gnyis sgrub la mchod bstod 'od zhu bdag dbang blang ba sogs song nas/ sngon 'gro khrus nas dbyung ba bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom pa sogs sngags tsam gyis bya/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du tshe dbang zab mo gsan par bgyi'o snyam pas/ thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la'ang nges don du 'chi med mgon po 'od snang mtha' yas nyid/ rang byung mtsho skyes sprul pa'i sku'i tshul bzung zhing*/ gdul bya drang ba'i don du tshe yum man+da ra bar bsten nas mā ra ti kar tshe bsgrubs pas/ skye 'chi med pa tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes shing*/ slar yang bod yul g.ya' ma lung du tshe'i sgrub pa mdzad par/ sprul gzhi tshe dpag med dang*/

lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa līs zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ gu ru yab yum 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mngon sum du grub cing*/ phyi ma'i gdul byar dgongs nas tshe sgrub brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad/ khyad par du o rgyan tshe dpag med dbyer med du bsgrub pa tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud 'di nyid mdzad de/ dam rdzas a ma ril bu sogs mkha' 'gro snying phug tu sbas shing*/ rgyas btab par mdzad pa las/ phyis smon lam dus la bab pa'i tshe gnubs chen rnam 'phrul/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos gdan drangs pa'i zab gter rin po che'i tshe dbang bsdus pa/ rdo rje'i go khrab zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas skyabs yul bla ma tshe dpag med dkyil 'khor mngon sum gsal ba'i drung*/ skyabs sems dang bsags sbyang gi gnad 'dus 'di'i don la yid la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can gyis: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog: thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: lan gsum dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi gnad ma 'chug par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta sa bsang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la/ khyed rang slob ma rnams dang mdun skyed skad cig gi o rgyan tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las/

'od zer 'phros pas tshe lha rig 'dzin drang srong rnams spyan drangs te slob ma rnams la thim par mos mdzod/ om̐ ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na bh+rūm̐: a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ mda' dar thogs la/ de nas tshe 'gugs shing bcud bsdu ba ni/ mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros te/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma srid zhi'i tshe dpal thams cad bsdus te/ bdag mdun rten rdzas la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin pa mos: lha klu mi yi bcud bsdus nas: skal ldan slob ma'i lus la bstim: tshe yi rig 'dzin myur thob mdzod: spro na tshe 'gug rgyas pa'ang bya/ de nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ de nas srid zhi'i tshe bcud thams cad phyag gi bum pa la thim/ phyir lud cing slob ma'i tshang bug nas zhugs/ bdud rtsi'i ltems kyis gang bas tshe'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bum pa mi dmigs chos sku'i klong : gtor ma zag med longs spyod brgyan: dkyil 'khor lha dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yongs rdzogs dbang bzhi thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na ka ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur mdzod cig: tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig: tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig: 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ de nas tshe chang mgrin par gtad la/ tshe chang 'di nyid ngo bo 'chi med mgon po stangs dpyal gyi byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin yin pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngag tu blud pa tsam gyis bde stong 'gyur ba med pa'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: dam tshig sna lnga'i rgyun lam nas: legs 'byung bdud rtsi a mṛ ta:
