de ring skal ldan khyod la blud: zag med bdud rtsi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na wak+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur mdzod cig: tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig: tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig: 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol: de nas tshe ril snying gar bzhag la/ tshe ril 'di nyid 'khor 'das snang srid yongs kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor bcud du dril ba'i rdzas mchog tu dmigs te/ khyed rang rnams la gtad pas/ snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas rdo rje'i srog la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: 'khor 'das lha mi'i bcud bsdus la: 'chi med zas mchog ril bu 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: 'dod yon longs spyod dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur mdzod cig: tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig: tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig: 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol: ye shes lnga'i phyag rgyar mtshon pa'i mda' dar gnas gsum du bzhag cing rgya yis btab pas/ nam yang skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur bral ba rtag brtan gzhom med sku lnga'i tshe dbang brnyes par mos shig / de nas rgya gram gyi rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab la: sra brtan 'gyur med rgya yis gdab: rim bsdus 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams: brtan par gyur cig badz+ra hoḥ tshe dbang du gyur cig /dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig /tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig /tshe srog rdo rje'i brag ri bas sra zhing brtan pa la mnga' mnyes par gyur cig / bkra shis brjod/

de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi tshe dbang zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas spyi dang bye brag dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ gtso bos ci ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: lan gsum/ bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /rjes kyi rim pa gzhung bzhin bya'o// // tshem̐ sgrubam̐ lcam̐gs kyim̐ rgyam̐ mdudam̐ zhes bya ba/ tshe dbam̐ng rig 'dzin pad+ma'i thugs dam gnad/ /gsaṃng sngaṃgs rdzas sman bskyed rdzogs zab mo yi/ /srog 'tsho'i man ngag bstanaṃ 'dziṃn khyad nor lags/ de dag ni nga gnyis pa tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi tshe dbang bsdus pa'i le tshan te dbang chog yongs rdzogs kyi mtha' grub bo// // ༈ de nas mtha' rgyas bkra shis par byed pa slob ma mnga' gsol gyi rim pa ni/ da khyed rnams la o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa yongs su rdzogs pas/ sgo gsum bya ba dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ gsang gsum phrin las dang bcas pa dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par gyur nas/ da ni rgyal bu rgyal sar mnga' gsol zhing*/ rgyal srid gtad pa bzhin du 'dir yang chos kyi rgyal srid la mnga' gsol ba'i phyir/ khyed rnams kyang rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ zhabs la rin po che'i khri dang*/ dbu la gser gyi gdugs/ phyag na dbang sgyur gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa bskur zhing*/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyis mdun nas brdal/ bkra shis pa'i rtags mchog brgyad kyi sku la brgyan/ yon tan rmad du byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad kyi mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/

po ti gtad la/ de la thog mar chos kyi rgyal tshab chen po'i bka' gtad cing rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum dang*/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs zab chos 'di nyid kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad par bskul ba'i brdar/ khyed rang rnams la po ti glegs bam gyis dbang bskur bas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis wā rā ṇā si dang*/ bya rgod phung ri sogs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ gdul bya grangs med pa smin grol la bkod pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan bzhin rgyal po dzā la gsang sngags kyi bka' bab pa ltar/ deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyis kyang chos kyi mdzod chen po 'di nyid/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum dang*/ 'chad nyan sgom sgrub gyis shig ces bka' yi gnang ba thob par mos shig / po ti gtad la/ hūm̐: yang dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams: lha dang mi dang lha ma yin: chos bstan de bzhin khyod la gtad: om̐ dharma mi kha te swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas snyan grags kyi dung dkar gtad la/ hoḥ sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar phul bas snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po phyogs bcur bsgrengs te rdo rje theg chen gyi snyan pa'i chos sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pa bzhin du/ khyed rang rnams la dung dkar phyag tu gtad pas/ bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan don phrin las rlabs po che dpag tu med pa mdzad par bskul ba'i gnang ba thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /hūm̐: dga' ldan lha las babs pa'i theg chen sgra: dam pas srol gtod mdzad pa snyan pa'i dung : chos kyi rnga chen sgrog par bskul ba pos: de ring skal ldan khyod la bskor bar bskur: oṃ badz+ra dharma shaṃ kha la swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rin po che'i 'khor lo gtad la/

hoḥ sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lha tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo phul ba'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo brgyad khri bzhi stong bskor ba bzhin du/ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la gser gyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur bas/ 'gro ba gang 'dul der ston gyi theg pa rim dgu'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing*/ gdul bya'i kha lo dam pa'i chos kyi bsgyur zhing bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po byed nus pa'i dpal la longs spyod par gyur cig /oṃ: rin chen las grub gser gyi 'khor lo ni: rtsibs stong mu khyud khor yug bsgribs nas su: mdo sngags sgron me sbar ba'i ched du sbyin: dam pa'i yon tan lhun gyis grub par shog: oṃ swa na tsakra sa le sbraṃ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas nor bu rin po che gtad la/ hoḥ sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la klu'i rgyal pos nor bu phul bas rten 'brel la brten nas/ chos thams cad mthar thug theg chen byang chub sems kyi sde snod/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa nges don phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin du deng 'dir khyed rang rnams nor bu rin po ches dbang bskur bas/ 'gro khams 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i nges don rdzogs pa chen pos/ rtsol med theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing don gnyis 'bad med lhun 'grub khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po mnga' dbang chen po'i dpal la longs spyod par gyur cig hūm̐: yid bzhin nor bu lhun grub 'od rab 'byin: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla med rdzogs pa che: zab lam snyan brgyud nges pa'i don kun rdzogs: rin chen lag bcang lta bu khyod la sbyin: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na trām̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen gzhong pa gtad la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la rin po che'i gzhong pa'i dbang bskur bas sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/

gnod sbyin gyi rgyal pos rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i gzhong pa bse ru spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan nor bu me shel me'i snying po/ chu shel chu'i snying po/ thabs rgyal po'i rna cha/ shes rab btsun mo'i rna cha/ zung 'jug blon po'i rna cha/ rgyal po'i bla rten glang chen gyi mche ba/ btsun mo'i bla rten byi ru dbang gi rgyal mo/ blon po la mu tig sna lnga'i phreng ba bcas maṇ+ḍal phul bas/ chos thams cad 'dzam gling gi mdzod kha phye ba ltar gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pas/ spyod yul du gyur pa bzhin du de ring gling bzhi chos kyi rgyal srid gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rgyal po lta bur thabs kyi chos rnams ni: blon po lta bur phra zhib nyams su myong : shes rab btsun mo yon tan rgyan gyis phyug: phyi nang gsang gsum deng 'dir khyod la sbyin: oṃ sarba badz+ra prañja hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rgyal srid sna bdun lag tu sprad nas/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyi dbang bskur bas/ phyi'i rten 'brel bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston la spyod pa'i/ 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal rnams la sngon gyi rnam dkar gyi mthu las snang bas rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyi sa gsum 'jig rten kun la dbang bsgyur ba dang*/ nang du 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi 'byor bas lam lnga'i yon tan la dbang bsgyur ba'i brdar/ rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyi 'byor pas mnga' gsol bar mos shig /hūm̐: 'khor lo rin chen rnam bcu ldan: 'khor ba'i 'khor tshogs rgyun bcad nas: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed dbang : skal ldan khyod kyis thob par shog: om̐ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: btsun mo rin chen bsod nams gter: pha rol phyin bcu'i gzugs dang ldan: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i dbang : yid bzhin dpal 'byor thob par shog: oṃ wa tī rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

hūm̐: nor bu rin chen phun sum gnas: bsod nams tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shing : dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas: lhan cig nor bdun phyug par shog: om̐ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: blon po rin chen blo gros ldan: gang la ji 'dod dpag bsam 'dra: gzhan don tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shing : shes bya thogs med dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā ma ti rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: dmag dpon rin chen stobs rtsal ldan: brtson 'grus go gyon 'khor ba 'joms: thabs ldan skyabs kyi dbang mchog 'dis: 'jigs tshogs lta ba 'joms par shog: oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: rta mchog rin chen sa lam bgrod: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha mthar brgal: bde chen thar lam zhing du 'dren: rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: glang po rin chen theg chen stobs: bdud sde 'joms pa'i dpung dang ldan: stobs chen gzhan gyi don byed cing : yang dag snying po'i don rtogs shog: oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hoḥ rigs kyi bu rnams la rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur bas/ bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i don bdun dang ldan nas/ gzhan don dpag med du 'grub pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /༈ de nas bsod nams brgya las grub pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan dpe'i dpal las snang ba'i bkra shis pa'i rtags mchog brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas/ bdud dang mu stegs sogs phas rgol gyi g.yul las rgyal zhing*/ 'gro kun de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rtags la sogs pa'i spyod yul rlabs po che la 'jug pa'i dbang thob par mos shig /

bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang ni/ gdugs/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na gdugs bzang gser gyi yu ba can: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod pa ltar: dbu la gdugs kyi bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ tsha traṃ ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gser nya/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na gser gyi nya mo 'od 'bar ba: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i spyan la mchod pa ltar: spyan la nya yi bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ ma tsha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dung*/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na chos kyi dung sgra sgrogs mdzad pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i gsung la mchod pa ltar: gsung la dung gi bkra shis thob par shog: oṃ maṅga laṃ shaṃ ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na pad+ma dmar mo 'dab brgyad pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod pa ltar: ljags la pad+ma'i bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bum pa/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na rin chen bum pa rab mdzes pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i mgul la mchod pa ltar: mgul la bum pa'i bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ kum+bha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dpal be'u/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na dpal gyi be'u 'od 'bar ba: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod pa ltar: thugs la dpal be'u bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ maṅga pa tra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na rin chen rgyal mtshan rab mdzes pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i sku la mchod pa ltar: sku la rgyal mtshan bkra shis thob par shog: oṃ maṅga laṃ dh+wa dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: 'khor lo/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni: phyag na gser gyi 'khor lo 'od 'bar ba: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i zhabs la mchod pa ltar: zhabs la 'khor lo'i bkra shis thob par shog:

oṃ maṅga laṃ tsakra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: yang ston mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi 'dren par byon nas 'du ba bzhi'i phrin las dang*/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi 'gro ba 'dren par byon pa'i tshe/ lha ma'i dbang po dag gis rten 'brel gyi rdzas phul bas dus kun shis pa spel ba'i/ bkra shis grub pa'i rdzas mchog brgyad du byin gyis brlabs pas dbang bskur ba'i phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dge legs rtags pa'i nyi ma 'khor yug tu khyab pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad thogs la/ rtog med yungs dkar rtog 'khrul gdon bgegs 'joms/ /ye shes me long bkra shis gzugs brnyan 'char/ /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'gags med chos sgra sgrogs/ /zho ni don dam snying po'i bcud kyis 'tsho/ /bde chen li khris snang sems dbang du byed/ /bilba 'bras bur smin pas don kun 'grub/ /sman mchog gi waṃ nyon mongs nad rnams sel/ /rtsa mchog dūrbas 'chi med tshe dbang ster/ /rgyal bas byin brlabs bkra shis rdzas brgyad pos/ /mnga' gsol bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ aṣ+ṭā maṅga laṃ dra bya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes so sor gtad cing mnga' gsol/ de dag gis dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa yin pas/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bden tshig gi shis pa brjod cing*/ me tog gi char chen po bsnyil bas dbang gi byin rlabs gong du 'phel zhing nyams med brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ de nas dam tshig gi khe nyen spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams legs par bsrung zhing dkyil 'khor 'di nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzung zhing*/ bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po byed snyam pas dam tshig khas len 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa che: dam pas bka' ni legs bstsal pa: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung :

de ltar dbang bskur ba'i slob bus slob dpon gyi dgyes pa skong dgos te/ rig pa rang shar las/ de ltar man ngag slob dpon la/ khu bo pha dang ma dang mig /bu dang chung ma nor dang mchog /sgo gsum zol zog med pa yis/ /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad 'bul/ /zhes dang*/ de ltar mnyes pa'i yon tan yang*/ de nyid las/ brten pa de la yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yi/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa 'thob/ /ces gsungs pas/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus dang longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya cher spyod la skyong du gsol: de nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen 'grub pa'i dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar ma byas na las kyi mtha' mi btsan pas/ 'di ltar bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mdo las/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /zhes dang*/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ bdag gi smon lam mtha' yas de tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ / sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ de dag ni sprul pa'i gter chen o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter ring lugs yongs rdzogs kyi smin byed dbang gi chu bo ma lus pa phyogs gcig tu drangs pa/

ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ ring zhig dpal zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling du rdor slob 'gan khur ba'i dus skabs shig thag ring bod yul nas/ 'brong pa mthong smon be cang gi sras dang lha ma sgom pa tshang gi sras sogs dpon blon 'ga' khul der 'byor ba dang*/ mched grogs dam pa 'brong pa rgyal po rin po che'am shar gling mi 'gyur rin chen rnam rgyal mchog nas ngo chen gsung nan ma chog par gnam lcags dbang lung skabs der gang yod 'don khul byas shing de skabs dbang chog chog bsgrigs ma rnyed par dka' ngal gang che 'phrad/ de rjes 7gter chen pad rgyal gling pa'i zhal mjal zhing gter chen nyid kyi gter gsar skor smin grol stsol bar gsol ba btab pas zhal bzhes dang*/ de 'phral khyed nas kyang gter rnying skor nged slob tshogs rnams la dbang lung gnang dgos zhes bka' phab pas re zhig yin min zhu spobs bral/ de rjes bal yul zhe chen dgon du sgrub chen zhig 'tshogs nas yod skabs gter chen rin po che der thog rgyag tu phebs nas da lo gter gsar gyi dbang de'ang 'don gtan khel/ khyed nas kyang gter kha gong ma'i dbang rnams gsung rgyu'i go sgrigs byas yod gsungs pas/ phran pas dbang zhu bar bcar rgyu yin/ yin na'ang khyed gu ru'i rgyal tshab gter chen zhig la ngas dbang ni phul mi shes lung 'dra rten 'brel du phul chog par zhus pas/ khong nas 'o na snga 'gyur bstan pa'i bdag po mkhyen rtse rin po che la zhu dgos par 'dug gsungs nas nged gnyis zhabs sar bcar/ gter chen rin po ches gnas tshul rnams zhib par zhus mdzad skabs mkhyen brtse rin po ches phran la gzigs nas da res skabs bab rten 'brel yin pas ma 'chug par gyis/ thog mar gter gsar rnams tshur zhus/ de nas khyod la brgyud pa yod pa de rnams chad lhag med par phar phul zhes bka' gnang*/

de nas ngas 'di rnams phal cher chog khrigs mi 'dug pas 'don rgyu ngal ba che lugs zhus pas dbang yig phal che bar spyan zhib mdzad cing gter gzhung phal cher 'di bzhin mang*/ de la gab pa bsdeb/ 'khrugs pa bsal/ /dkyus pa bsrangs nas man ngag mthong rgyun lag len thebs pa dgos mod deng sang de bzhin rgyun mi 'khyong*/ des na slad 'don khrigs sus bltas kyang 'don shes pa zhig dgos gal chen po red gsung*/ de ltar gnang rogs zhus pas yong yong gsung*/ deng sang nub ri sogs la bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma chen po 'gas dbang 'don dus dbang sgrub dang lag len go rim gang yang shes kyin mi 'dug zer mis 'phya gin 'dug ga /'o na ga 'dra byed zhus par gnas skabs skyon med 'jam mgon rnam gnyis kyi dbang spyi'i khog dbub yod pa de bzhin gyis zhes so sor sbyar lugs zhib phra bka' mngag mdzad/ spyir yo ga gsum gyi don dbang bzhi'i go don skabs phye thub dgos kyi red/ de khyod kyis kyang lus shes gsung*/ de thog mi brjed phyir zin bris btab/ rjes su o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter gyi mtha' skyong ba gter chen pad rgyal gling pa rin po che'i slob tshogs dang bcas par dbang rgyun 'bul ba'i skabs nyin re bzhin ji dgos bka' 'dri zhus la/ slad bod yul nas pad+ma khrag 'thung gi dbang chog rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i phyogs bsgrigs sogs lag tu 'byor bas gter chen bla ma rnam gnyis kyi dgongs pa dang gcig tu bab 'dug pa bzhin/ yid ches nges pa rnyed nas zab chos 'di nyid la sri zhu dang 'khor lo'i mgon po nyi ma 'od zer mjal kha tha ma'i skabs/ khong nas nga la gnam sprul bzod pa rab brtan gyis gnam lcags bstan pa 'di khyod la gtad pa yin gsungs nas gtad rgya mdzad pa yin la/ ngas kyang khyed sprul sku rnams la phul ba yin/ 'on kyang zhes mang du bshums nas da phyin bstan pa 'di ming ma bor tsam yong ba'i re ba de khyod la bcol yod gsungs pas/

gnam sprul rin po che sogs mang po bzhugs yod na'ang de skabs gsung de ci yin ma shes mod/ dam pa rnams kyis bkas bskul bzhin 'di ga'i bka' bsdu bya rgyur lung bstan pa yin par da gzod go nas mgon po gang gi bka' drin gzhal ba'i phyir du dmigs nas/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa nyid rab byung bcu gnyis pa shing khyi lor spyi lo 1694thog mar sku bltams nas lo 311 'das pa rab byung bcu bdun pa shing mo bya/ smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i dus tshes dge bar sgo chen rgyal sprul gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis 'dzam gling dbang phyogs skyong ba/ skye med yi ge'i sgra ldan gyi khab e wam̐ bsti gnas gsang sngags gling du grub par bgyis la slar yang glog klad drwa ba'i 'phrul thabs las/ yud tsam gyis shar phyogs hi ma la'i ri rgyud shrī lnga ldan rgyal khams su gnas pa'i phur gling sgrub sde ru/ 'phen sprul au ḍī'i sar 'phur 'gros su btang zhing lhan cig tu dag par bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa'i snying po sa gsum gyi khyon du dar zhing rgyas la yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //
